**Job Description – HR Manager**

**Location:** Mumbai  
**Experience:** 6–10 Years  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced HR Manager with a strong focus on **Talent Acquisition and HR Operations oversight**. The role will be approximately **70% Recruitment and 30% HR Operations**, with responsibility for driving hiring outcomes while ensuring payroll, payments, compliance, and critical HR processes are accurately reviewed and completed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Talent Acquisition – 70%**

* Own and oversee end\-to\-end recruitment for business\-critical positions.
* Develop hiring strategies and maintain a strong talent pipeline.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand requirements and ensure timely closures.
* Review candidate quality, interviews, offers, and hiring decisions.
* Track recruitment TAT, pipeline, offer\-to\-joining ratio, and hiring quality.
* Monitor recruitment performance and provide regular hiring updates to senior management.
* Continuously improve sourcing strategies and recruitment processes.

**2\. HR Operations \& Payroll – 30%**

* Oversee HR operations and ensure timely and accurate completion of critical activities.
* Review and verify payroll, attendance, leaves, deductions, incentives, reimbursements, and employee changes before processing.
* Monitor employee, consultant, and vendor payments and ensure they are processed accurately and on time.
* Check PF, ESIC, TDS, Professional Tax, and other compliance requirements and deadlines.
* Conduct regular checks to identify errors, pending activities, and process gaps.
* Coordinate with Finance and the HR team for timely closure of payroll, payments, compliance, and operational activities.
* Ensure HRMS data, documentation, and processes are accurate and up to date.

**Key Requirements**

* 5–10 years of HR experience with strong Talent Acquisition experience.
* Proven experience managing multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.
* Strong recruitment strategy, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Working knowledge of payroll, HR operations, and statutory compliance.
* Experience managing or mentoring an HR/recruitment team.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* High ownership and attention to detail.
* Experience with HRMS/ATS platforms such as Keka, Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, or similar tools preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate will be **recruitment\-focused, strategic, commercially aware, and data\-driven**, with the ability to work closely with senior management while overseeing critical HR operations and controls.

*Jaiswal Group*

Role Overview

**Job Title**

**Department**

Operations

General Manager – Operations

**Scope**

Multi\-site Food Service / Canteen Operations

**Industry**

Institutional Food Service / Contract Catering

Job Summary

The Area Manager at Jaiswal Group is a key operational leadership role responsible for overseeing multiple canteen and food service units within an assigned region. This role demands a hands\-on operator who can drive consistent service quality, food safety compliance, and financial performance across all sites.

You will be the primary point of accountability between frontline site teams and senior management ensuring that daily operations run smoothly, clients are satisfied, costs are controlled, and people are developed. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, multi\-site environment and take genuine ownership of results, this role is designed for you.

Key Responsibilities1\. Site Operations \& Daily Management

* Visit a minimum of two units daily to assess operational standards, address on\-ground issues, and ensure smooth service delivery.
* Monitor day\-to\-day operations across all assigned units and ensure adherence to defined service standards and SOPs.
* Ensure production planning is completed at least two days in advance and executed through the system; verify compliance daily.
* Review and approve the Canteen Service Report (CSR) and ensure all documentation at each site is completed as per the prescribed checklist.

2\. Food Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure all units are compliant with FSSAI licensing requirements licences must be prominently displayed and valid at all times.
* Oversee the collection and frozen storage of food samples for a rolling three\-day period at each site.
* Ensure periodic water quality reports are conducted and findings are documented.
* Maintain all compliance\-related documentation at the unit level and keep it up to date at all times.
* Ensure personal grooming standards are enforced by the Unit Manager on a daily basis.

3\. Cost Control \& Profitability

* Prepare and review the Daily Profitability Report (DPR) for all sites and identify variances requiring corrective action.
* Track and analyse projected versus actual raw material consumption on a daily basis to detect and address inefficiencies.
* Drive food waste reduction target food wastage at or below 3% daily and ensure raw food wastage is recorded every day.
* Ensure cooked food portion weights are recorded and average per\-person consumption is updated in the system in coordination with the costing team.
* Approve petty cash and cash purchases for assigned units (with Purchase and Costing teams kept in the loop); actively minimise cash purchases.
* Audit cash sales wherever applicable at sites.

4\. Inventory \& Procurement

* Ensure a minimum of two weeks’ raw material inventory is maintained at all times across assigned sites.
* Review and approve purchase requisitions for respective sites.
* Conduct random physical and perpetual stock audits to verify inventory accuracy.
* Check the quality of incoming materials; escalate and coordinate with the Purchase team if any material falls below standard.
* Ensure all grocery brands used at sites are as per the approved agreement specifications.

5\. Menu Planning \& Costing

* Collaborate with the client to plan menus within the agreed budget; obtain approval from the Costing team before implementation.
* Ensure approved menus are updated in the system with targeted food cost figures.
* For weekly menus, ensure finalisation by Friday of the preceding week; for monthly menus, by the 20th of the prior month.

6\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Conduct formal client feedback sessions at least once a week; document and act on all feedback received.
* Prepare and share feedback reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis with the client and internal stakeholders.
* Verify headcount of meals consumed at each site; ensure any cash collections are updated in the system accurately.
* Ensure timely invoicing for all sites; verify invoices before submission and follow up on recoveries to avoid delays.

7\. Team Leadership \& Training

* Identify high\-potential employees across sites and optimise workforce deployment and duty allocation accordingly.
* Conduct a weekly briefing for site teams; ensure Unit Managers conduct daily staff briefings at every site without fail.
* Re\-impart regional training programmes to site teams and conduct structured on\-the\-job training sessions at least once a week.
* Support site teams in hiring staff wherever required, following the defined HR process.
* Initiate and drive the Rewards \& Recognition programme across all assigned sites to boost morale and performance.

8\. HR \& Attendance Management

* Ensure the Attendance Management System is functional and being used correctly at all units.
* Oversee attendance regularisation and ensure HR\-related documentation at each unit is kept updated at all times.

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* Graduate or postgraduate in Hotel Management, Food Service Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in food service, canteen operations, or institutional catering, with at least 2–3 years in a multi\-site or supervisory role.
* Prior experience managing client relationships and working within contractual food service environments is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI regulations, food safety protocols, and compliance documentation.
* Hands\-on familiarity with ERP or operations management systems used for production planning, inventory, and reporting.

Key Skills \& CompetenciesOperational Excellence

* Strong understanding of multi\-unit food service operations and the ability to manage complexity across sites simultaneously.
* Ability to read, interpret, and act on daily operational data including profitability reports and consumption variance.

Food Safety \& Quality

* Thorough knowledge of FSSAI norms, food hygiene standards, and documentation requirements.
* Disciplined approach to compliance no shortcuts on safety.

Financial Acumen

* Comfortable with cost analysis, budgeting, and driving profitability at the unit level.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to manage client expectations and maintain long\-term relationships.
* Proactive in seeking feedback and turning it into actionable improvements.

People Leadership

* Natural team builder with the ability to motivate, train, and hold teams accountable across multiple locations.
* Experience in structured training delivery and performance management at the field level.

Planning \& Organisation

* Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-through culture things get done, and results are tracked.

title: Lab Manager
description:
**Although this position allows for administrative work to be done remotely, this is fundamentally a field\-based management role. The Operations Manager is required to conduct daily, mandatory site visits. Every single day, you are expected to physically visit at least one active camp site at a different location within the Jaipur region. These visits are crucial to:**

* **Ensure operational integrity by checking that the camp is set up correctly, running smoothly, and adhering to all protocols.**
* **Actively manage any on\-site grievances or logistical crises immediately.**
* **Meet with partner NGO officials and local coordinators present at the site to take their feedback, ensure their satisfaction, and build strong, long\-term relationships.**

**1\. Team Recruitment \& Management**

* **Talent Acquisition:** End\-to\-end recruitment of phlebotomists and field technicians in various locations. Conduct interviews, verify certifications, and onboard new hires.
* **Duty Roster \& Allocation:** Create and manage complex duty rosters, assigning the team of 30 phlebotomists to different camp locations based on requirements, skill level, and geography.
* **HR Management:** Manage attendance, leaves, shift swaps, and performance evaluations. Handle team grievances and disciplinary issues.
* **Training \& SOP Adherence:** Conduct remote or in\-person training sessions on pre\-analytical protocols, patient handling, safety, and operational Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

**2\. Camp Logistics \& Operational Oversight**

* **Resource Planning:** Ensure all field teams have necessary supplies (vaccutainers, needles, ice packs, transport boxes, consent forms) before deploying to a camp.
* **Punctuality Monitoring:** Track the real\-time location and arrival of phlebotomists at camp venues to guarantee on\-time setup.
* **Problem Solving:** Act as the central command hub during active camps to immediately resolve issues like staff shortage, vehicle breakdown, or material deficit.

**3\. Clinical Compliance \& Sample Logistics**

* **Cold Chain Management:** Monitor and enforce strict cold chain maintenance protocols during sample collection and transport to ensure sample viability.
* **Lab Coordination:** Coordinate with partner laboratories to ensure timely and proper handover of collected samples. Verify that the correct tests are registered for the correct samples.
* **Report Management:** Tracking the Analytical Turn Around Time (TAT). Follow up with labs for timely report generation and ensure reports are dispatched/uploaded to the patient or NGO partner without delay.

**4\. Finance, Billing \& Recovery**

* **Billing Generation:** Oversee the accurate generation of bills based on the actual number of tests conducted at each camp.
* **Payment Recovery:** Coordinate with NGO partners and corporate clients for timely processing of payments against submitted invoices. Maintain a tracker of receivables.
* **Expense Management:** Verify and approve field team expenses, including travel and logistics costs.

**5\. Stakeholder Management \& Grievance Redressal**

* **NGO Liaison:** Act as the primary point of contact for NGO partner representatives, coordinating camp dates, locations, and expectations.
* **Grievance Handling:** Promptly and professionally handle any grievances from patients, NGO partners, or labs regarding the conduct of phlebotomists, delays in reports, or billing discrepancies.
* **Relationship Building:** Foster positive long\-term relationships with lab partners, supply vendors, and NGO clients.

description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. * Exposure to **Power BI and HR analytics**.
* Strong communication, coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and ownership mindset.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new **HR technology, AI and automation tools**.

If you are an HR professional who wants to go beyond traditional HR administration and build expertise in **HR \+ Data \+ Technology \+ AI**, this role gives you the opportunity to learn, experiment and grow. **We value:****Learnability \| Ownership \| Data\-driven Thinking \| Collaboration \| Continuous Improvement \| AI Mindset**

**Company:** Swastik Financial Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Credit  
**Designation:** Credit Analyst  
**Location:** Besant Nagar, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Head \- Risk

**Job Summary**

Swastik Financial Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical **Credit Analyst** to support the company's credit assessment and loan underwriting function.

The role involves analysing loan applications, assessing the creditworthiness and repayment capacity of customers, reviewing financial and banking information, evaluating credit bureau reports, identifying potential risks, and ensuring compliance with the company's credit policies and processes.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and numerical skills, attention to detail, sound judgement, and a good understanding of retail lending and credit risk.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Credit Analysis \& Underwriting**

* Analyse loan applications and assess the overall creditworthiness of prospective borrowers.
* Evaluate customer income, repayment capacity, existing obligations, banking behaviour and financial profile.
* Analyse salary/income documents, bank statements, financial statements and other relevant information.
* Review credit bureau reports and assess repayment history, overdue accounts, credit utilisation and other credit indicators.
* Identify inconsistencies, adverse trends, potential risks and deviations in loan proposals.
* Prepare credit assessments and recommendations for approval/rejection as per the company's credit policy and delegation matrix.
* Ensure that credit decisions are supported by adequate documentation and objective analysis.

**2\. Documentation \& Verification**

* Review KYC, income, banking, property/security and other supporting documents as applicable.
* Ensure all mandatory documentation is complete and satisfactory before recommending a case.
* Coordinate with multiple Sales, Credit, Legal and Technical vendors and teams for additional information or verification.
* Validate information provided by customers against available supporting documents.
* Ensure that credit conditions and approval requirements are properly documented and complied with.

**3\. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with multiple Sales, Credit, Legal and Technical vendors
* Communicate credit requirements, deficiencies and approval conditions clearly.
* Follow up on cases requiring additional documentation or clarification.
* Maintain professional independence while working closely with business teams.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in **Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field**.
* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Banking or a related discipline will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **1–3 years** of experience in credit analysis, credit underwriting, loan processing or credit operations within an **NBFC, bank, housing finance company or financial services organisation**.
* Candidates with relevant experience in retail lending, secured lending or MSME lending will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong analytical and financial skills may be considered for entry\-level positions.

**Required Skills**

title: Corporate Sales Manager
description:
About us

We are an early\-stage travel and tourism company based in Coimbatore, building leisure, group and corporate travel experiences for individual travellers, companies and institutions. As a young team, every person here owns real work from day one — you will not be a cog in a process, you will help build the process.

About the role

This is a dual role. Roughly 60% travel operations and 40% corporate and institutional sales. You will handle the end\-to\-end running of trips — quoting, booking, coordinating, and keeping guests happy — while also meeting companies, colleges and institutions in and around Coimbatore to bring in group and corporate business.

It suits someone who is organised enough to run a booking without errors, and personable enough to sit across from an HR head or a college administrator and hold a conversation. If you want variety rather than a narrow job description, this is it.

What you'll do — Operations

Build itineraries and cost sheets for domestic and international packages, group tours, and corporate offsites

Coordinate bookings with hotels, DMCs, transport operators, airlines and activity partners; negotiate rates

Handle guest communication from enquiry through to post\-trip feedback — calls, WhatsApp, email

Manage documentation: vouchers, invoices, visa paperwork, insurance, travel advisories

Be the point of contact while groups are travelling, including occasional after\-hours support during live trips

Maintain trip files, vendor records and the enquiry pipeline in our CRM/sheets

Track trip\-level costs and margins, and flag leakage

What you'll do — Corporate \& Institutional Sales

Build a prospect list of corporates, manufacturing and engineering firms, IT companies, hospitals, educational institutions, clubs and associations across Coimbatore, Tiruppur, Erode and Salem

Do outreach — calls, LinkedIn, emails, walk\-ins — and convert them into meetings

Attend client meetings (in person and online): offsites, annual team outings, MICE, dealer and incentive trips, student educational tours, faculty and alumni travel

Prepare proposals and presentations; follow up until closure

Represent the company at local trade and industry events, expos and association meets

Maintain relationships with existing accounts so repeat business comes back to us

What we're looking for

0–2 years of experience. Freshers with the right attitude will be trained. Prior experience in travel, hospitality, events, or any client\-facing sales role is an advantage

Any graduate. Degrees in Travel \& Tourism, Hotel Management, BBA or similar are a plus, not a must

Fluent English and Tamil, spoken and written. Comfort in Hindi or Malayalam is a bonus

Genuinely good on the phone and in person — warm, clear, and able to handle a client who is upset

Detail\-orientation that shows up in the work: correct dates, correct names, correct amounts, every time

Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp Business, and basic presentation tools

Willing to travel locally for client meetings, and occasionally to escort or set up a group tour

Two\-wheeler and valid licence preferred for client visits

Nice to have

Familiarity with GDS, B2B booking portals or travel CRMs

Exposure to social media, content or destination marketing

Existing contacts in the Coimbatore corporate or education ecosystem

Work arrangement and flexibility

Core working days at our Coimbatore office, with flexibility to work from home on agreed days once you are settled in

Flexible start and finish timings can be discussed around genuine personal commitments such as school hours

Some evening or weekend availability is needed when a group is actually travelling — we plan this in advance, and compensate with time off

**We actively encourage applications from women returning to work after a career break.** If you have been away from a full\-time role for a while, that is not a mark against you here. We are happy to structure the first few months as a phased, part\-remote ramp\-up while you find your rhythm.

title: Senior Manager- People Operations
description:
**COMPANY SUMMARY**
  

Irth Solutions is a PE\-backed global SaaS company and the leading platform for damage prevention and asset protection in the energy, utility, telecom, and media industries. With \~350 employees across the US, Canada, and India, we help clients protect critical infrastructure through intelligent software that powers the entire damage prevention lifecycle. We're a scaling company with a builder's mindset — and we're looking for people who thrive in that environment  

  

**JOB SUMMARY**
  

We're hiring Senior Manager\- People Operations to own the operational backbone of our People \& Culture function. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has built and run people operations in complex, multi\-jurisdictional environments and knows what "good" looks like in payroll, benefits, and HRIS without needing it to be handed to them. This role is based in our Pune, India office and operates on US business hours to support our North American employee population. You'll lead a team of two direct reports and report directly to the Chief People \& Culture Officer. If you're looking for a role where you can build infrastructure that actually matters and see your impact in real time, this is it.

 **Requirements** **What You'll Own**  

**Payroll**  



* Own end\-to\-end US payroll processing (semi\-monthly) for \~300\+ employees across multiple states, with hands\-on accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
* Manage Canadian payroll operations across multiple provinces, including Quebec — navigating jurisdiction\-specific deductions, tax filing, and regulatory requirements
* Partner with Finance on payroll accounting, GL reconciliation, and audit readiness
* Lead remediation and ongoing maintenance of multi\-state payroll tax registrations, including proactive identification and resolution of tax ID gaps in Rippling
* Stay current on federal, state/provincial, and local payroll compliance changes across all operating jurisdictions

**Benefits Administration**

* Own US benefits program design and administration, including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, 401(k), life, and ancillary lines
* Manage open enrollment end\-to\-end — plan selection, carrier coordination, employee communications, and system configuration in Rippling
* Lead broker relationship and serve as the primary point of contact for carriers and TPAs
* Ensure ACA compliance, reporting, and filing (1094/1095\-C)
* Support Canada benefits strategy in partnership with local HR resources (Pune/India ancillary benefits as applicable)

**HRIS — Rippling**

* Serve as the system owner and subject matter expert for Rippling across all modules: payroll, benefits, PTO, headcount, and integrations
* Own data integrity, configuration, workflows, and role\-based access
* Lead HRIS optimization initiatives — building automation, improving self\-service, and reducing manual lift across the People team
* Manage Rippling\-to\-Intacct integration, including issue escalation and resolution with vendor support
* Partner with Finance and IT on system governance, data validation, and new module rollouts

**People Operations \& Compliance**

* Directly manage and develop two People Operations team members — setting priorities, building capability, and creating a high\-performing team culture
* Develop and maintain HR policies across US and Canada jurisdictions, ensuring alignment with applicable employment law
* Support BYOD compliance framework, records retention, and HR audit readiness across US, Canada, and India •
* Manage unemployment claims, leave administration (FMLA, state leaves, parental), and workers' compensation programs

description:
Manager – Marketplace Growth \& Client AcquisitionLegal \& Corporate Services

**Company:** Aegis Corporate Alliance Pvt. Ltd.  
**Office:** Aegis Riverfront, Aluva, Ernakulam, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Salary:** Starting from ₹25,000 per month \+ Attractive Performance Incentives  
**Reporting Requirement:** Minimum 3 days of physical reporting at the Aluva office during the last week of every month. Employees may also work from the office additionally whenever preferred or operationally required.

About the Role

Aegis Corporate Alliance Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a commercially driven and highly organised professional to develop and manage our business acquisition through global freelance and professional\-service marketplaces, particularly platforms such as Upwork, Fiverr and Freelancer.

This is **not a routine digital marketing or social\-media role**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying suitable business opportunities, positioning our legal and corporate service offerings, preparing persuasive proposals, communicating with prospective clients, following up on opportunities, improving marketplace profiles and converting qualified leads into sustainable business.

The role is ideal for someone who understands **online B2B client acquisition, professional\-service selling and marketplace growth** and is capable of independently developing a measurable international business pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and grow the company's presence across selected global freelance and professional\-service marketplaces.
* Identify high\-quality opportunities relevant to legal, corporate, regulatory, compliance and professional business services.
* Search, shortlist and prioritise suitable projects based on scope, commercial value, jurisdiction and internal capability.
* Prepare customised, persuasive and professional proposals instead of generic bidding templates.
* Manage Upwork agency operations, Fiverr service listings/gigs and other approved marketplace profiles.
* Optimise profiles, service descriptions, portfolios, keywords, packages and pricing.
* Conduct preliminary communication with prospective clients and understand their requirements.
* Coordinate discovery calls and transfer qualified opportunities to the appropriate internal professional/team.
* Prepare commercial quotations and scope summaries in coordination with management.
* Follow up systematically with prospects and maintain an organised sales pipeline.
* Develop strategies for improving proposal\-to\-interview and interview\-to\-client conversion rates.
* Monitor marketplace trends, competitors, pricing and client demand.
* Build repeat\-client and retainer opportunities from successfully completed assignments.
* Maintain records of leads, proposals, conversations, conversions, revenue and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate internally to collect suitable portfolios, credentials, case studies and service descriptions.
* Ensure all communications maintain the confidentiality and professional standards expected from legal and corporate service providers.
* Provide structured monthly reports on marketplace performance, leads, conversions, revenue and recommended improvements.

Major Service Areas

The candidate will primarily develop opportunities relating to:

* Commercial contracts and contract review
* Corporate and business advisory services
* Startup and business documentation
* Regulatory and compliance support
* Cross\-border business and regulatory research
* Legal research and professional outsourcing
* Intellectual property and brand\-protection support
* Employment and HR documentation
* Technology, privacy, data and digital\-business documentation
* Due diligence and corporate documentation
* Business setup and associated corporate services
* Other specialised professional services introduced by the company

The candidate is **not expected to independently provide legal opinions or legal advice**. Substantive professional work will be handled by the appropriate qualified team.

Required Skills

We are particularly looking for candidates with:

* Strong practical knowledge of **Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer or similar global marketplaces**
* Proven ability in online B2B lead generation and client acquisition
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Exceptional proposal and business\-writing skills
* Strong sales communication and follow\-up ability
* Ability to understand professional and technical service requirements quickly
* Client qualification and requirement\-analysis skills
* Negotiation and commercial communication skills
* Knowledge of profile and marketplace optimisation
* Basic understanding of SEO and keyword positioning
* CRM and sales\-pipeline management
* Research and competitor\-analysis capabilities
* Strong attention to detail
* Professional email and online meeting etiquette
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and modern productivity tools
* Ability to work independently in a target\-oriented hybrid environment
* High degree of confidentiality, accountability and ownership

Preferred Background

Candidates with previous experience in any of the following will have an advantage:

* Upwork/Fiverr business development
* Professional\-services sales
* Legal Process Outsourcing (LPO)
* Consulting or advisory firms
* Corporate\-service companies
* SaaS or technology\-service agencies
* Accounting, compliance or business\-consulting firms
* International B2B business development

Experience generating business for **legal, corporate, consulting or other knowledge\-based professional services** will be particularly valued.

What We Offer

* **Salary starting from ₹25,000 per month**
* Attractive performance\-linked incentives in addition to fixed salary
* Opportunity to earn significantly more based on successful business generation and performance
* Hybrid working arrangement
* Only 3 mandatory office\-reporting days per month, scheduled during the last week
* Option to work from the Aegis Riverfront office more frequently when preferred
* Exposure to international clients and cross\-border business opportunities
* Opportunity to work across legal, corporate, regulatory, technology and consulting sectors
* Direct interaction with management and professional teams
* Substantial ownership over the marketplace\-growth function
* Performance\-based career advancement
* Opportunity to build and eventually lead a dedicated marketplace/client\-acquisition team as the function grows
* Structured performance recognition and professional\-development opportunities

Who Should Apply?

Apply if you are someone who does not simply “submit bids”, but can understand:

**Which opportunity is worth pursuing → how the service should be positioned → how a proposal should be written → how the prospect should be approached → how the lead should be followed up → and how it can ultimately be converted into a long\-term client.**

We are looking for a person who treats marketplace acquisition as a **business\-development function with measurable revenue responsibility**.

Preliminary Application Questions

**1\. Marketplace Experience**  
Which platforms have you personally worked with—Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer or others? Briefly explain your role and the results you achieved, including leads, conversions or revenue wherever possible.

**2\. Practical Assessment**  
Suppose you identify an Upwork project requiring the review and redrafting of a commercial agreement for an international business client. Briefly explain how you would evaluate the opportunity and approach the client before submitting a proposal.

**3\. Performance \& Availability**  
Are you comfortable working in a performance\-oriented role involving measurable targets for qualified leads, proposals, conversions and business generated, and can you report physically to our Aegis Riverfront, Aluva office for a minimum of 3 days during the last week of every month?

Work Location

Hybrid – Aegis Riverfront, Aluva, Ernakulam, Kerala

Full\-Time

Compensation

**From ₹25,000 per month \+ attractive performance\-linked incentives**

5\. Training \& Development

6\. Exit \& Separation Management

* Manage employee resignation and exit formalities.
* Monitor notice periods and handover requirements.
* Conduct exit interviews where required.
* Ensure recovery of company assets.
* Coordinate final attendance and leave verification.
* Coordinate Full \& Final Settlement inputs with Accounts.

7\. Candidate ProfileEducational Qualification

Experience

* **5–8 years of relevant experience** in HR \& Administration.
* Experience in **automobile dealership, showroom, service center, retail, manufacturing or a similar operational environment** will be preferred.
* Candidates with experience handling both **HR and Admin functions** will be preferred.

**Job Title: HR Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations**

**Company:** Meadbery  
**Location:** Zirakpur, Punjab (On\-site)  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 5\+ years  
**Salary:** Based on experience (commensurate with market for the Tricity region)

**About Us**  
Meadbery is a fast\-growing D2C Ayurvedic wellness brand selling through our own website and Amazon India. As we scale, we're building our first dedicated in\-house HR function to support our growing telecalling and sales teams.

**Role Overview**  
We're hiring an HR Manager to independently own recruitment and HR operations for our Zirakpur office. This is a hands\-on role — you will personally source, screen, and close candidates, not just coordinate the process. The primary focus is high\-volume hiring for sales and telecalling roles, alongside day\-to\-day HR generalist responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Recruitment (Primary Focus)*

* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for telecalling and sales roles — sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer rollout, and joining
* Deliver high\-volume hiring on tight timelines using Naukri, Apna, Indeed, LinkedIn, and referral networks
* Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline/database specific to the Tricity (Chandigarh–Mohali–Panchkula) market
* Screen specifically for target\-driven role fit — not just communication skills, but resilience, consistency, and ability to sustain outbound call/sales volume
* Track and report real hiring metrics: joins vs. targets, offer\-to\-join ratio, and 90\-day retention

*HR Generalist / Operations*

* Manage onboarding, attendance, and payroll coordination for the Zirakpur team
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation
* Handle grievances, employee relations, and exit formalities
* Support HR policy implementation and basic compliance

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of HR experience, with demonstrated recruitment for sales, telecalling, or other high\-volume/target\-driven roles (not only corporate or technical hiring)
* Working knowledge of the Tricity job market — salary bands, effective sourcing channels, local candidate behavior
* Comfortable owning recruitment personally, end\-to\-end — this is not a coordination\-only or strategic\-advisory role
* Strong Excel/reporting skills for tracking hiring and HR metrics
* Immediate joiners or short notice period preferred

**What We're Not Looking For**

* Candidates whose recruitment background is exclusively IT/tech, corporate, or international (US/UK) hiring with no domestic sales\-hiring exposure
* Strategic HR leadership profiles looking for an advisory or policy\-design mandate
* Remote or hybrid seekers — this role is fully on\-site in Zirakpur

**Compensation Structure**

* Fixed salary based on genuine, verifiable experience
* Performance\-linked increment reviewed at a defined probation checkpoint, tied to actual hiring delivery (not activity alone)

**To Apply**  
Submit your resume along with specific numbers from your recruitment experience — roles closed per month, offer\-to\-join ratio, and candidate retention. Vague or unverifiable claims will not be shortlisted for interview.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

Application Question(s):

title: Senior Manager- People Operations
description:
**Company Summary**
 Irth Solutions is a PE\-backed global SaaS company and the leading platform for damage prevention and asset protection in the energy, utility, telecom, and media industries. With :350 employees across the US, Canada, and India, we help clients protect critical infrastructure through intelligent software that powers the entire damage prevention lifecycle. We're a scaling company with a builder's mindset — and we're looking for people who thrive in that environment
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We're hiring Senior Manager\- People Operations to own the operational backbone of our People \& Culture function. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has built and run people operations in complex, multi\-jurisdictional environments and knows what "good" looks like in payroll, benefits, and HRIS without needing it to be handed to them. This role is based in our Pune, India office and operates on US business hours to support our North American employee population. You'll lead a team of two direct reports and report directly to the Chief People \& Culture Officer. If you're looking for a role where you can build infrastructure that actually matters and see your impact in real time, this is it.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What You'll Own**
**Payroll**
* Own end\-to\-end US payroll processing (semi\-monthly) for :300\+ employees across multiple states, with hands\-on accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and compliance
* Manage Canadian payroll operations across multiple provinces, including Quebec — navigating jurisdiction\-specific deductions, tax filing, and regulatory requirements
* Partner with Finance on payroll accounting, GL reconciliation, and audit readiness
* Lead remediation and ongoing maintenance of multi\-state payroll tax registrations, including proactive identification and resolution of tax ID gaps in Rippling
* Stay current on federal, state/provincial, and local payroll compliance changes across all operating jurisdictions


**Benefits Administration**
* Own US benefits program design and administration, including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, 401(k), life, and ancillary lines
* Manage open enrollment end\-to\-end — plan selection, carrier coordination, employee communications, and system configuration in Rippling
* Lead broker relationship and serve as the primary point of contact for carriers and TPAs
* Ensure ACA compliance, reporting, and filing (1094/1095\-C)
* Support Canada benefits strategy in partnership with local HR resources (Pune/India ancillary benefits as applicable)


**HRIS — Rippling**
* Serve as the system owner and subject matter expert for Rippling across all modules: payroll, benefits, PTO, headcount, and integrations
* Own data integrity, configuration, workflows, and role\-based access
* Lead HRIS optimization initiatives — building automation, improving self\-service, and reducing manual lift across the People team
* Manage Rippling\-to\-Intacct integration, including issue escalation and resolution with vendor support
* Partner with Finance and IT on system governance, data validation, and new module rollouts


**People Operations \& Compliance**
* Directly manage and develop two People Operations team members — setting priorities, building capability, and creating a high\-performing team culture
* Develop and maintain HR policies across US and Canada jurisdictions, ensuring alignment with applicable employment law
* Support BYOD compliance framework, records retention, and HR audit readiness across US, Canada, and India
* Manage unemployment claims, leave administration (FMLA, state leaves, parental), and workers' compensation programs
* Comfortable working US business hours from Pune — this is a firm requirement given the payroll and benefits support model for our North American workforce


**What You Bring**
* 7\+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or a directly equivalent function — with demonstrated ownership of payroll and benefits, not just advisory support
* Prior experience managing direct reports with a track record of developing team members and driving accountability
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience in both the US (multi\-state) and Canada (multi province) — this is a hard requirement
* Deep Rippling expertise; you can configure it, troubleshoot it, and train others on it
* Strong knowledge of US payroll tax compliance, benefits regulations (ACA, ERISA, COBRA), and Canadian payroll and employment standards
* Familiarity with Quebec\-specific requirements (Law 25, CNESST, provincial payroll nuances) is a meaningful plus
* Experience operating in a PE\-backed, high\-growth, or scaling SaaS environment — you know how to move fast with evolving structure
* Exceptional attention to detail combined with an ability to zoom out and see the system level picture
* Strong cross\-functional communication skills — you can translate payroll and compliance complexity for Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders
* A builder's mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with India\-based payroll or HR coordination (particularly in Pune/Maharashtra)
* Familiarity with SR\&ED tax credits or other Canadian R\&D incentive programs
* CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) or equivalent certification
* Experience with equity/stock plan administration or MIP/bonus program operationalization
* Prior experience managing an RPO or staffing partner relationship


**EDUCATION**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance/Accounting, or a related field


**Benefits**
**What We Offer**
* Be part of a dynamic and growing company that is well\-respected in its industry
* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
* Health Insurance coverage

description: Career Category Sales \& Marketing Operations Job Description Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do. Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives. Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. What you will do Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Associate, Field Reporting will provide hands\-on technical and operational support for field and leadership reporting. The role will help develop, enhance, validate, refresh, and release dashboards that enable field representatives and leaders to understand targets, execution, customer engagement, sales performance, and business trends. This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and works across business reporting, technical reporting, iDNA/data\-management, Incentive Compensation, Field Effectiveness, analytics, and field teams. The role supports reporting platforms such as Vision and Gateway and follows an agile, Jira\-based delivery model. Responsibilities Dashboard Development and Enhancements Build and enhance Tableau dashboards and report tabs using approved requirements, mockups, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Configure KPIs, calculations, filters, hierarchies, navigation, customer and geography views, and other user\-facing report features. Support minor and major enhancements, including new metrics, source changes, field\-force changes, visual redesigns, and new\-report development. Reporting Operations and Release Management Execute scheduled test refreshes, production refreshes, quality checks, approvals, and releases for assigned Vision and Gateway reports. Monitor refreshes and report availability, investigate failures or anomalies, implement approved fixes, and communicate status within agreed service levels. Support quarterly switchovers, report archival, server or platform maintenance, and other recurring reporting\-operations activities. Data Validation and Quality Control Validate dashboard outputs against approved business rules, source data, analytical benchmarks, and acceptance criteria. Perform unit, functional, regression, and data\-quality checks across calculations, filters, access controls, layouts, and user personas. Document validation evidence, defects, root\-cause findings, fixes, and release sign\-offs to support quality, governance, and audit readiness. Requirements and Field Support Support assessment of reporting requests by clarifying the business objective, users, KPIs, data needs, dependencies, priority, and acceptance criteria. Contribute to report mockups, technical designs, data\-requirement documentation, effort estimates, and implementation plans under the guidance of reporting leads. Respond to routine field and stakeholder questions, investigate data or dashboard inquiries, and provide clear resolutions or escalations. Sprint Delivery and Issue Management Maintain accurate Jira tickets, including requirements, acceptance criteria, development details, estimates, dependencies, testing evidence, and status. Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily coordination, demonstrations, and retrospectives for assigned work. Identify delivery risks early, coordinate across business and technical partners, and drive assigned issues and action items through timely closure. Access, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement Process assigned user\-access and exception requests and validate that report access is limited to approved business scope and user personas. Follow approved development, release, access\-control, documentation, and data\-handling processes. Identify opportunities to improve dashboard performance, simplify recurring operations, strengthen controls, and automate repeatable validation or refresh activities. Cross\-Functional Collaboration Partner with Field Effectiveness, Incentive Compensation, analytics, iDNA/data\-management, cross\-system operations, and field stakeholders to deliver end\-to\-end reporting changes. Coordinate data dependencies, UAT readiness, feedback, and production\-release activities with business and technical partners. Communicate progress, decisions, risks, and support needs clearly to stakeholders across geographies and levels. What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Basic Qualifications Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 1 \- 3 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, dashboard development, commercial reporting, and/or sales operations. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the bio/pharmaceutical or healthcare industry. Hands\-on experience developing and supporting Tableau dashboards; exposure to enterprise reporting portals is preferred. Ability to write SQL queries, assess data requirements, reconcile outputs, and investigate data issues; familiarity with Databricks or comparable data platforms is helpful. Strong understanding of data visualization, dashboard usability, calculations, filters, geographic hierarchies, and role\-based access. Experience with commercial data such as sales, activity, targets, goals, customer/account, claims, and engagement data. Experience working in agile delivery models and using Jira or similar tools for backlog, sprint, issue, and release management. Strong quality\-control discipline, attention to detail, and ability to document testing evidence and communicate defects clearly. Effective written and verbal communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. What you can expect of us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way. In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards. Equal Opportunity and Accommodation As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed, and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. .

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.

title: Associate - ENR (Capital Projects) CoE
description:
**ABOUT US:**








  




 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change\-makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.
 




  






**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**





  






 This is an opportunity to be part of Bain’s Capital Projects Center of Expertise (CoE), based out of the Gurugram office, specifically supporting Bain’s Capital Projects \& Infrastructure practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The Capital Projects CoE works across major capital programs spanning energy, infrastructure, transport, oil \& gas, power \& utilities, mining and large industrial build\-outs.
 





 As part of the Capital Projects team, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for clients executing large, complex capital programs. The primary objective is to collaborate with practice and case teams on the development and deployment of project\-controls, PMO and digital capabilities that answer strategic questions for Bain’s capital\-intensive clients — from project setup and assurance through delivery and turnaround.
 





 An Associate works as a team member / contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback and progressively take on greater ownership of workstreams.
 








  




**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**






  
 



* **Day\-to\-day management of 2\-3 team members**


* Lead a small team of Analysts and Jr. Associates, owning day\-to\-day delivery with limited PL/Manager oversight
* Understand and translate the client's context and business problem into a clear, prioritized work plan
* Create the work plan, provide guidance to junior team members, and review outputs to ensure high\-quality delivery to clients
* Anticipate roadblocks, resolve them at source, and escalate early when needed


* **Program governance \& PMO operations**


* Design and stand up PMO operating models — stage\-gate governance, change control, RACI, decision logs, escalation paths — and assess the robustness of a client's existing setup
* Build and interrogate the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS): run critical\-path, what\-if, and schedule\-compression analyses that underpin recommendations


* **Cost \& performance controls**


* Build cost\-control and Earned Value analyses (budget phasing, CPI/SPI, forecast\-at\-completion, variance) to pinpoint where a program is over budget or behind schedule
* Create executive\-ready dashboards that give client leadership a decision\-grade view of project health


* **Risk \& safety management**


* Build the analytical backbone for risk reviews — risk registers, quantified mitigations, contingency strategies — and turn findings into recommendations the team can land with the client


* **Digital \& advanced analytics**


* Shape the digital roadmap and success metrics for client programs, including 5D BIM (cost \+ schedule) and model\-based quantity management
* Apply advanced scheduling and risk analytics — constraint\-based planning, scenario simulation, Monte Carlo — to quantify outcomes and de\-risk recommendations
* Build Power BI / Tableau control towers and pilot AI tools that speed delivery and leave the client with reusable assets



  






**ABOUT YOU:**











* Relevant experience of 2\-5 years for undergraduates and 0\-3 years for postgraduates from a top\-tier college with a strong academic record and 3\-4 years of relevant experience in capital projects, project controls, PMO or management consulting
* PMP® certification or active progress toward it is an advantage (not mandatory at this level)
* Hands\-on with at least 2–3 of: Project controls, P6/MS Project, Power BI/Tableau, BIM (Navisworks/Revit/Synchro), EVM, ALICE – Generative Scheduling, AI tools
* Strong analytical, MS Office, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-player skills; able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure




  
 





**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**





  






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

**Terms**

 \- Create user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes in Figma.

 Apply through LinkedIn using the Easy Apply button on this post. Please include a link to your portfolio or your best work with your application. We review every application and will contact shortlisted candidates through LinkedIn.

**Company:** Elite Butlers Hospitality Solutions  

**Location:** RPS 12th Avenue, Faridabad, Delhi NCR  

**Work Mode:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  

**Experience:** 10\+ years preferred  

**Team:** India \& UAE \| Currently \~15 members, expanding further


### **About the Role**


Elite Butlers Hospitality Solutions is looking for an experienced and highly capable **Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations** to lead and strengthen our recruitment delivery across India and the UAE.


The role will oversee a growing team of recruiters and support functions while personally leading **senior and critical mandates for HNI/UHNI families, private residences, family offices, luxury hospitality and corporate clients**.


We are looking for someone who combines **strong recruitment expertise, team leadership, client management and operational discipline**.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage a **15\+ member recruitment/operations team** across India and UAE, with the ability to scale the function to 20–30\+ members.
* Allocate and prioritise mandates based on urgency, business value and recruiter capability.
* Conduct **first/second\-level interviews** and quality checks before senior candidates are presented to clients.
* Personally manage critical and senior\-level mandates.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality profiles and improve closure ratios.
* Conduct daily/weekly reviews covering mandates, pipelines, interviews, offers, joining and revenue.
* Coach recruiters on sourcing, interviewing, candidate presentation, negotiation and client handling.
* Coordinate closely with the **CRM/client servicing team** from requirement initiation through closure.
* Join client calls/meetings where senior intervention is required.
* Understand client requirements and convert them into clear recruitment strategies.
* Monitor proposals, commercials, engagement terms, invoices and payment follow\-ups in coordination with the relevant teams.
* Manage candidate negotiations, counter\-offers, notice periods and joining challenges.
* Ensure proper use of **ATS/CRM/HRMS**, accurate data and recruitment reporting.
* Develop recruitment SOPs, productivity benchmarks and quality standards.
* Support hiring, induction and development of new recruiters as the team expands.
* Oversee recruitment delivery across multiple locations/offices as the company grows.

### **Candidate Profile**


We are ideally looking for someone with:


* **10\+ years of recruitment/Talent Acquisition experience**
* Previous experience managing approximately **10–20 recruiters/team members**
* Strong exposure to **hospitality, HNI/UHNI recruitment, private staffing, executive search or luxury services**
* Experience handling senior and confidential mandates
* Excellent interviewing and candidate\-assessment skills
* Strong client\-facing and commercial understanding
* Experience using ATS/CRM/HRMS platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong Excel/reporting and digital skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment

The person should be **smart, polished, well\-presented, commercially aware and comfortable interacting with senior candidates, HNI/UHNI clients and business leaders.**


### **What Success Looks Like**


The person should bring **structure, accountability and quality** to the entire TA operation, ensuring recruiters are productive, mandates move within defined timelines, clients receive strong profiles, senior positions receive personal attention, and the recruitment function scales without compromising service standards.


There is significant scope for this position to grow into **Manager / Senior Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations**, with responsibility for multiple teams and locations across India, UAE and other international markets.

* Monitor CIP (Cleaning\-in\-Place) activities and ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of processing equipment.

* **Quality \& Process Control**
* Monitor raw milk and finished product parameters as per approved specifications.
* Ensure proper sampling and testing at different stages of processing.
* Identify process deviations and take corrective action in consultation with the concerned department.
* Maintain process records, production reports and checklists.
* **Food Safety \& Hygiene**
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GHP, HACCP, FSSC 22000/ISO requirements and company food safety procedures.
* Monitor personal hygiene, equipment hygiene and production\-area sanitation.
* Report any contamination risk, abnormal condition or food safety concern immediately.
* **Equipment \& Process Monitoring**
* Monitor the performance of pasteurizers, homogenizers, separators, milk tanks, pipelines, pumps and other processing equipment.
* Report equipment abnormalities to the Maintenance Department.
* Ensure proper start\-up, shutdown and changeover procedures.
* **Documentation \& Reporting**
* Maintain daily processing, temperature, CIP, production and deviation records.
* Prepare shift\-wise production and process reports.
* Ensure traceability and proper documentation of batches.
* **Coordination**
* Coordinate with Quality Control, Production, Maintenance, Utilities, Stores and Dispatch departments.
* Support trials, new product development and process improvement activities.
* Assist in internal, customer and certification audits.

Qualifications

* **B.Sc. Dairy Technology / B.Tech Dairy Technology / B.Sc. Food Technology / B.Tech Food Technology** or equivalent.
* Relevant experience in a dairy/milk processing plant will be preferred.

Experience

* **1–3 years** of experience in milk processing/dairy production preferred.
* Freshers with relevant dairy/food technology qualifications may also be considered.

title: Multiunit Operations Manager - US Businesses
description:
Multiunit Operations Manager – US Businesses

Company: Vishram Management Group (VMG)

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat – Work From Office

Shift: Night Shift (U.S. Business Hours)

Experience: 7\+ years preferred

Industry Preference: Retail / Supermarket / QSR / Multi\-Location Business

\#About the Role

Vishram Management Group is shifting its global backend operations to its Ahmedabad office and is looking for a strong Multiunit Operations Manager to take complete ownership of the India backend operation.

This person will act as the single point of contact between U.S. leadership and the India team, ensuring that Accounting, HR, Marketing, and Technology functions operate efficiently, meet deadlines, and support the performance of our U.S. businesses.

We're looking for someone with a retail business management background who has managed operations beyond the store level — including accounting oversight, HR, marketing, reporting, systems, and team management.

\#Functions You Will Oversee

You will directly manage and hold accountable:

\- Marketing Center of Excellence

\- VMG Human Resources

\- Accounting Teams – Vishram Group

\- Technology / IT Manager

\- Backend Business Operations \& Reporting

\# Key Responsibilities

Business Operations

\- Take complete ownership of VMG's Ahmedabad backend operation

\- Act as the primary point of contact for U.S. management

\- Convert management priorities into clear tasks, deadlines, KPIs, and accountability

\- Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews with department managers

\- Identify problems before they reach senior management and drive them to resolution

\- Build SOPs, workflows, reporting systems, and accountability structures

Accounting \& Financial Oversight

\- Oversee accounting teams supporting the Vishram group of businesses

\- Review AP, AR, bank reconciliations, cash flow, expenses, and management reports

\- Monitor P\&L performance, unusual expenses, overdue receivables, and financial discrepancies

\- Ensure accounting information is accurate and delivered to management on time

\- Work with operations to identify cost savings and improve profitability

HR \& People Management

\- Manage the VMG HR Manager and ensure recruitment requirements are completed on time

\- Oversee attendance, productivity, performance management, onboarding, and employee accountability

\- Ensure department managers meet staffing and performance expectations

\- Develop a performance\-driven culture within the India office

Marketing Center of Excellence

\- Oversee the Marketing Manager and marketing team

\- Ensure marketing activities connect to measurable business results

\- Review campaign execution, social media, digital marketing, promotions, and reporting

\- Hold the marketing team accountable for deadlines, KPIs, and quality of execution

Technology \& Systems

\- Manage the Technology Manager and ensure reliable support for U.S. operations

\- Oversee business systems, user access, technology issues, automation, and process improvements

\- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive backend work and improve efficiency

\# What We're Looking For

Candidates should have experience from retail, supermarket, QSR, franchise, hospitality retail, or another multi\-location business, with an understanding of how different departments drive profitability together.

Relevant experience areas include:

\- Multi\-location retail/business operations

\- Team and department management

\- Accounting and P\&L oversight

\- AP/AR and financial reporting

\- HR and recruitment management

\- Marketing oversight

\- Business technology and systems

\- SOP and workflow development

\- KPI and performance management

\- Cost control and profitability improvement

This is not a coordinator or administrative position. We need a hands\-on business operator who can independently manage multiple departments, hold managers accountable, solve problems, and give U.S. leadership one clear point of accountability.

\# Success in This Role

You'll know you're succeeding when:

\- U.S. leadership doesn't need to follow up with multiple India departments

\- Accounting and management reports are accurate and on time

\- HR positions are filled and employee issues are handled promptly

\- Marketing projects are executed on schedule and measured against results

\- Technology issues are resolved quickly

\- Department managers are held accountable to KPIs

\- Processes become more organized, automated, and scalable

\- The Ahmedabad office operates as a true backend operations center for VMG's global businesses

\# Benefits \& Perks

✅ Paid Annual Leave \& Public Holidays

✅ Comprehensive Health Insurance

✅ Company\-Matched SIP Investment Program

✅ Performance\-Based Incentives \& Career Growth

✅ Milestone Rewards \& Recognition Programs

✅ International Career \& Transfer Opportunities

✅ Professional Learning, Training \& Skill Development

* Health insurance
