title: Centre Head
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – CENTRE HEAD**

**Location:** Calicut, Kerala  
**Department:** Centre Operations / Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Aviation \& Education / Training  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director/ Director/GM

**1\. Job Summary**

The Centre Head will be responsible for the **overall management and performance of the Calicut Centre**, including admissions, sales, academic coordination, staff management, administration, student services, revenue generation, and day\-to\-day centre operations.

The role requires a strong combination of **leadership, business development, people management, customer relationship management, and operational skills** to ensure that the centre achieves its admission and revenue targets while maintaining high standards of student service and academic delivery.

**2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Centre Operations**

* Manage the overall day\-to\-day operations of the Calicut Centre.
* Ensure smooth and professional functioning of all departments.
* Implement company policies, procedures, and operational standards.
* Monitor centre discipline, punctuality, attendance, cleanliness, and infrastructure.
* Ensure proper maintenance of centre records, registers, reports, and documentation.
* Coordinate with Head Office and senior management regarding centre\-related matters.

**B. Admissions \& Business Development**

* Take overall responsibility for achieving monthly and annual admission targets.
* Monitor enquiries, leads, follow\-ups, counselling, conversions, and admissions.
* Guide and monitor Counsellors, BDEs, Telecallers, and other admission team members.
* Develop local marketing and promotional activities to generate enquiries.
* Monitor competitor activities and market trends in the Calicut area.
* Build relationships with schools, colleges, companies, agencies, and other potential referral partners.
* Review daily and monthly admission performance and take corrective action where required.

**C. Revenue \& Financial Performance**

* Monitor centre revenue and collection performance.
* Ensure timely fee collection and proper follow\-up of outstanding payments.
* Monitor centre expenses and ensure effective utilisation of resources.
* Prepare and submit revenue, admission, collection, and expense reports to management.
* Work towards achieving the centre's profitability and business objectives.

**D. Staff Management**

* Lead, supervise, and motivate the entire Calicut Centre team.
* Monitor staff performance against assigned KPIs and targets.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
* Identify training and development requirements of employees.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct among staff.
* Coordinate with HR regarding recruitment, attendance, leave, performance issues, and employee\-related matters.
* Ensure proper allocation of duties and responsibilities among team members.

**E. Academic Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Academic Head and faculty regarding class schedules and academic activities.
* Monitor faculty attendance, student attendance, timetable, and academic discipline.
* Ensure students receive proper academic support and guidance.
* Address student and parent concerns in coordination with the Academic Department.
* Monitor student feedback and take appropriate corrective action.

**F. Student \& Parent Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong professional relationships with students and parents.
* Handle escalated student/parent complaints and concerns.
* Ensure timely resolution of service\-related issues.
* Monitor student satisfaction and retention.
* Ensure proper follow\-up of dropouts, transfers, refunds, and other student\-related matters as per company policy.

**G. Reporting \& Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly centre performance reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators including:
* Enquiries
* Counselling
* Admissions
* Conversion ratio
* Revenue
* Fee collection
* Dropouts
* Staff performance
* Student strength
* Student satisfaction
* Present centre performance and action plans to senior management.

H. Compliance \& Administration

* Ensure compliance with company policies and management instructions.
* Maintain proper documentation and records.
* Ensure the centre is maintained in a professional, safe, and customer\-friendly condition.
* Coordinate with HR, Accounts, Academic, Marketing, and other departments whenever required.
* Ensure all management instructions are implemented within the centre.

3\. Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in **Business Administration, Management, Aviation, Hospitality, Education, or a related field**.
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.

4\. Experience

* **Minimum 8 \+ years of relevant experience**, preferably in:
* Education / Training
* Aviation / Hospitality
* Sales \& Business Development
* Customer Service
* Branch / Centre Management
* Previous experience as **Centre Head, Branch Manager, Sales Manager, Operations Manager, Admissions Manager, or similar leadership position** will be preferred.
* Experience in handling admission targets and a sales\-oriented team will be an advantage.

**5\. Required Skills**

* Strong leadership and team\-management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong sales and business development skills.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Good negotiation and counselling skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Customer relationship management skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, Google Workspace, and reporting systems.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and work under targets.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Centre Head will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly and annual admission achievement.
* Revenue and fee collection.
* Lead\-to\-admission conversion.
* Team performance and productivity.
* Student retention and dropout control.
* Customer/student satisfaction.
* Staff discipline and attendance.
* Centre operational efficiency.
* Local marketing and business development activities.
* Timely submission and accuracy of reports.

7\. Personal Attributes

The ideal candidate should be:

* Professional and presentable.
* Highly responsible and accountable.
* Confident in handling teams and customers.
* Proactive and target\-oriented.
* Good at building relationships.
* Capable of handling pressure and resolving operational issues.
* Willing to take ownership of the overall centre performance.

title: HR Business Partner – People & Culture | Hyderabad
description:
**People Are at the Heart of Impact.**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, our work is about creating opportunities for young people.**

**But sustainable impact doesn't happen without the people behind it.**

Great Centre Heads.  
Committed facilitators.  
Passionate outreach teams.  
Strong program leaders.  
People who show up every day because they believe the work matters.

**We're looking for an HR Business Partner who can help these people thrive.**

This is a hands\-on, field\-facing HR role where you'll work closely with leaders and teams across Hyderabad, understand what is happening on the ground, solve people challenges, strengthen HR practices, and help build a culture where employees can do their best work.

If you see HR as more than policies and processes — and believe that **strong people practices create stronger social impact** — this could be your opportunity.

**About Lighthouse Communities Foundation**

**Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF)** works in the areas of skilling, employability, and livelihoods for underserved youth.

Our Lighthouse model brings together **Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Communities** through a Public\-Private Partnership to create sustainable pathways towards employment and socio\-economic transformation.

Our centres are built around collaboration — with different stakeholders contributing resources, expertise, networks, and capabilities to help young people access better opportunities.

**Our work is guided by:**

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

**Your Role: Be the Bridge Between People \& Purpose**

As an HR Business Partner, you'll partner with regional leadership, Centre Heads, program teams, and employees to make sure our people practices support both **employee experience and organisational outcomes**.

You'll work across:

**Hiring → Onboarding → Development → Performance → Employee Relations → Culture → Organisational Growth**

And because our teams work across centres and communities, this is a **field\-facing HR role**.

You won't just hear about people challenges in meetings.

**You'll go where the teams are. Listen. Understand. Solve. Build.**

**What You Will Do**

**Partner With Leaders \& Teams**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across the assigned region.
* Partner with Centre Heads and program leaders on people\-related matters.
* Understand team dynamics, people challenges, and organisational needs.
* Provide practical HR guidance to managers and employees.
* Coach leaders on people management and employee\-related issues.
* Ensure HR support is timely, accessible, and solution\-oriented.

**Build Teams That Can Deliver Impact**

**Great programs need great people.**

**You'll support the complete employee journey, including:**

* Recruitment coordination.
* Candidate screening.
* Interview processes.
* Offer and joining coordination.
* Employee onboarding.
* New\-hire orientation.
* Early\-stage employee support.

**You'll work closely with hiring managers and central HR to ensure we bring in people who are not only capable, but also aligned with our values and mission.**

**Help People Grow**

* Partner with central HR teams to implement learning and development initiatives.
* Identify capability\-building needs across teams.
* Support training and development programs.
* Encourage a culture of continuous learning.
* Work with managers to identify development opportunities for their teams.

**Make Performance Management Meaningful**

**Performance management should be more than an annual form.**

**You'll support managers and employees with:**

* Goal setting.
* Performance reviews.
* Development planning.
* Regular feedback.
* Performance conversations.
* Capability\-building interventions.
* Performance improvement processes where required.

**The goal is to create clarity, accountability, and growth — while ensuring performance practices are fair and aligned with organisational expectations.**

**Support Employee Relations**

* Serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers.
* Listen to employee concerns and help identify appropriate solutions.
* Support resolution of workplace issues in a fair and timely manner.
* Help managers navigate sensitive people situations.
* Promote a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Ensure organisational policies and processes are understood and followed.

**Strengthen HR Practices Across Centres**

**Our teams work across different centres and communities.**

**You'll help ensure consistency while remaining sensitive to local realities.**

**This includes:**

* Implementing HR policies and processes.
* Supporting compliance requirements.
* Ensuring employees understand relevant policies.
* Identifying gaps in HR processes.
* Working with central HR to improve employee experience.
* Ensuring HR practices are aligned with organisational goals, values, and requirements.

**Use Data to Understand People**

**Good HR decisions need more than intuition.**

**You'll:**

* Monitor HR metrics and trends.
* Track hiring, onboarding, retention, performance, and other relevant people indicators.
* Identify patterns and areas requiring attention.
* Generate insights for leadership.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve HR effectiveness.

The question isn't just:

**“What is the number?”**

It's:

**“What is the number telling us about our people?”**

Be Present Where the Work Happens

This role involves **up to 70% travel across centres in the assigned region**.

**You'll spend significant time with teams on the ground, building relationships, understanding local realities, and providing hands\-on HR support.**

**If you're someone who enjoys being close to the action rather than spending every day behind a desk, you'll enjoy this role.**

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration**, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.

Experience

* **3–4 years of HR experience**.
* Experience in areas such as:
* Talent acquisition
* Employee relations
* Performance management
* Learning \& development
* People management
* Organisational development

**Experience in a nonprofit, social\-impact, education, skilling, or field\-based organisation is an advantage.**

**Communication**

* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across different roles and backgrounds.
* Strong listening, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If...**

**You're someone who:**

* Sees HR as a business and people partner — not just a process owner.
* Is comfortable having difficult conversations with empathy and clarity.
* Can coach a manager through a people problem rather than simply quoting policy.
* Enjoys meeting people where they work.
* Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and operational problem\-solving.
* Is curious about what is happening on the ground.
* Can work with people from very different backgrounds and roles.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can work independently and take ownership.
* Believes that inclusion is something you **build into everyday decisions**, not just something you write in a policy.
* Is genuinely motivated by the idea that better people practices can lead to better outcomes for young people.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In this role, success isn't simply:**

**“HR processes were completed.”**

It's when:

* The right people are hired at the right time.
* New employees feel welcomed and supported.
* Managers become stronger people leaders.
* Employees know what is expected of them.
* Performance conversations happen with clarity and fairness.
* Teams feel heard and supported.
* People challenges are addressed before they become organisational problems.
* Employees have opportunities to learn and grow.
* HR data helps leaders make better decisions.
* And ultimately, our teams are better equipped to create impact for young people.

**Why Join Lighthouse?**

**Build the People Behind the Impact**

**At Lighthouse, you'll get the opportunity to work at the intersection of:**

**People \+ Purpose \+ Field Operations \+ Organisational Development**

You'll work with diverse teams, engage with leaders across centres, and experience the realities of building people systems in a growing social\-impact organisation.

You'll also be part of an organisation where our values matter:

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

Because creating opportunities for young people starts with creating an environment where the people doing the work can **learn, grow, contribute, and thrive.**

Ready to Build the People Behind the Mission?

If you're an HR professional who wants to move beyond transactional HR and become a genuine **people partner**, we'd love to hear from you.

### **Job Description**


ABOUT XENONSTACK  

XenonStack is a Data and AI Foundry for Agentic Systems, enabling enterprises to design, deploy, operate, and scale intelligent agents across digital and physical environments.  

We build enterprise\-grade platforms across the agentic stack:  

Akira AI \- Reasoning and agent orchestration. Turn models into collaborative, policy\-governed agents that learn and act together.  

ElixirData \- Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision\-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes.  

NexaStack \- Agentic infrastructure automation. Secure, compliant AI deployment across cloud, edge, and on\-prem.  

MetaSecure \- Trust, compliance and defense. Continuous assurance with AI\-BOMs, risk scoring, and agentic security.  

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI \+ Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise\-ready.  

WHO WE BUILD FOR  

We work directly with enterprise customers who are building AI \- across every industry. Because the platforms are our own, we sit with their CTOs, CDOs and Heads of AI on how AI actually gets built, deployed and scaled inside their business, not as an outside advisor but as the team behind the platform.  

THE OPPORTUNITY  

We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to own end\-to\-end recruitment across engineering and go\-to\-market roles. You will hire AI engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, and enterprise sales talent \- roles where the candidate pool is small, the bar is high, and the best people are not applying to job boards.  

This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will source, screen, schedule, and close. You will not be handed a pipeline.  

ROLE MISSION  

Build a repeatable hiring engine that consistently delivers qualified technical and GTM talent, with short cycle times and offers that stick.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  

1\. Sourcing and Pipeline Building  

* Build target candidate lists using LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, GitHub, and direct outreach
* Write and refine Boolean searches for technical skill sets
* Run proactive outreach to passive candidates, not just inbound applications
* Maintain a warm pipeline for recurring roles

  

2\. Screening and Evaluation  

* Run structured screening calls against a defined rubric
* Assess technical candidates on fundamentals, project depth, and problem\-solving approach


\- Verify claims on the resume \- tenure, scope, and numbers \- before advancing anyone  

* Write clear, decision\-ready summaries for hiring managers and leadership

  

3\. Process and Coordination  

* Own the candidate journey end to end: first call through joining
* Schedule and coordinate rounds with founders, engineering leads, and business heads


\- Keep every record current in Zoho Recruit \- candidate ID, role, round, date, outcome  

* Drive every stage to an action or a status update within one business day

  

4\. Offers and Closing  

* Run compensation conversations early and honestly, within defined bands
* Manage the offer\-to\-joining window actively to prevent drop\-offs
* Conduct background verification before rounds are scheduled

  

5\. Reporting and Improvement  

* Track time\-to\-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and drop\-off reasons
* Flag where the funnel is breaking and propose fixes
* Improve job descriptions and screening questions based on what the pipeline actually returns

  

HOW WE WORK WITH AI  

AI is part of the daily workflow here, not an add\-on. In this role you are expected to:  

* Use AI tools for resume screening, candidate research, outreach drafting, and summarising interviews


\- Know where they get it wrong \- every AI\-assisted rejection needs a named human reviewer  

* Build reusable prompts and workflows the team can adopt

  

Come ready to talk about what is in your AI stack and how you verify its output. We will ask.  

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE* Consistent monthly closures across engineering and GTM roles
* A live pipeline for recurring roles, not a fresh start every requisition
* Hiring managers get decision\-ready summaries, not resume forwards
* Offer acceptance above 85%, with drop\-offs understood and reduced

  

HOW WE WORK  

We value deep work, clarity, and execution over activity. You will be expected to clarify, plan, execute, and escalate with options \- not wait to be told. Ownership sits with the individual, and outcomes are measured, not effort.  

OUR VALUES  

Agency \- Be self\-directed and proactive  


Taste \- Sweat the details and build with precision  


Ownership \- Take responsibility for outcomes  


Mastery \- Commit to continuous learning and growth  


Impatience \- Move fast and challenge inertia  


Customer Obsession \- Always put the customer first  

WHY JOIN US  

Hire for the frontier \- Recruit the people building agentic AI platforms, not generic IT roles  


Real ownership \- You own the function, not a slice of it  


AI\-first environment \- Work alongside the products you are helping staff  


Leadership access \- Work directly with the MD and CISO on every senior hire  


Great Place to Work\-Certified \- 14\+ years, based in Mohali  

LOCATION AND WORK MODE  

On\-site \- Mohali, Punjab (Sector 75, STPI)  


Shift: General  


Full\-time, in\-office role.### **Requirements**


MUST\-HAVE* 3\+ years in talent acquisition, with at least 1 year hiring technical roles


\- Demonstrated ability to source independently \- not dependent on vendors or consultants  

* Hands\-on with LinkedIn, Naukri, and at least one ATS
* Ability to screen a technical candidate credibly without being an engineer yourself
* Clear written communication; you can summarise a candidate in five lines
* Real numbers on your own closures, offer acceptance, and time\-to\-hire

  

GOOD\-TO\-HAVE* Hiring for AI/ML, data, or cloud engineering roles
* Experience with Zoho Recruit
* Exposure to product or startup environments where roles change quickly
* Boolean and GitHub sourcing
* MBA in HR or equivalent

We are looking for an HR leader who believes that strong business performance starts with a strong, stable, and motivated workforce.


This is not just a routine HR administration role. We are looking for someone who can understand people, analyse data, improve retention, and build HR systems that deliver measurable business results.


If you enjoy solving workforce challenges, reducing attrition, improving productivity, and introducing practical HR best practices, this opportunity could be the right next step for you.


Your Mission


Build a workforce that stays longer, performs better, and contributes more.


You will be responsible for strengthening HR practices across staff and workers, improving employee retention, and using HR analytics to understand the real business impact of manpower investment.


What You Will Drive


1\. Employee Retention \& Engagement


Identify the real reasons behind staff and worker attrition.
  

Develop practical strategies to improve retention and employee satisfaction.
  

Strengthen onboarding, engagement, grievance handling, and exit\-feedback systems.
  

Build a workplace culture that encourages employees to stay and grow.


2\. HR Analytics \& Workforce ROI


Develop meaningful HR dashboards and workforce KPIs.
  

Analyse manpower cost, productivity, absenteeism, overtime, attrition, and workforce output.
  

Measure the effectiveness and ROI of HR initiatives.
  

Convert HR data into practical recommendations for management.


3\. Strategic HR Systems

Strengthen performance management, competency development, and career progression.
  

Support manpower planning, succession planning, and leadership development.
  

Align HR initiatives with business and operational goals.

Understand and address challenges related to shifts, absenteeism, productivity, and labour stability.
  

Implement practical HR solutions at the ground level.
  

Build stronger coordination between HR, management, and employees.


5\. HR Best Practices \& Continuous Improvement


Benchmark relevant HR practices from reputed spinning mills and textile manufacturing companies.
  

Introduce suitable systems for retention, engagement, productivity, and workforce management.
  

Continuously improve HR processes through data, feedback, and measurable outcomes.
   

Who We Are Looking For


A strategic, analytical, and hands\-on HR professional who can go beyond traditional HR administration.


You should have:


10\+ years of progressive HR experience, preferably in manufacturing, textiles, spinning mills, or other labour\-intensive industries.
  

Strong understanding of strategic HR, employee retention, HR analytics, and workforce productivity.
  

Experience in implementing HR systems and improving employee engagement.

title: Energy Manager
description:
Smart Joules

  
* Hyderabad, Telangana, India
* Permanent
* Operations
Job Description:
As an Energy Manager in SmartJoules, you will monitor and manage the energy efficiency of the facility. You will also implement energy conservation measures and monitor the energy consumption, evaluate business decisions for sustainability, and look for ways to improve energy efficiency. This is a role that will help shape the company's path to achieving our vision of efficiently managing the largest number of Joules in India by 2025\. Specific responsibilities will be reviewed periodically and collectively with top management.


Experience Range:
5 \- 10 years


Educational Qualifications:
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical \& Electrical Engineering
Job Responsibilities:
* Responsible for imaging, piloting and spreading new ways to save energy and serve our clients in pursuit of our Mission and Vision.
* Providing meaningful opportunities for Site Energy Engineers and Site Electricians from various sites to interact with each other to build empathy and support.
* Keeping client engineering teams updated and satisfied, and informed about their own contractual commitments towards Smart Joules.
* Managing site works of vendors and contractors.
* Conduct and/or help the Site Energy Engineer conduct small scale events and trainings on energy efficiency at client site
* Ensuring all information used for billing and monthly reports are accurate and shared in a timely manner with the Central Services team.
* Ensuring Smart Joules' invoices are submitted on time and to the right people.
* Resolving all queries of engineering teams related to billing and keeping continuous track of invoice movement within the client team until date of payment.
* Ensuring Site Energy Engineers stay on top of their billing related responsibilities
* Setting daily energy savings targets based on weekly and monthly targets given by Senior Managers and enabling Site Energy Engineers to achieve the intended results.
* Executing periodic audits at our client sites to ensure our ECMs are performing as intended, and with the intention of discovering additional ECMs
* Providing constant support to Site Energy Engineers to ensure end\-use assets and systems are performing efficiently.
* Take up the activities necessary to ensure achievement of the person\-specific or department specific OKRs.
* Managing execution of maintenance schedules prepared by Sr. Manager in coordination with Site Energy Engineers, contractors, vendors, and clients.
* Handling inventory management at sites efficiently, ensuring the availability of critical spares.
* Ensure the spares/consumables procured for maintenance activities are the best cost without compromising on quality.
* Ensuring vendors are executing all works under AMCs and Warranties in a timely and high\-quality manner.
* Ensuring the data related to maintenance budget estimation is prepared and shared as and when required.
* Ensuring the maintenance is carried out within the allocated budget.
* Share all information related to critical breakdowns and client communication with the sr. management.
* Support the Site Engineers to address all breakdowns.
* Presenting and explaining monthly reports to clients to help them appreciate our work.
* Maintaining all site documentation as per Smart Joules' standards.
* Regularly documenting and sharing best practices and success stories from all sites with other Energy Managers and Site Energy Engineers.
* Using DeJoule consistently and comprehensively to drive savings.
* Coordinating with Projects, BMS and Analytics \& Automation teams to execute onboarding and regular training programs for Site Energy Engineers and clients .
* Ensuring Site Energy Engineers use DeJoule consistently and comprehensively.
* Support in improving the BMS system features through regular use and feedback.
* Contributions to regional planning in line with our goals and plans.
* Coordinating with the HR department for recruitment and induction of high\-quality Site Energy Engineers and Energy Managers for our team.
* Helping with induction programs of other team members in Smart Joules, as needed.
* Mentor and help the SEEs in undergoing training and technical development.
* Ensure the SEEs attend the training sessions organized by Smart Joules.


Skills Required:
Energy Efficiency , Energy Conservation , Sustainability , Innovation , Relationship Management , Vendor Management , Contractor Management , Training , Billing , Operations Management , Auditing , Maintenance Management , Inventory Management , Budgeting , Documentation , Data Analysis , IoT Platform Management , BMS System Management , Leadership , Recruitment , Mentoring , Energy Calculations , Computer Skills , Web Search , Email , Microsoft Word , Microsoft Excel , Microsoft PowerPoint , Document Preparation , English Language , Hindi Language , Local Language


Candidate Attributes:
* At least 5 Years of experience in operations and maintenance in commercial buildings
* Some experience with operations and maintenance of central air conditioning systems.
* Capable of making basic energy calculations.
* Basic computer skills (Web Search, Email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) including document preparation.
* Must speak English or Hindi (preferably both) and the local language spoken at their site location.


Job Code: KL\-BYZBSSF3
About Us
As our planet faces the alarming reality of warming temperatures, India is confronting a critical challenge: by 2030, heat stress events could cost the nation 34 million full\-time jobs—equivalent to 5\.8% of its working hours. In this context, HVAC systems are no longer a luxury but a fundamental necessity.  

  

The escalating demand for cooling in India is projected to necessitate an additional 800 GW of power generation, exacerbating carbon emissions and accelerating climate change. With HVAC systems already accounting for up to 60% of energy costs, the people, the planet, and profit appear to be at cross\-roads with each other, making it imperative to decouple the gridlock.  

  

The answer to this impending conundrum lies in Energy Efficiency.  

We are Smart Joules. And, we are pioneering the journey towards profitable decarbonization.
Why Us?
OUR VISION  

To reduce 29 million tonnes of Co2 by 2030 by pioneering profitable decarbonization.  

  

OUR MISSION  

To make energy efficiency simple, substantial and profitable through cooling\-as\-a\-service business models, intelligent automation technologies and efficiency\-first processes, culture and values.

Store Operations • Manage the complete day\-to\-day operations of the retail store. • Ensure the store is clean, organized, well\-presented, and customer\-ready at all times. • Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and operational standards. • Manage store opening and closing procedures. • Coordinate with head office regarding operational requirements. 2\. Sales \& Business Performance • Drive daily, monthly, and annual sales targets. • Monitor sales performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue. • Track key retail metrics such as sales, average bill value, conversion, and customer footfall. • Develop and implement strategies to improve store performance. • Ensure effective product presentation to maximize sales opportunities. 3\. Team Management • Lead, train, motivate, and manage the store sales team. • Allocate daily responsibilities and sales targets to team members. • Monitor individual and team performance. • Conduct regular team briefings and provide feedback. • Ensure staff maintain professional grooming, behaviour, and customer service standards. • Support recruitment and onboarding of store staff when required. 4\. Customer Experience • Ensure a premium and consistent customer experience. • Handle customer queries, feedback, complaints, exchanges, and escalations professionally. • Build strong customer relationships and encourage repeat purchases. • Ensure staff follow proper customer engagement and selling practices. 5\. Inventory \& Stock Management • Monitor daily stock movement, inward and outward transactions. • Ensure accurate stock receiving, tagging, storage, transfers, and sales records. • Conduct regular stock checks and physical inventory audits. • Investigate and resolve stock discrepancies, damages, shortages, or losses. • Maintain proper stock levels and coordinate replenishment with the warehouse/head office. • Ensure proper organization of the stockroom. 6\. Visual Merchandising • Maintain store displays according to the brand's visual guidelines. • Ensure proper product placement, size\-wise arrangement, colour coordination, and display standards. • Coordinate seasonal launches, promotions, new collections, and promotional displays. • Ensure mannequins, fixtures, signage, and displays are maintained properly. 7\. Cash \& Billing Operations • Supervise billing and POS operations. • Ensure accurate cash handling and daily cash reconciliation. • Monitor card, UPI, and other payment transactions. • Ensure proper documentation of refunds, exchanges, discounts, and credit notes. • Coordinate with the accounts team regarding daily sales and cash reports. 8\. **Job Title:** Medical Store Manager  
**Department:** Medical Store / Pharmacy  
**Location:** Green Park, New Delhi  
**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹60,000 per month (depending on experience and skills)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Schedule:** Monday to Saturday

About the Organisation

A.K. Institute of Ophthalmology – Eye \& Retina Centre is a specialised eye care centre committed to providing quality ophthalmic healthcare services.

We are looking for an experienced and responsible Medical Store Manager to manage medical inventory, procurement, vendor coordination, and the timely availability of medicines and medical supplies.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Inventory \& Stock Management**

* Maintain accurate records of medicines, surgical consumables, medical supplies, and equipment.
* Monitor stock levels, expiry dates, and stock movement to prevent shortages and overstocking.
* Follow FIFO (First In, First Out) and FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) inventory management practices.
* Ensure proper storage and timely replenishment of stock.

**2\. Procurement \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for timely procurement of medicines and medical supplies.
* Verify received items against purchase orders and invoices.
* Follow up on pending orders, returns, damaged goods, and discrepancies.
* Maintain vendor relationships and ensure cost\-effective purchasing.

**3\. Compliance \& Quality Control**

* Ensure medicines and medical supplies are stored as per applicable regulations and hospital policies.
* Monitor temperature, humidity, and storage conditions wherever required.
* Maintain proper documentation for audits and inspections.
* Ensure expired, damaged, or recalled medicines are identified, segregated, and handled as per applicable guidelines.

**4\. Team Management \& Coordination**

* Supervise medical store staff and allocate daily responsibilities.
* Coordinate with doctors, pharmacists, nursing staff, OT, and other departments.
* Ensure timely availability of medicines and surgical consumables for OPD, OT, and emergency requirements.
* Train staff and ensure compliance with hospital procedures.

**5\. Reporting \& Administrative Responsibilities**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory and consumption reports.
* Maintain purchase records, stock registers, invoices, and inventory software.
* Monitor stock consumption, wastage, and inventory discrepancies.
* Assist management in budgeting and inventory planning.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in Pharmacy or Healthcare Management will be preferred.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in medical stores, hospital pharmacy, or healthcare inventory management.
* Experience in managing medicines, surgical consumables, and medical supplies.
* Knowledge of inventory management, FIFO/FEFO, and stock reconciliation.
* Basic computer knowledge and experience with inventory management software or hospital ERP.
* Good communication, coordination, organisational, and team management skills.

Preferred Candidate

* Experience in an eye hospital, ophthalmology centre, or multispecialty hospital.
* Ability to manage multiple departments and ensure uninterrupted availability of essential supplies.
* Detail\-oriented, responsible, and capable of maintaining accurate inventory records.

* Modify and extend AI\-generated solutions.
* Verify AI\-generated answers against actual technical requirements.
* Use AI as a development assistant rather than as a replacement for programming knowledge.

**Strong programming fundamentals are mandatory even when using AI tools.**

Logical \& Problem\-Solving Skills

The candidate should demonstrate strong logical thinking and problem\-solving ability.

We expect the candidate to be able to:

* Break complex problems into smaller components.

* Identify the root cause of bugs.
* Develop efficient solutions.
* Understand algorithms and data structures.
* Think about edge cases and failure scenarios.

Passion for Technology

The ideal candidate should:

* Enjoy learning new technologies.
* Be curious about how systems work internally.
* Take initiative to explore and experiment.
* Stay updated with modern development practices.
* Be willing to work with new frameworks, tools, and technologies.
* Take ownership of assigned work.
* Be comfortable learning outside their existing skill set.

What We Look For

* **Strong theoretical knowledge**

* **Passion for technology**
* **Strong willingness to learn**
* **Good communication skills**
* **Professional discipline and accountability**

Important Requirement

**We are not looking for candidates who simply generate code using AI tools.**

We are looking for developers who can **think, understand, explain, debug, improve, and build software.**

AI tools may be used to increase productivity, but the candidate must possess sufficient technical knowledge to **understand and take ownership of the final code.**

title: Associate – Data Engineer (Data Business CoE)
description:
**About us**





 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
 








  




**Who you will work with** 






 Pyxis combines alternative data, AI\-driven analytics, and institutional investor\-led insights to reveal where, how and why consumers buy, how they pay, how much they spend, how their needs and demands are changing, and much more. 
 





 By revealing previously opaque fundamental business trends and their drivers, Pyxis enables investors and business decision makers to efficiently allocate capital and address critical problems.
 





 Pyxis has assembled one of the most comprehensive collections of alternative data covering hundreds of millions of people and tens of billions of transactions across the U.S., Canada, Brazil, UK, France and Japan as well as targeted countries across the EU and APAC. This data provides a longitudinal view of consumer and business transactional behaviors—across nearly all verticals over the last six years—and plays an integral role in answering companies’ and investors’ questions about market share, category size, pricing and promotion effectiveness, assortment optimization, ad targeting, loyalty, switching behavior, disruption, and more.
 





 These state\-of\-the art capabilities enable Bain to provide its clients with a valuable new dimension in investment analysis and strategy development, complementing Bain’s proven “outside\-in” approach with the ability to apply complex data sets to assess company fundamentals.
 





  BCN Pyxis modeler will work closely with the BCN team manager, Pyxis Product Manager, General Manager, Bain Partners, and the Proprietary Data group to build and deliver a commercially successful product that spans core sectors across all regions. 
 





 The working style of the team would be to support Pyxis product development , hence the pipelines and algorithm built should be scalable and automated to support subscription clients
 








  




**What you’ll do** 




* Design, implement, and continuously expand data pipelines by performing extraction, transformation, and loading activities
* Work across workstreams to deliver high\-quality, zero\-defect deliverables and leverage manager’s support on complex pieces
* Gather requirements and business process knowledge in order to transform the data in a way that’s geared towards the needs of end users
* Provides tool based technical expertise to the junior team members when required
* Builds reusable capabilities that can be used by team members or across service lines
* Write advanced SQL and Python code to build and maintain backend data APIs and services; work hands\-on with Snowflake for data transformation, query optimization, and pipeline development
* Ensure that the data architecture is scalable and maintainable
* Design and develop RESTful backend APIs and microservices using Python (FastAPI/Flask) to expose data products and support downstream consumers
* Work with the business in designing and delivering correct, high quality data
* Investigate data to identify potential issues within ETL pipelines, notify end\-users and propose adequate solutions
* Prepare documentation for further reference
* Respond to onshore team/client questions around the data and insights
* Provide ongoing support for subscription customers, such as additional data cuts and responding to questions about the data/methodology
* The working style of the team would be to support product development , hence the pipelines and algorithm built should be scalable and automated







  




**About you** 






 Work experience: 2\-4 years of experience in areas related to Data Management, Business Intelligence or Business Analytics. Hands\-on experience in data handling and ETL workstreams
 





 Education Required: Incumbent should be a graduate/post graduate from top\-tier institute or have pursued a statistical/analytical course from a tier 1 university
 





 Preferred: Concentration in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Market Research is strongly preferred.
 





  Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:
 



* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python and SQL for batch and real\-time data processing.
* Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows to ingest, transform, and load data from multiple source systems.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and data services using FastAPI for data integration and consumption.
* Design, implement, and support enterprise\-grade Data Warehouse solutions following dimensional modeling best practices.
* Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and data transformations for analytics and reporting.
* Work extensively with Snowflake to build, optimize, and manage cloud\-based data platforms (good to have)
* Utilize Starburst/Trino for distributed query processing, data federation, and high\-performance analytics (good to have)
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability through validation frameworks, monitoring, and automated testing.
* Optimize data pipeline performance, query execution, and storage utilization across large\-scale datasets.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data analysts, and engineering teams to gather and translate data requirements.
* Implement data governance, security, access controls, and compliance standards across data platforms.
* Troubleshoot production data issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement preventive solutions.
* Leverage cloud\-native technologies and best practices for scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective data architectures.
* Maintain technical documentation, data lineage, and operational runbooks while following Agile development methodologies.







  




**What makes us a great place to work** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

* Facilitate the Lighthouse Foundation Course for newly enrolled youth across assigned centres.

* Facilitate groups of approximately **25–30 participants**.

**Help Young People Navigate Career Choices**

* Conduct career assessments to help students understand their interests, strengths, and aspirations.
* Conduct one\-on\-one career counselling and guidance sessions.
* Help students explore different career and skilling possibilities.
* Guide young people towards appropriate courses and pathways based on their goals and potential.
* Help students make **informed career decisions**, rather than decisions based only on external expectations.

**Build Confidence Along the Way**

Career development isn't only about choosing a course.

It is also about helping young people believe they can take the next step.

You will build trust, encourage participation, support self\-awareness, and help students develop the confidence and agency they need to navigate their career journey.

**Follow the Journey**

* Track student attendance, participation, and progress throughout the Foundation Course.
* Maintain accurate records of career assessments and counselling sessions.
* Document student progress and relevant interventions.
* Use insights from the field to strengthen student engagement and program delivery.

**Work as One Team**

* Collaborate closely with Lighthouse Centre teams to ensure smooth program implementation.
* Support student engagement and centre\-level activities.
* Contribute to other program initiatives as required.
* Share field insights and ideas that can improve the student experience.

**Who Can Apply?**

**We welcome candidates with:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Psychology, Counselling, Training**, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduates from other disciplines with relevant facilitation, counselling, training, or youth engagement experience are also encouraged to apply.
* **Freshers with relevant internship experience** in counselling, facilitation, training, or youth engagement are welcome.

**Experience \& Skills**

**Ideally, you will have:**

* **1–2 years of experience** in facilitation, career counselling, training, youth development, or a related area.
* Experience facilitating groups of **25–30 participants**.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Good listening and counselling skills.
* Empathy and a genuine interest in working with young people.
* Good documentation and organisational skills.
* Proficiency in the **regional language, Hindi, and English**.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across the assigned region.

**This Role Is For You If...**

**You are someone who:**

* Gets energy from working directly with people.
* Believes that every young person deserves access to opportunity.
* Is curious about people's stories, aspirations, and potential.
* Can facilitate a room without making it feel like a classroom.
* Knows when to speak — and when to listen.
* Can turn a career conversation into a moment of clarity.
* Is comfortable working in different communities and environments.
* Doesn't mind being on the road and enjoys field\-based work.
* Can balance empathy with execution.
* Wants their work to create an impact that can be seen beyond a spreadsheet.

**Why Join Lighthouse**

**Your work can change someone's starting point.**

**You could be the person who helps a young person:**

* Discover a strength they didn't recognise.
* Explore a career they didn't know existed.
* Choose the right skilling pathway.

description:
About 900 students learn ballet with us across seven centres. Every one of them started with a parent asking questions, on a call, on WhatsApp, or at our front desk. You would be the person who answers.

You will help families go from their first question to their first class. Most parents are new to this. They don't know which class suits their child. You find out what they need and help them choose. You will also keep our records in the CRM, look after families on the waitlist with regular updates, and support the team with day to day administration. For some classes, you will also step in as the student coordinator when needed.

**What you'll do**

* Talk to parents on phone, WhatsApp, email, Instagram and in person
* Explain classes, timings and fees
* Book trials and complete enrolments
* Follow up with families and note everything in the CRM
* Keep waitlisted families updated with regular messages, and offer them a place when a seat opens
* Support the team with administration: records, schedules, notices and parent queries
* Act as student coordinator for some classes, as and when required. You look after the students in class and are the contact for parents and teachers
* Tell us what parents keep asking, so we can fix the cause

**What we're looking for**

* Someone who is easy and pleasant to talk to
* Experience in customer service, hospitality, admissions or front office. Freshers with a great first impression can apply too
* Experience with a CRM (Freshdesk, Zoho, HubSpot or similar) is a plus for experienced candidates. We will train freshers
* Someone who keeps track of many follow ups
* Comfortable with Google Sheets
* Good spoken and written English. Kannada or Hindi is a plus
* Comfortable with children and parents
* Based in Bangalore and able to join soon

You don't need to know ballet.

**What you get**

* Health insurance
* Paid leave and holidays
* Free yoga and BarreFIT classes
* Mobile and travel reimbursement
* A flat team where everyone works closely together and ideas are heard

**Common questions**

**What are the hours?**  
Mostly weekdays at headquarters. Since the role includes admissions, administration and coordinating some classes, some weekend and evening work comes with it. We agree on your schedule and a weekday off when you join.

**Will I travel to other centres every day?**  
No. You will mostly be at headquarters. When a class needs a coordinator, you will go to that centre, and we reimburse your travel.

**Can I work from home?**  
Mostly not, because we work best together. We allow an occasional work from home day when you need quiet time.

**I'm a fresher. Can I apply?**  
Yes. We first look at how well you talk and listen. Your first job is welcome here.

**How to apply**

Apply on Indeed and answer the two questions below. You can also send a 60 second voice note to 9731180164\. Just tell us who you are, what you have studied or worked on so far, and why you would like to join us. Freshers, please don't worry about work experience. Your studies, projects or anything you are proud of is enough.

We will call selected candidates within 24 hours.

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**

  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.

* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

 grounded, verifiable, and clinically safe — there is no room for hallucination when a doctor is making
 



 a decision.
 



 What You'll Actually Work On
 



 You'll move across the full stack and occasionally into infrastructure. Concretely:
 



  





 Backend
 



  Build and extend API endpoints that power the clinical Q\&A experience and the patient app
 



  Work inside our AI orchestration pipeline — the layers that turn a clinician's free\-text
 



 question into a grounded, structured, trustworthy answer
 



  Design and evolve database schemas, write migrations against live tables, and ship them
 



 safely to production
 



  Use caching and async task queues for background work like document processing, OCR, and
 



 summarisation
 



  





 AI / LLM Pipeline
 



  Integrate, tune, and evaluate calls to large language models — routing, structured output,
 



 narrative generation, and verification
 



  Work on our hallucination defence layer: deterministic grounding checks plus model\-based
 



 gates that catch hallucinations before they reach the clinician
 



  Help with prompt engineering — we treat prompts as code: versioned, evaluated, and
 



 deployed deliberately, not edited live
 



  Build evaluation harnesses so we can measure regression every time we change a prompt or
 



 swap a model
 



  





 Mobile \& Web
 



  Ship user\-facing features across our patient mobile app (iOS \+ Android) and our clinical web
 



 platform — onboarding, document uploads, the chat surface, and more
 



  Work with native device capabilities like the camera, document scanning, and secure on\-
 



 device storage
 



  Debug platform\-specific issues across iOS, Android, and the web — cold\-boot lifecycle,
 



 modal behaviour, keystore quirks, and the long tail of cross\-platform weirdness
 



  





 Infrastructure (occasionally)
 



  Help maintain our cloud deployments and the services that back them
 



  Write and review container builds, debug runtime issues, tune concurrency and timeouts
 



 under real load
 



  Touch our deploy scripts (idempotent, atomic\-swap, auto\-rollback on smoke\-test failure)
 



 across staging and production
 



  Work with secrets management, server\-level configuration, and database operations against
 



 live environments
 



  





 Observability \& Quality
 



  Instrument features with structured logging — every model call, every critical path, with
 



 cost, latency, and error telemetry feeding our dashboards
 



  Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests; our pipeline has an e2e harness that exercises
 



 real clinical scenarios
 



  Participate in code reviews. Every PR goes through a structured review covering correctness,
 



 clinical safety, security, scalability, and data completeness before merge
 



  





 You're a Good Fit If You
 



  B.Tech in CS and have 2\-3 yrs of experience
 



  Are comfortable writing both a backend language and a frontend language — not just one.
 



 You'll genuinely move between them in the same week
 



  Have deployed something — even a side project — to a cloud provider. Anything real, end\-
 



 to\-end
 



  Can read a container build file and an orchestration config without panicking
 



  Understand REST APIs, relational databases, caching, and the basics of async / background
 



 jobs
 



  Are curious about how LLMs actually work in production — context windows, structured
 



 output, grounding, the latency\-vs\-quality tradeoffs. You don't need to be an ML engineer,
 



 but you should want to understand the pipeline
 



  Can drop into a large unfamiliar codebase, read tests, search aggressively, and find your way
 



 around without being hand\-held
 



  Care about correctness. In our domain, "it kinda work" is a bug
 



  Remote\-first, async\-first. We respect your hours and how you work. Output over seat time

We are looking for a responsible and organized **Marine Store Manager** to manage day\-to\-day inventory and store operations at our marine and industrial supplies facility. **Powered by GSNA Education Pvt Ltd**

Position

Department

Customer Success / Operations

Role Overview

We are looking for a responsible and customer\-focused **Customer Success Manager (CSM)** to manage students and parents after enrollment, ensure smooth execution of classes, handle customer escalations, improve student engagement, and support renewals, upselling, and cross\-selling.

The CSM will act as the primary point of contact between students, parents, teachers, and the internal academic/operations teams.

**1\. Student \& Parent Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with students and parents after enrollment.
* Regularly communicate with parents regarding class progress and schedules.
* Understand customer concerns and ensure timely resolution.
* Conduct feedback calls and collect customer feedback.
* Maintain accurate customer records and follow\-up status.

**2\. Class Scheduling \& Execution**

* Manage daily and weekly class schedules.
* Coordinate between students and teachers for smooth class execution.
* Monitor scheduled, completed, cancelled, and missed classes.
* Follow up on teacher/student absences and reschedule classes when required.
* Ensure classes are conducted according to the agreed schedule.

**3\. Escalation Management**

* Handle student and parent complaints professionally.
* Identify the root cause of escalations and coordinate with the relevant department for resolution.
* Track open escalations until closure.
* Maintain proper escalation records and provide regular updates to customers.

**4\. Renewals \& Retention**

* Monitor upcoming course/product expiry dates.
* Contact parents regarding renewals well in advance.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate renewal discussions.
* Support customer retention through proactive communication and service quality.

**5\. Upselling \& Cross\-Selling**

* Identify relevant additional academic requirements.
* Introduce suitable products, programs, or additional services to existing customers.
* Coordinate with the sales team where necessary for conversions.
* Follow up on interested customers and opportunities.

**6\. Student Progress \& Feedback**

* Monitor student engagement and class participation.
* Coordinate with academic teams regarding student requirements.
* Collect feedback regarding teachers, classes, schedules, and overall experience.
* Escalate academic concerns to the appropriate academic team.

**7\. Daily Reporting**

* Prepare daily/weekly CSM reports.
* Track:
* Scheduled classes
* Completed classes
* Cancelled/missed classes
* Rescheduled classes
* Customer escalations
* Feedback received
* Renewals
* Upselling/cross\-selling opportunities
* Pending customer issues
* Maintain accurate CRM/customer records.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication skills in English.
* Strong customer\-handling and relationship\-management skills.
* Good follow\-up and coordination abilities.
* Problem\-solving attitude.
* Ability to handle multiple students/customers simultaneously.
* Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and CRM tools.
* Ability to work with teachers, students, parents, and internal teams.
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Any Bachelor's degree.
* Previous experience in customer success, customer support, education operations, sales support, or relationship management is preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication and coordination skills may also be considered.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer satisfaction and feedback
* Timely resolution of escalations
* Class execution percentage
* Reduction in missed/cancelled classes
* Renewal conversions
* Customer retention
* Upselling and cross\-selling
* Timely follow\-ups
* Accuracy of daily reports

Working Environment

The role involves continuous coordination with **students, parents, teachers, academic teams, sales teams, and management** to ensure a smooth customer experience from enrollment through the complete product/service tenure.

description:
**About Zenopsys** 


 Zenopsys is building a world where life\-saving medicines are never delayed by paperwork and operational bottlenecks. 
 





 Zenopsys is an AI\-native documentation workspace built for the Life Sciences industry. Our platform uses Agentic AI to automate and streamline documentation across the product lifecycle—from
 
**R\&D and Clinical Development to Regulatory Submissions, Quality, and Post\-Market activities** 

 .
 




**We help medicines and therapies reach the market 6\-24 sooner!** 



**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for a highly curious, analytical and customer\-focused Associate Product Manager who can work closely with product, engineering, sales and customers to build and improve Zenopsys products.
 





 You will understand customer workflows and problems, translate them into product requirements, support feature development, conduct product demos, gather customer feedback and help drive product adoption and satisfaction.
 





 The ideal candidate should be a strong problem solver,an excellent communicator, and passionate about building AI\-powered products.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**Product Management** 
* Work with senior product leaders to define, prioritize and build product features.
* Understand customer workflows and convert business problems into clear product requirements.
* Create user stories, feature requirements, acceptance criteria and product documentation.
* Track features from ideation through development, testing, release and adoption.
* Act as the Product Owner for assigned features/modules.


**Customer \& Product Solutions** 
* Understand how customers use Zenopsys for their internal operations and identify opportunities to improve their workflows.
* Conduct customer discussions, capture feedback and translate insights into actionable product improvements.
* Support customer onboarding and product adoption.
* Help resolve product\-related queries and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Track customer satisfaction, usage and recurring product issues.


**Product Demonstrations \& Sales Support** 
* Become a Zenopsys product expert and develop a deep understanding of the platform and its use cases.
* Conduct product demonstrations for prospects and existing customers.
* Support the Sales/Business Development team during pre\-sales discussions, discovery calls and solution presentations.
* Understand customer requirements and demonstrate how Zenopsys can address their specific business problems.
* Support post\-sales teams with product knowledge, customer training and adoption initiatives.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 
* Work closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, Regulatory, Sales, Customer Success and Leadership teams.
* Coordinate across teams to ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and delivered.
* Help create product documentation, SOPs, user guides and training materials.
* Support product launches, feature releases and internal enablement.


**What We Are Looking For** 
* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or related courses from a Tier\-1 engineering institute
* MBA from a Tier\-1 business school with a background in Engineering
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of technology and software products.
* Quick learners who will be able to understand and work with different data types and structures in the life\-sciences industry including scientific data, medical data and regulatory data.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand complex customer problems and simplify them into actionable solutions.


**Good to Have** 
* Exposure to SaaS / B2B software products.
* Basic understanding of APIs, databases, SQL or data analytics.
* Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic workflows.
* Understanding of pharma, biotech, clinical research or regulatory processes.
* Previous experience in customer\-facing or consulting roles.

title: Fibre Splicer Technician
description:
**Position Title: Fiber Optic Splicer**

**Department:** Technical / Field Operations

**Reports To:** Field Supervisor / Project Manager

**Location:** As Assigned

1\. Job Summary

The Fiber Optic Splicer is responsible for installation, splicing, testing, maintenance, and repair of fiber optic cables to ensure uninterrupted broadband, IPTV, and leased line services. The role requires technical expertise, accuracy, safety compliance, and timely execution of assigned projects.

2\. Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Fiber Splicing \& Termination

· Perform fusion and mechanical splicing of fiber optic cables.

· Prepare, strip, clean, and cleave fiber cables before splicing.

· Terminate fiber cables in ODF, patch panels, and distribution boxes.

· Ensure splice loss remains within acceptable standards.

B. Installation \& Deployment

· Install underground, aerial, and indoor fiber optic cables.

· Assist in cable laying, routing, and ducting activities.

· Install joint enclosures, splitter boxes, and fiber distribution units.

C. Testing \& Troubleshooting

· Conduct testing using OTDR, power meter, and light source.

· Identify and rectify fiber faults, breaks, and signal losses.

· Perform preventive maintenance and emergency restoration work.

· Maintain proper documentation of test results.

D. Maintenance \& Repair

· Respond promptly to service complaints and fiber cut issues.

· Repair damaged fiber cables and restore connectivity.

· Coordinate with technical teams during network outages.

E. Documentation \& Reporting

· Maintain daily work reports and job completion reports.

· Record splice loss readings and maintain fiber route details.

· Update inventory usage of fiber cables and materials.

F. Safety \& Compliance

· Follow company safety policies and use proper PPE.

· Ensure work is completed as per industry standards and company guidelines.

· Maintain tools and equipment in proper working condition.

3\. Required Skills \& Competencies

· Knowledge of fiber optic splicing and testing equipment.

· Ability to read fiber network diagrams and route maps.

· Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

· Basic knowledge of broadband and IPTV network infrastructure.

· Good communication and teamwork skills.

· Willingness to work in field conditions and extended hours if required.

4\. Educational Qualification

· ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, or relevant field.

· Certification in Fiber Optic Technology (Preferred).

5\. Experience

· 1–3 years of experience in fiber optic splicing (Preferred).

· Freshers with technical training may also apply.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

· Quality of splicing (minimum loss levels).

· Timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Quick fault resolution and restoration.

· Compliance with safety and reporting standards.

description:

 As a Technical Project Manager, you will help organize and drive the delivery of a smart productivity hardware product. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, design, and operations teams to turn ideas, requirements, and decisions into clear plans and actionable tasks. You’ll own coordination across multiple workstreams, ensuring dependencies, deadlines, blockers, and decisions are actively managed. The role combines Agile delivery, technical project coordination, documentation, and operational follow\-through. You’ll work in an international environment alongside internal teams, vendors, and contractors. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on how a technology product moves from planning through release.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Organize sprint work, including planning, task breakdown, prioritization, and progress tracking.
* Translate product requirements and decisions into clear, actionable tasks for engineering and design teams.
* Track deadlines, dependencies, blockers, risks, and agreements across project participants.
* Maintain accurate backlogs, roadmaps, project documentation, and task statuses.
* Document product and technical decisions, requirements, meeting outcomes, and agreed next steps.
* Coordinate delivery across product, engineering, design, and operations.
* Run regular team syncs and follow up to ensure decisions are translated into execution.
* Support changes in requirements by assessing their potential impact on scope, timelines, and delivery.
* Coordinate operational matters involving vendors, contractors, legal, finance, and other external stakeholders.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and escalate issues that could affect timelines, quality, or product outcomes.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Project Manager, or Product Operations Manager within a technology product company.
* Experience working directly within a product or engineering organization, rather than exclusively in an agency or administrative environment.
* Hands\-on experience running Agile/Scrum processes and managing sprint execution.
* Experience taking ownership of projects or products from initial scoping through release.
* Strong ability to write requirements, user scenarios, acceptance criteria, and development or design tasks.
* Experience managing multiple parallel workstreams, dependencies, and external stakeholders.
* Experience working with vendors, contractors, or operational teams.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through testing and release.
* Basic understanding of how hardware, firmware, mobile, and backend components interact.
* Ability to turn complex or loosely defined problems into structured, actionable tasks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence running meetings and driving decisions to completion.
