Reporting to the Head Total Rewards, this role serves as a trusted advisor to HR and business leaders, driving compensation, performance management, incentive programs, benefits, mobility, payroll governance, and executive rewards.
   

  

 This is a strategic and operational role that combines reward program design, governance, analytics, and execution to support business growth, talent attraction, retention, and pay\-for\-performance objectives in a global environment. The role will play a critical part in establishing and managing the annual Performance Management Cycle and ensuring the effective delivery of global Total Rewards initiatives following the business transition from Lonza.
   

  

**What You Will Get**
* Opportunity to shape and influence the Total Rewards strategy for a global business with approximately 3,500 employees.
* End\-to\-end ownership of compensation, performance management, incentive, benefits, and mobility programs across multiple geographies.
* Exposure to executive rewards, global salary structures, job grading frameworks, and governance processes.
* Partnership with senior business leaders, HR teams, and external providers to drive strategic workforce decisions.
* A highly visible role combining reward strategy, analytics, business partnering, and program execution.
* Opportunity to lead transformation initiatives and establish best practices in rewards and performance management.


**What You Will Do**
* Influence, govern, and execute the global Total Rewards strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and talent priorities.
* Lead annual compensation and reward processes, including salary reviews, benchmarking, pay equity analysis, and compensation support.
* Manage global job evaluation, grading frameworks, and salary structure architecture to ensure consistency and market competitiveness.
* Lead the annual Performance Management Cycle, including planning, communications, calibration, governance, and execution.
* Administer global incentive and executive reward programs, including annual bonus and short\-term incentive plans.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR and business leaders while overseeing benefits, mobility, vendor partnerships, analytics, and reporting.
* Drive continuous improvement, governance, compliance, and operational excellence across reward, performance, and HR delivery processes.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Proven expertise in Total Rewards, including compensation, executive rewards, benefits, mobility, payroll governance, and performance management within multinational organizations.
* Strong experience leading annual compensation and performance management cycles, including calibration, incentive administration, communications, and governance.
* Deep understanding of job evaluation methodologies, grading frameworks, salary structures, and market benchmarking practices.
* Demonstrated capability in HR analytics, workforce reporting, data\-driven decision making, and translating insights into business recommendations.
* Strong project and program management skills with the ability to manage complex initiatives, multiple stakeholders, and competing priorities.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with senior leaders and HR teams globally.
* Strong governance, compliance, and risk management mindset with experience developing and implementing policies and reward frameworks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA preferred


**About Lonza**
 At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30\+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together.  Every plushie adopted, every "OMG this is so cute" and every happy customer at Uni Seoul happens because of one thing: a great store team.
 



  





 We're looking for the person who finds those teams, sets them up to win and makes them want to stay. If you love being on the shop floor more than behind a desk, and you can hire 30 people for a new store without breaking a sweat — read on.

**MEET UNI SEOUL: CUTENESS AS A WAY OF LIVING** 




 Uni Seoul is India's Korean\-inspired impulse lifestyle brand. Founded in Pune in 2023, we've grown into 17\+ stores across 8 cities in under three years.
 



  





 Walk into one of our stores and you'll find plushies waiting to be adopted, a walk\-in plushie closet, and shelves of quirky stationery, beauty and home finds. Everything is designed in\-house and priced between ₹99 and ₹2,999\.
 



  





 What we've built so far:
 



 \- 17\+ stores across Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Nashik, Ahmedabad, Kochi and Chennai
 



 \- ₹60 Cr ARR, on track to close the year at ₹100 Cr
 



 \- NPS above 80 and 4\.7\+ Google ratings — customers don't just shop, they come back
 



 \- ₹35 Cr Series A (June 2026\), led by Riverwalk Holdings and Sauce.vc, with Panthera Peak Ventures and MIXI Global Investments
 



 \- 250\+ people across our stores, warehouse and HQ — and growing fast
 



  





**THE PLAYGROUND WE OPERATE IN** 




 India's young consumers are buying small joys, often and on impulse. A ₹450 plushie, a pastel planner, a K\-beauty find — these are everyday treats, not big\-ticket decisions.
 



  





 \- The K\-wave is mainstream. K\-dramas, K\-pop and K\-beauty have made Korean aesthetics part of everyday Gen Z and millennial life.
 



 \- Stores are experiences again. Shoppers want places that are fun to walk into, photograph and share — not just shelves.
 



 \- Global players have proven the model. Miniso, Daiso, Pop Mart and Artbox show how big this can get. We're building the homegrown, design\-led version for India.
 



  





 In this business, the store team is the brand. That's why this role matters so much.
 



  





**WHERE WE'RE HEADED** 




 Our ambition is 500 stores across India, followed by the UAE and Southeast Asia through master franchises. 18 new stores are already in the pipeline.
 



  





 Every one of them needs a team that's hired, trained and ready on opening day. You'll be the one making that happen.
 



  





**YOUR MISSION** 




 Make sure every Uni Seoul store is fully staffed, well trained, paid right and happy — from the day it opens.
 



  





 You'll be the HR face of the company for our store teams: their hiring partner, their go\-to for problems, and the Cluster Managers' right hand on everything people.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





 1\. Store hiring: fill every shift, open every store on time
 



 \- Own end\-to\-end hiring for store associates, store managers and area managers across all cities.
 



 \- Build a hiring engine for new launches: job portals, campus drives, referrals, walk\-in drives and agency partners.
 



 \- Keep a ready bench of talent so no store ever runs short\-staffed.
 



 \- Run hiring on our ATS and track what matters: time to hire, cost per hire and offer\-to\-join ratio.
 



  





 2\. Onboarding: Day 1 should feel like unwrapping a gift
 



 \- Run onboarding for every store joiner — documents, Keka setup, PF/ESIC enrolment and first\-week induction.
 



 \- Work with Retail Ops to deliver our induction programme for store managers, area managers and cluster managers.
 



  





 3\. Store HR operations: nothing slips through the cracks
 



 \- Manage attendance, leave, shift rosters and payroll inputs for store teams on Keka.
 



 \- Make sure every store employee is paid right and on time, with minimum wages, PF, ESIC, LWF and professional tax handled correctly in every state.
 



 \- Keep store HR records audit\-ready: registers, Shops \& Establishments licences and employee files.
 



 \- Run clean exits: full \& final settlements, clearances and exit interviews.
 



  





 4\. Engagement \& retention: keep the best people on the floor
 



 \- Visit stores regularly and know your store teams by name.
 



 \- Track attrition store by store, find out why people leave, and fix it with the Cluster Managers.
 



 \- Run store rewards and recognition, incentive payouts and celebrations.
 



  





 5\. Performance \& growth: build tomorrow's store leaders
 



 \- Support KRAs, monthly store performance reviews and the appraisal cycle for retail teams.
 



 \- Spot high performers early and build the path from associate to store manager to cluster manager.
 



 \- Find training gaps and coordinate product, customer\-experience and grooming training.
 



  





 6\. Employee relations \& POSH: be the person store teams trust
 



 \- Be the first point of contact for store team grievances, and resolve them fast and fairly.
 



 \- Handle disciplinary cases, investigations and warnings as per policy.
 



 \- Drive POSH awareness across stores and support the Internal Committee.
 



  





 YOUR FIRST YEAR, AT A GLANCE
 



 \- First 30 days: Visit stores in every city and meet every Cluster Manager. Audit store HR records and compare headcount with the manpower plan.
 



 \- By day 60: A hiring pipeline and a ready bench for every live store and the next launches. Store onboarding standardised on Keka.
 



 \- By day 90: Store\-wise attrition dashboard live. A monthly store HR review with Cluster Managers up and running.
 



 \- By month 12: Every new store opens fully staffed. Early attrition trending down. Clean store audits. A visible path from associate to store manager.
 



  





 How we'll measure you: time to hire, store staffing levels, early attrition (first 90 days), payroll input accuracy, store audit findings and grievance closure time.
 



  





**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 Must\-haves:
 



 \- 4–7 years in HR, with at least 2 years in retail, QSR, hospitality or another frontline\-workforce setup.
 



 \- Proven volume hiring for store or frontline roles across multiple cities.
 



 \- Working knowledge of payroll inputs and statutory basics: PF, ESIC, minimum wages, LWF, professional tax and Shops \& Establishments.
 



 \- Comfortable with an HRMS (Keka preferred), an ATS and Excel/Google Sheets — and keen to use AI tools and automation to work faster.
 



 \- Happy to travel regularly to stores across cities.
 



 \- A graduate degree in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is a plus.
 



 \- Fluent in English and Hindi; a regional language is a bonus.
 



  





 Bonus points:
 



 \- You've hired and set up teams for new store launches.
 



 \- You've worked at a fast\-growing retail brand or a startup.
 



  





 The vibe we're looking for:
 



 \- As comfortable on the shop floor as at your desk.
 



 \- Warm enough to be trusted, firm enough to be respected.
 



 \- Organised, fast and relentless — an open position bothers you until it's filled.
 



  





**WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE** 




  





 \- A true open\-door HQ. Anyone can walk up to anyone, founders included. Good ideas win, whoever they come from.
 



 \- Real ownership. Your hiring decides whether a new store opens on time. Few roles have impact this visible.
 



 \- Flexible working hours. We care about outcomes, not attendance registers. Plan your day around your best work.
 



 \- Learn at startup speed. You'll see retail expansion, new city launches and brand\-building up close.
 



 \- Grow as we grow. As we scale to 500 stores, this role can grow into leading Retail HR with a team of your own.
 



 \- Competitive pay. Strong compensation that rewards great work.
 



 \- The cutest perks in India. Employee discounts on everything in our stores. Yes, including the plushies.
 



 \- A team that actually has fun. Launch parties, store openings, festivals and celebrations are part of the job description.
 



  





 THINK YOU'RE THE ONE? PROVE IT (WITH STYLE)
 



 Write it to our talent team \- talent@uniseoul.in CC mohit@uniseoul.in with the subject line "Application for HRBP – Retail", attach your CV, and tell us:
 



  





 1\. Why you? In 150 words or less, why should our store teams have you in their corner?
 



 2\. Your hiring hero moment. The toughest store or frontline hiring deadline you've beaten, and how.
 



 3\. Your retention fix. One thing you did that made frontline people stay longer.
 



  





 Consider this your first test. If your email makes us smile, you're halfway there. If it also shows you read every word of this JD, you're further than most.
 



  





 We can't wait to meet you :)

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

**Company Description** 
 At the International Institute of Export Import Management (IIEIM) Pune, we focus on comprehensive, practical training in global trade and export\-import management.
 



  





 Our mission is to equip individuals and businesses with the skills and knowledge needed to succeed in international markets. We emphasize hands\-on learning and current industry insights to build real\-world capabilities. With a strong placement support system, IIEIM helps learners access opportunities in global commerce and accelerate their careers.
 



  





 Joining IIEIM means contributing to an institution dedicated to transforming futures through export\-import expertise.
 



  





**Role Description** 
**The IIT Graduate Engineer – Founder’s Office \| Any Branch role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Pune Division.** 




  





 This role supports the Founder in strategic initiatives, business planning, and operational execution across academics, marketing, partnerships, and new programs. Day\-to\-day tasks may include data analysis, preparing reports and presentations, conducting market and industry research, and coordinating with different internal teams to drive key projects. The position involves designing and improving processes, tracking project milestones, and ensuring timely implementation of decisions made by the Founder. The engineer will also contribute to problem\-solving for organizational challenges, explore technology\-driven improvements, and help shape the institute’s growth in the export\-import education space.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Educational background: IIT graduate in any engineering branch with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.**



  




* Business and strategy orientation: Ability to support strategic planning, conduct business and market research, analyze data, and prepare decision\-ready insights.
* Communication and collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capability to draft reports and presentations, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and senior leadership.
* Process and project management: Skills in organizing work, managing timelines, tracking progress, and improving systems and processes for operational efficiency.
* Technical and digital aptitude: Comfort with spreadsheets, presentations, collaborative tools, and interest in leveraging technology for educational and business solutions.
* Professional attributes: High ownership mindset, integrity, willingness to learn, ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, and openness to taking on diverse responsibilities in a founder’s office setup.
* Domain interest: Genuine interest in education, global trade, export\-import management, and building an institution with long\-term impact.

title: EPM - ARCS  - Associate
description:

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an EPM \- ARCS \- Associate \- Consult, you will specialize in providing consulting services for enterprise performance management solutions using Oracle technologies. You will collaborate with clients to assess their performance management needs, design and implement Oracle\-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will be part of a dynamic team that helps clients optimize operational efficiency. This opportunity allows you to engage in research, participate in project tasks, and develop basic skills and knowledge, all while responding effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.

* Collaborating with clients to assess and address their enterprise performance management needs using Oracle technologies
* Designing and implementing Oracle\-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting
* Providing training and support to clients for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle enterprise performance management tools
* Analyzing client needs to optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
* Engaging in business process analysis to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation

* At least 1 years of experience

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting \& Finance, Finance, Management Information Systems, Economics, Business Administration/Management

* Utilizing skills in financial planning and analysis for client projects
* Engaging in business process analysis to enhance operational efficiency
* Applying strategic data analysis to inform decision\-making processes
* Excelling in communication and teamwork within diverse environments

 NextNation is a
 
**global talent mobility company** 

 helping skilled professionals from India access career opportunities across international markets. Our business spans healthcare mobility, skilled \& vocational programs, visa services and technology\-enabled talent solutions.
 





 We are building a high\-growth company and are looking for someone who wants to be part of the

 As a
 
**Founder's Office Associate** 

 , you will work closely with the Founder on high\-priority business initiatives across
 
**strategy, operations, sales, hiring, partnerships, research and execution** 

 .
 





 This is a role for someone who enjoys figuring things out, taking ownership and moving quickly. You may start the day working on a business analysis and end it coordinating with a partner, solving an operational issue or helping close an important initiative.
 



**What You Will Do** 
* Work directly with the Founder on critical business priorities and special projects.
* Conduct market, competitor and business research and convert findings into actionable insights.
* Prepare presentations, business plans, MIS reports and management dashboards.
* Track important company\-level projects and ensure timely execution.
* Work with sales, operations, marketing and HR teams to drive key initiatives.
* Coordinate with external partners, clients and other stakeholders when required.
* Identify operational gaps and proactively propose solutions.
* Help build and improve internal processes as the company scales.
* Support strategic expansion into new markets, products and business lines.
* Take ownership of projects from
 
**idea → execution → outcome** 

 .

 We are looking for someone with

 .
 





 The ideal candidate:
 



* Takes responsibility rather than waiting for instructions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Can handle ambiguity and figure things out independently.
* Has strong communication and problem\-solving skills.

* Can create clear presentations and communicate ideas effectively.
* Is willing to work across different functions instead of being restricted to one area.
* Learns quickly and is genuinely curious about business.
* Is ambitious and wants to grow with a startup.
* Has a
 
**long\-term interest in building with NextNation** 

 and taking increasing ownership.

 This role is particularly suited for candidates who say:
 




**“I want to work closely with founders, learn how a company is built, take ownership and grow into a larger leadership role.”** 





 It is
 
**not** 

 ideal for someone looking for a narrowly defined 9\-to\-5 role with only routine responsibilities.

 Candidates from backgrounds such as:
 



* Business / Management
* Engineering
* Economics / Finance
* Entrepreneurship
* Consulting / Strategy
* Sales / Operations




 Freshers with exceptional ownership, communication and problem\-solving ability can also be considered.
 



**What You Will Get** 
* Direct exposure to the Founder and leadership team.
* Opportunity to work across multiple functions of a growing company.
* High ownership and accelerated learning.
* Exposure to international markets and talent mobility.
* Opportunity to build and lead initiatives as the company scales.
* Potential career progression into
 
**Strategy, Business Operations, Growth or Leadership roles** 

 .


**Hiring Philosophy** 

**We are hiring for mindset first and experience second.** 





 We want people who are
 
**hungry, curious, accountable and committed to building something meaningful with NextNation.**

title: BIE, Speed Benchmarking, CXBT Capability Team
description:
**Description**
 How does Amazon know whether it is delivering faster than the competition? That question is answered by the Speed Measurement and Analytics team within Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT), and as a Business Intelligence Engineer I on this team, you will help build the answer. You will own data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical deep\-dives that feed into Pulse, the team's benchmarking product that tracks competitive delivery speed across 10\+ geographies worldwide. Your work will directly inform how Amazon invests in speed improvements across Worldwide Stores. If you are curious, analytical, and energized by turning large\-scale data into clear, actionable insights, this is a great opportunity to grow your career while shaping decisions that matter.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, ETL jobs, and data models that power competitive delivery\-speed benchmarking across your assigned geography or horizontal function, ensuring data freshness, accuracy, and completeness.
* Write and optimize SQL/PySPARK queries to produce weekly and monthly speed benchmark reports, translating raw data into actionable insights for regional leads and senior leadership.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Program Managers, and peer Business Intelligence Engineers to align data definitions, standardize metrics, and support the onboarding of new geographies into the benchmarking platform.
* Investigate data anomalies, root\-cause quality issues, and implement validation checks so that discrepancies are caught before they reach stakeholders.
* Maintain clear documentation of your data artifacts and analytical methodology, and identify opportunities to automate manual processes for improved pipeline reliability and reporting efficiency.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will start your day checking pipeline health and dashboard accuracy for your assigned geography, then move into writing or refining SQL queries that feed the latest benchmarking signals into Pulse. You might spend part of the afternoon investigating a data discrepancy flagged by a regional lead, or meeting with a Product Manager to scope a new competitive analysis. Between tasks you will review a teammate's code, update your documentation, and brainstorm ways to automate a manual reporting step.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Speed Measurement and Analytics team sits within Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) organization. Our mission is to give Worldwide Stores a single, trusted view of how Amazon's delivery speed compares to competitors globally. We are a collaborative group of Business Intelligence Engineers and Product Managers working together to expand coverage to new geographies and new speed signals. Joining now means you will help build, not just maintain, the platform that shapes Amazon's speed investment strategy.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t\-test, Chi\-squared)
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
* Experience with statistical analysis, co\-relation analysis

 Portfolio Management Group (PMG) Tech is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group (PMG), integrating portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, AI, and data capabilities to make technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
   

  

 Risk \& Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence\-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA leverages advanced engineering, AI, and data platforms to strengthen risk management capabilities, enhance decision\-making, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
   

  

**Job Purpose / Background**
 The Research Engineer partners with Risk \& Quantitative Analysis (RQA), PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to build data workflows, analytics solutions, and AI\-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights. Embedded within PMG Tech Pods—business\-focused cross\-functional teams—you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, AI Leads, and engineers to deliver high\-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and decision\-making.
   

  

 This role requires a strong understanding of business problems and risk workflows, with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will leverage Python, SQL, workflow orchestration, cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Snowflake, GCS), and visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI to build and operate data\-intensive applications. The role also requires experience with data quality, CI/CD pipelines, and data operations to ensure reliable, production\-grade solutions that meet business needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain web harvesting and data pipelines, transformations, and workflows to support research hypotheses and data analyses.
* Develop new platform capabilities to source high\-quality data and create scalable and maintainable data solutions.
* Develop research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, or exploratory tools as needed by the pod for insight generation or research workflows.
* Engage with investors and researchers to understand research workflows and translate requirements into data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data extraction and management tools and technologies to accelerate investor research.
* Collaborate with AI leads to source data and build AI applications to supplement investor research with AI\-assisted solutions.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Knowledge/curiosity about investment research workflows or similar domains.
* Prior experience in data engineering or data analytics, or data intensive applications.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across engineering and business teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years hands\-on experience in Data Engineering/Analytics
* B.S. / M.S. college degree in Computer Science, Data Science/Engineering, or related subject area.


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience web harvesting tools and techniques (Scrapy)
* Experience with cloud data tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, GCP).
* Exposure to AI/ML tooling, LLM experimentation, or AI applications such as RAG, Summarization and Q\&A (Open AI, Vertex, Anthropic).
* Experience creating dashboards, notebooks, or lightweight research tools (Streamlit, Flask, Tableau, Power BI).
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration or automation tools (Kubernetes/Airflow).


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

You will build by developing solutions that fill gaps and make it easier for teams to create and publish data products on EDP. title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development

 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 Enabling the movement toward advanced chip design, KLA's Measurement, Analytics and Control group (MACH) is looking for the best and brightest research scientists, software engineers, application development engineers and senior product technology process engineers to join our team. The MACH team's mission is to collaborate with our customers to innovate technologies and solutions that detect and control highly complex process variations—at their source—rather than compensate for them at later stages of the manufacturing process. With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Our MACH team develops leading\-edge solutions for patterning process analytics and control technologies, thereby providing customers with critical insight at the feature level, field level and cross\-wafer analysis. title: BIE, Speed Benchmarking, CXBT Capability Team
description:
**Description**
 How does Amazon know whether it is delivering faster than the competition? That question is answered by the Speed Measurement and Analytics team within Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT), and as a Business Intelligence Engineer I on this team, you will help build the answer. You will own data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical deep\-dives that feed into Pulse, the team's benchmarking product that tracks competitive delivery speed across 10\+ geographies worldwide. Your work will directly inform how Amazon invests in speed improvements across Worldwide Stores. If you are curious, analytical, and energized by turning large\-scale data into clear, actionable insights, this is a great opportunity to grow your career while shaping decisions that matter.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, ETL jobs, and data models that power competitive delivery\-speed benchmarking across your assigned geography or horizontal function, ensuring data freshness, accuracy, and completeness.
* Write and optimize SQL/PySPARK queries to produce weekly and monthly speed benchmark reports, translating raw data into actionable insights for regional leads and senior leadership.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Program Managers, and peer Business Intelligence Engineers to align data definitions, standardize metrics, and support the onboarding of new geographies into the benchmarking platform.
* Investigate data anomalies, root\-cause quality issues, and implement validation checks so that discrepancies are caught before they reach stakeholders.
* Maintain clear documentation of your data artifacts and analytical methodology, and identify opportunities to automate manual processes for improved pipeline reliability and reporting efficiency.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will start your day checking pipeline health and dashboard accuracy for your assigned geography, then move into writing or refining SQL queries that feed the latest benchmarking signals into Pulse. You might spend part of the afternoon investigating a data discrepancy flagged by a regional lead, or meeting with a Product Manager to scope a new competitive analysis. Between tasks you will review a teammate's code, update your documentation, and brainstorm ways to automate a manual reporting step.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Speed Measurement and Analytics team sits within Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) organization. Our mission is to give Worldwide Stores a single, trusted view of how Amazon's delivery speed compares to competitors globally. We are a collaborative group of Business Intelligence Engineers and Product Managers working together to expand coverage to new geographies and new speed signals. Joining now means you will help build, not just maintain, the platform that shapes Amazon's speed investment strategy.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t\-test, Chi\-squared)
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
* Experience with statistical analysis, co\-relation analysis

**Browser \& RPA Automation Engineer — Go** 

  





  





**Company:** 
 Lucid Growth Media
 



**Website:** 
 https://lucidgrowthmedia.com/
 



**Department:** 
 Engineering
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Work mode:** 
 On\-site
 



**Job location:** 
 Shyamnagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan
 



**Minimum experience:** 
 3 years of professional experience
 



**Maximum experience:** 
 5 years of professional experience
 



**Prior on\-site development\-team experience:** 
 At least 2 years
 



**Monthly take\-home salary:** 
 ₹40,000–₹60,000 — up to ₹60,000, based on demonstrated capability and relevant experience. The offer will include a salary breakdown.
 



**Working schedule:** 
 Monday to Saturday; second and fourth Saturdays off. Sundays off.
 



**Shift timing:** 
 9:00 AM–6:00 PM (9\-hour shift)
 



 Application deadline: 30 September 2026
 



  





**Skills:** 
 Go, browser automation, CDP, DOM and browser debugging, sessions, concurrency and cancellation, HTTP/REST APIs, durable database records, Windows VM diagnostics and Git.
 



  





**Job description** 




  





 Build and maintain reliable browser automation for authorised web applications. You will own multi\-step UI workflows, session recovery, API integration and accurate database records of execution results.
 



  





 The work centres on browser behaviour and reliable workflow execution. You will maintain Go automation components and run workflows in controlled Windows VM environments. You will collaborate with backend, Android and AI/full\-stack engineers. Company\-provided AI coding tools support development.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 \- Implement and maintain Go browser workflows using appropriate automation libraries and browser\-control protocols.
 



 \- Handle dynamic pages, selectors, frames, navigation, waits, authentication and session state.
 



 \- Diagnose interrupted or failed workflows and implement checkpoints, bounded retries, cancellation and recovery.
 



 \- Connect automation to backend APIs and persist execution records without losing or double\-counting results.
 



 \- Verify the resulting application state; distinguish successful actions, failures and uncertain outcomes in reporting.
 



 \- Maintain Go runtime and API integration components; troubleshoot browser processes, window focus and input handling in VM environments.
 



 \- Protect credentials and sensitive records; provide redacted diagnostic evidence, tests and rollback notes.
 



 \- Write task plans, follow approval and review steps, and attach verification evidence before closing work.
 



  





**Required skills and experience** 




  





 \- Strong hands\-on code\-based browser automation, including browser debugging protocols such as CDP and dependable state detection.
 



 \- Practical knowledge of DOM behaviour, browser developer tools, sessions/cookies, HTTP and asynchronous execution.
 



 \- Production Go skills, including goroutines, cancellation, concurrency safety, error handling, HTTP clients and testing.
 



 \- REST API and database experience, including durable state, duplicate prevention and reconciliation.
 



 \- Experience operating and debugging browser processes in Windows or comparable VM environments.
 



 \- Git review, automated tests, secure credential handling and reliable release practices.
 



 \- Clear written English for task plans, reproduction steps, results and handover notes.
 



 \- Evidence of improving an automation after failure or review and proving that the corrected workflow works.
 



  





 Experience with Windows input/window APIs, desktop/browser\-control bridges or low\-code workflow integration is useful. Familiarity with Python services is optional; production Go is essential. This role owns operational workflows and their recorded outcomes; testing experience is valuable when accompanied by implementation and maintenance skills.
 



  





**How we work and hire** 




  





 Work follows documented tasks, approval, implementation, review and verification. We value early escalation of blockers and honest reporting of results.
 



  





 Selection includes a short AI\-assisted initial interview, an approximately 60–90\-minute practical using synthetic material, and an on\-site technical discussion. Final hiring decisions include human review.

title: SDET 2
description:
**About AiDASH**
 AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.
   

  

 The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.
   

  

 Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As an SDET 2 at AiDASH, you will own the quality of the AI\-powered applications behind our offerings. You will understand application requirements and architecture, then build test strategies that cover both functional behaviour and performance. Your work will include API automation using Java and RestAssured, data validation, performance testing with tools like JMeter, and monitoring application health after release. You will also validate the accuracy of AI/ML\-driven outputs and use AI tools to speed up how you test. Success means shipping reliable, high\-performing applications that help our teams deliver faster.
   

  

**How you'll make an impact:**
* Creating comprehensive test strategies that validate both functional and performance aspects of the system under test
* Analysing functional and non\-functional requirements from a coverage and impact perspective, and designing effective and efficient test cases
* Writing robust and maintainable API test automation using Java and the RestAssured framework, along with other tools and scripts that make testing more efficient
* Contributing to enhancing the automation framework based on the needs of the project/requirements
* Performing data validation testing across APIs, databases like Postgres and MongoDB, and the outputs of data processing solutions
* Conducting performance testing and benchmarking of applications using tools like JMeter
* Preparing test data for QA validations by coordinating with multiple teams and ramping up quickly across different contexts
* Creating the automation pipeline using Jenkins or other build tools to trigger the automation, and using reporting tools like ExtentReports or Allure for clear and detailed test reports
* Monitoring post\-production application health and alerts, including working with Kubernetes clusters and AWS services to check service health and logs
* Documenting and managing defects throughout their lifecycle, conducting root cause analysis, and coordinating with Test and Development team members to resolve issues
* Contributing to the quality of our upcoming in\-house orchestration platform, a one\-stop solution for invoking and reporting on the various data processing solutions.


**What we're looking for:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed university with good academic results is preferred
* Hands\-on experience testing backend applications, with strong skills in API testing and data validation testing
* Hands\-on experience in API automation using Java and RestAssured, and/or Python scripting, with a good understanding of test frameworks
* Experience in performance testing using tools like JMeter
* Hands\-on experience with databases like Postgres and MongoDB, and writing queries for data validation
* Knowledge of AWS services and experience working with Kubernetes clusters for checking service health and logs
* Understanding of queues and caching
* Strong attention to detail and curiosity to understand the internal workings of software
* Good analytical skills and decision making ability, with the ability to work in a team as well as an individual
* Ability to work under pressure and maintain deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Good to have: gRPC basics, Airflow DAGs, web application testing and automation using Selenium/Playwright, knowledge of testing and validating ML/AI based applications, and use of AI tools and editors for increased velocity of work


 We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description** 




 We are looking for a Linux Infrastructure Engineer (2–3 years) to help deploy, tune and maintain our high\-frequency trading (HFT) infrastructure. * Tune and maintain bare\-metal Linux servers for consistent, low\-latency performance.
* Optimise systems at the hardware and BIOS level for speed and stability.
* Support co\-located infrastructure at major Indian exchanges — provisioning, monitoring and daily readiness checks.
* Ensure accurate time synchronisation and reliable start\-of\-day and end\-of\-day operations.
* Maintain our Windows/Microsoft Server environment, including Active Directory, patching and endpoint security.
* Work with our Network Engineer to test and validate performance improvements.
* Provide support for trading and back\-office applications, and lead root\-cause analysis on infrastructure issues.


- 


**Job Requirements** 



* 2–3 years of hands\-on Linux administration (RHEL, Rocky or Ubuntu).
* Interest in performance tuning and low\-latency environments.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server administration and patch management.
* Comfort with scripting and automation (Bash; Python or Ansible a plus).
* Familiarity with Indian financial exchanges or trading platforms is a strong plus.
* A methodical, ownership\-driven approach and willingness to work on\-site with trading operations.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience in a broking, trading, HFT, algo, or financial services technology environment.
* Exposure to trading terminals, algo platforms, exchange connectivity, vendor licensing, Linux/SQL support, or server/application support.
* Ability to work independently in a regulated, time\-sensitive business environment.



  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Comprehensive health insurance and wellness programs.
* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonuses.
* Access to cutting\-edge trading infrastructure and proprietary tools.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

title: Quality & Training Specialist - VSO - Sinhala Speaking
description:
**Responsibilities**
 The Quality \& Training Specialist (QTS) department ensures that safety policies are enforced accurately and consistently at scale. The Q\&T Market Lead acts as the strategic bridge between high\-level policy and boots\-on\-the\-ground execution. While Specialists focus on quality assurance, the Lead focuses on systemic scalability, proactive operational risk identification and mitigation, and team excellence.
   

 This role requires commitment to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as operational needs demand.
   

  

 What will I be doing?
   

 \- Quality Assurance \& Auditing: Conduct regular analytical audits of human moderation, ensuring all processes comply with data protection and Trust \& Safety standards while maintaining specific audit targets (e.g., Accuracy, RCA, and Appeal success rates).
   

 \- Data Analysis \& RCA: Perform deep\-dives into recurring quality issues through Root Cause Analysis (RCA), spot error patterns, and translate data into actionable feedback for Operational Guidelines \& Standards and Operations Teams to drive continuous process optimization.
   

 \- Policy Interpretation \& Curation: Act as an authority to provide expert judgment on complex, ambiguous, or high\-risk cases under quality methodologies and processes (like KOM). Deeply interpret safety guidelines and validate "golden sets" (benchmark data) to guide enforcement accuracy.
   

 \- Calibration \& Collaboration: Lead calibration sessions to ensure consistency across different moderation teams. Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders (BPO Partners, PPS, PS, and OGS teams) to simplify complex policy explanations and drive global quality goals.
   

 \- Operational Oversight \& Escalation: Manage and resolve unprecedented "edge cases" with speed and accuracy. Drive policy cascading to ensure new policies \& operational guidelines updates are 100% communicated and implemented across all relevant internal and external partners.
   

 \- Technical Reporting \& AI Utilization: Leverage AI to improve performance and reduce manual, repetitive tasks. Utilize QA dashboards, RCA tools, and calibration platforms to prepare comprehensive weekly and monthly reports focusing on market accuracy, error trends, and policy gaps.
   

 \- Training \& Policy Cascade: Lead or support training rollouts for new policy changes and operational guideline updates, especially for BPO staff, ensuring changes are clearly understood, operationalized, and consistently applied. This is estimated to take up around 20% of total monthly output deliverables.
   

 \- This role requires commitment to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as operational needs demand.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications
   

 1\. Quality Assurance Experience: Min 1 year of proven expertise in conducting analytical audits, tracking performance targets, and maintaining data integrity within a trust and safety, compliance, or high\-volume operational environment.
   

 2\. Problem\-Solving Skills and Ownership: Strong capability in conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA), identifying trend patterns, and suggesting process optimizations that reduce error rates while maintaining high\-speed moderation. High level of self\-motivation with the ability to operate independently, demonstrate end\-to\-end ownership, and thrive in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment.

 6\. Fluency in Sinhala is required to review and evaluate Sinhala\-language content and ensure accurate understanding of local linguistic and cultural context. Fluency in English is also required as the primary working language for internal communication, documentation, and collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

 1\. Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-volume operational environments
   

 2\. Strong attention to detail with ability to follow structured frameworks and guidelines
   

  

**Trust \& Safety at ByteDance**
 Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every\-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis.​
   

 ​
   

 ByteDance recognises that keeping our platform safe for the ByteDance communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining.​
   

 ​
   

 We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence\-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person\-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​
   

  

  

**About Us**
 Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​

 Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. title: Proof firing assistant
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*
**Your** 
**role**
 Saab is globally in a growth journey and are right now expanding in India, read more about the journey in the factory located in Jhajjar at Reliance MET township here https://www.saab.com/newsroom/press\-releases/2024/saab\-starts\-construction\-of\-new\-carl\-gustaf\-factory\-in\-india
   

  

 As a Proof Firing assistant, you will support and execute proof\-firing activities in accordance with approved procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
   

  

 You will be responsible for accurately recording firing results, observations, malfunctions, and test data, ensuring that all information is documented and maintained in accordance with company and regulatory requirements. The role includes preparing proof\-firing reports, maintaining complete test records, and ensuring full traceability of all testing activities.
   

  

 You will ensure the proper handling, identification, storage, and accountability of ammunition used during trials while maintaining strict compliance with defence security requirements and confidentiality standards. Working closely with internal stakeholders, you will support proof\-firing preparations in accordance with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring that all equipment, materials, and documentation are prepared and available prior to testing.
   

  

 Safety is a critical aspect of the role. You will be expected to stop or suspend testing whenever unsafe conditions or deviations from approved procedures are identified and support investigations into proof\-test failures, incidents, or abnormalities. You will contribute to the implementation of corrective and preventive actions to continuously improve test quality, safety, and operational performance.
   

  

 In addition, you will support the development and training of associates and supervisors through participation in training sessions, technical development activities, one\-to\-one coaching, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives. You will assist in maintaining performance standards, supporting skills development, and promoting adherence to operational and safety procedures.
   

  

 The position also includes supporting external audits, inspections, and visits from regulatory or certification bodies. You will help ensure the safety of personnel across the facility, maintain and promote associate safety standards, and support continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, and operational excellence. Furthermore, you will prepare monthly scheduled activity and inspection reports, monitor observations raised by external agencies, and assist in ensuring that appropriate follow\-up actions are implemented and documented.
   

  

**Your profile**
* High school graduate from any discipline
* 1\-2 years of relevant experience in defence weapon systems, ammunition testing, proof\-firing operations, quality assurance, or defence testing environments.
* Knowledge within Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to accurately record and report test data.
* Self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Fluent in both written and spoken Hindi and English, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the workforce.
* Good understanding of health, safety, and environmental regulations and requirements.
* Knowledge of risk assessment, hazard identification, and emergency response procedures.
* Experience with test instrumentation, measurement equipment, and technical data recording.
* Understanding of applicable technical specifications, standards, and testing procedures.
* Ability to maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment.
* Knowledge of crisis and incident management principles is considered an advantage.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commitment to safety and quality standards.


 We welcome applications from candidates with a more junior profile who are eager to develop their skills within defence testing and proof\-firing operations. If you have a strong interest in the field, and a willingness to learn, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection.
   

  

**What You Will Be Part Of**
 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
   

  

 Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe.
   

  

 Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems.
   

  

 Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here

description:

 **Software Infrastructure** 
**Engineer**

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys automation using modern approaches such as GitOps and Infrastructure as Code, and is excited to learn and grow in a collaborative environment. You'll work directly with other teams, regularly demo new features you build, and help shape deployment workflows that make their work more efficient.

* Experience in writing GitHub Actions workflows or similar CI/CD pipelines

* Helm chart experience
* Bash/shell scripting proficiency
* Docker containerization basics

**Important:**

**What Makes This Role Unique**
* Learning opportunities: We'll support your growth in areas like Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform
* Impact: Your automation work will directly reduce manual deployment overhead. You'll work closely with other teams (Solutions Architecture team, Quality Analysis team), building tools that directly improve their daily work
* Collaboration: Regular interaction with other teams to understand needs and demo features.
* Modern stack: Work with current technologies and cloud\-native patterns


**About Our Team**
 We value:
   

  

* Collaboration and communication \- sharing knowledge and learning together
* User focus \- understanding the needs of the teams we support
* Quality \- writing maintainable, tested code with proper documentation
* Growth mindset \- eagerness to learn new technologies and approaches

title: Site Reliability Engineer I
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point\-of\-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back\-office software solutions as well as industry\-leading hardware and drive\-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.
   

  

**Position Description**
 As a Site Reliability Engineer I, you will be part of the global Cloud Centre of Excellence organization responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence of PAR's cloud platforms and SaaS services.
   

  

 This role combines cloud infrastructure, observability, and automation to support highly available and resilient systems, with growing use of AI\-assisted tooling in day\-to\-day operations. You will work closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to improve service reliability, automate operational processes, reduce operational toil, and enhance customer experience.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has a solid, hands\-on foundation in cloud operations and is comfortable owning production issues end\-to\-end, while continuing to build toward modern SRE practices and Infrastructure as Code.
   

  

**Position Location:** 
 India – Gurugram or Jaipur (Hybrid)
   

  

*This role supports 24x7 operations across multiple regions. Working days and hours are structured on a rotational basis to provide coverage and the role may also include on\-call/after\-hours support as needed.*
**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience supporting cloud\-native applications and infrastructure in AWS and GCP pr Azure environments
* Experience supporting production applications in a highly available environment (SaaS environment a plus)
* Hands\-on experience with Linux systems administration and exposure to Windows systems administration
* Experience with at least one observability/monitoring platform such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus.
* Experience with scripting/automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, NodeJS, or similar languages
* Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes\-based platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code concepts and tools such as Terraform
* Experience with RDS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other managed cloud database services
* Working understanding of cloud networking, DNS, load balancing, and application performance troubleshooting
* Experienced in an incident management processes and root cause analysis methodologies
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to write clear documentation – runbooks, operational procedures, postmortems, and knowledge articles.


**Additional Skills**
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate or DevOps Engineer certification
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development or operational tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, AWS Bedrock, or similar)
* Exposure to building AI agents or intelligent operational assistants
* Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar delivery platforms
* Familiarity with AIOps, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, or intelligent alerting concepts
* Awareness of Platform Engineering concepts and Internal Developer Platforms (IDP)
* Exposure to highly regulated or large\-scale SaaS environments


**Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning:**
* Monitor and support the reliability, performance, and scalability of PAR's cloud platforms and SaaS services
* Help build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and observability solutions
* Support tracking of Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and reliability metrics
* Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, escalation, and service restoration activities
* Contribute to root cause analysis and blameless postmortems that drive continuous improvement
* Develop and maintain automation scripts to reduce manual effort and eliminate operational toil, using AI\-assisted tools where useful
* Help identify monitoring and observability gaps through data analysis
* Assist in creating and maintaining runbooks, operational procedures, and troubleshooting workflows
* Support Kubernetes platform operations and containerized application deployments
* Assist with Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Terraform and related tooling
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve application reliability and operational readiness
* Participate in change management reviews and production readiness assessments
* Help analyse system trends, performance metrics, and operational data to identify improvements
* Support capacity planning, performance optimization, and disaster recovery activities
* Partner with Security teams on vulnerability remediation and operational compliance activities
* Participate in rotational shift coverage and on\-call support for critical production systems


**Interview Process**
 Interview \#1: Phone or Video Screen with Talent Acquisition Team
   

  

 Interview \#2: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams)
   

  

 Interview \#3: Video interview with the Team (via MS Teams)
   

  

 PAR is proud to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. We also provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws.
