title: Software Engineer
description:
**Software Engineer \| Meridian Review Group \| Czech Business Review** 




**Remote, London, Prague or Costa Rica \| Full\-Time or Long\-Term Contract \| $9,000–$12,000 per month depending on experience** 




 Meridian Review Group is looking for a
 **Software Engineer** 
 to join our growing international team of just under 25 team members, and help build the technology behind a rapidly expanding network of independent business, markets and economic publications.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who wants to build, not simply maintain.
 



  





 Meridian currently operates specialist publications covering major economies, financial markets, companies, technology, investment and economic change.
 



 We are building Meridian as much more than a collection of conventional news websites.
 



 Alongside journalism, we are developing market\-data products, company and executive databases, rankings, economic datasets, research tools, structured entity systems, internal editorial technology and new ways for readers to understand companies, industries, markets and economies.
 



 The role can be fully remote or based from one of our locations in
 **London, Prague or Costa Rica** 
 .
 



 The Meridian Network
 



 Meridian currently operates seven specialist publications, each with its own editorial remit, research products and audience.
 



 Global Markets Review
 



 Markets, stocks, listed companies, earnings, dividends, analyst expectations, semiconductors and the public\-market side of AI infrastructure.
 



 Explore Global Markets Review
 



 The publication increasingly combines markets journalism with maintained research products, stock and company reference infrastructure and structured market data.
 



 British Business Review
 



 UK business, technology, artificial intelligence, startups, regulation and the economic environment facing British companies.
 



 Explore British Business Review
 



 Its permanent research layer includes UK business regulation, technology\-sector datasets, company research and regulatory calendars designed to remain useful beyond an individual news cycle.
 



 American Commerce Review
 



 Business, technology, markets, industrial investment and economic change across the United States.
 



 Explore American Commerce Review
 



 A major focus is connecting companies and investment projects to geography, including state\-level economic data, major employers, industrial projects and strategic manufacturing.
 



 German Business Review
 



 Industry, technology, the Mittelstand, automotive, energy, finance and regional business across Germany.
 



 Explore German Business Review
 



 The publication combines company and economic reporting with research into German industrial technology, AI infrastructure, data centres and the specialist companies behind Germany's manufacturing economy.
 



 Dutch Business Review
 



 Business, semiconductors, technology, finance and industrial infrastructure across the Netherlands.
 



 Explore Dutch Business Review
 



 A particular research focus is the Dutch semiconductor ecosystem around ASML, Brainport Eindhoven, precision engineering, advanced manufacturing and the infrastructure constraints affecting future expansion.
 



 Czech Business Review
 



 Business, technology, startups, industrial investment and economic policy across Czechia and Central Europe.
 



 Explore Czech Business Review
 



 Its research layer follows Czech technology companies, startup development, manufacturing, exports, AI adoption and the country's evolving industrial economy.
 



 Gulf Business Review
 



 Companies, capital, artificial intelligence, infrastructure, sovereign investment and economic transformation across the Gulf.
 



 Explore Gulf Business Review
 



 A major focus is understanding the physical and financial infrastructure behind the Gulf's AI and economic ambitions, particularly sovereign capital, data centres, cloud infrastructure, energy and major projects.
 



 What We’re Building
 



 Meridian Review Group is an international publishing, research and intelligence group covering business, markets, investment, technology, AI, energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, finance and economic policy.
 



 Our model combines timely journalism with information designed to remain useful long after publication.
 



 That includes:
 


* Company and executive profiles
* Market and stock data
* Economic and regional guides
* Industry directories
* Rankings and indexes
* Investment trackers
* Original research datasets
* Company, sector and geographic databases
* Searchable reference products
* Specialist newsletters and recurring editorial products
* Data\-backed journalism
* Research and intelligence products for professional audiences



 The network currently reaches approximately
 **480,000 readers across our publications in under a year** 
 , and we are growing rapidly.
 



 Our ambition is to create a publishing and information platform capable of reaching
 **millions of readers every month** 
 , ultimately building toward
 **10 million monthly visitors across the Meridian network** 
 .
 



 That creates a very different engineering challenge from building a single publication.
 



 We need systems that can support multiple brands, thousands and eventually hundreds of thousands of content and entity pages, rapidly growing search traffic, structured datasets, financial information, new publications and entirely new research products without the platform becoming increasingly difficult to maintain.
 



 We want to build systems that work well today while being designed for what Meridian could become several years from now.
 



 Examples of Products We’ve Already Built
 



 We do not see data, research and software as something separate from publishing.
 



 Several Meridian publications already have maintained datasets, interactive research tools and structured information products.
 



 Analyst Rating Decoder
 



 Global Markets Review has built a browser\-based tool that lets readers compare changes in analyst ratings and price targets while separating actual rating changes from target\-price revisions.
 



 Try the Global Markets Review Analyst Rating Decoder
 



 It sits alongside maintained research indexes covering analyst ratings, dividends, earnings and company valuation.
 



 US Industrial Investment Tracker
 



 American Commerce Review maintains a state\-level research system following major semiconductor and strategic manufacturing projects across the United States, separating investment values from project stages and public incentives.
 



 Explore American Commerce Review Research \& Data
 



 The same architecture connects investment projects with all 50 state business pages, companies, employers and regional economic information.
 



 UK Business Regulation Calendar
 



 British Business Review maintains a dated regulatory calendar covering major Companies House, employment and financial\-regulation milestones affecting UK companies.
 



 Explore the UK Business Regulation Calendar
 



 Rather than publishing another generic compliance article, the product separates measures already in force from scheduled changes and dates that remain dependent on implementation.
 



 German Data Centre Tracker
 



 German Business Review maintains a dataset of major German cloud, AI and sovereign\-compute projects, separating disclosed investment, planned capacity and actual delivery stage.
 



 Explore German Business Review Research \& Data
 



 Its research layer also includes a
 **German Mittelstand \& Industrial Technology Index** 
 and a maintained index of restructuring across Germany's automotive sector.
 



 Dutch Semiconductor Supply Chain Database
 



 Dutch Business Review maps the companies and institutions that make up the Dutch semiconductor ecosystem across lithography, wafer processing, packaging, design, photonics and precision engineering.
 



 Explore Dutch Business Review Research \& Data
 



 It also includes an interactive
 **Semiconductor Supply\-Chain Role Finder** 
 and research indexes covering Brainport Eindhoven, grid infrastructure and logistics.
 



 Czech Company Ranking Comparator
 



 Czech Business Review has developed an interactive company comparison tool designed to avoid common problems such as comparing different financial periods, currencies or global employee numbers with Czech employment figures.
 



 Explore Czech Business Review Research \& Data
 



 Its research products also include a
 **Czech Technology Companies Database** 
 , Startup \& Technology Ecosystem Tracker and economic and manufacturing research indexes.
 



 Gulf AI Infrastructure Tracker
 



 Gulf Business Review maintains structured research into major AI and data\-centre projects across the GCC.
 



 Its tracker separates long\-term campus ambitions from first\-phase capacity, projects actually under construction and infrastructure already operating.
 



 Explore Gulf Business Review Research \& Data
 



 The publication has also developed an interactive
 **AI Infrastructure Project Stage Checker** 
 , sovereign\-capital reference systems and research indexes covering major Gulf projects and energy infrastructure.
 



 Examples of Our Journalism and Research
 



 A few examples of the kind of work being built on top of this infrastructure:
 



 Global Markets Review
 



**The AI Chip Trade Is Becoming the AI Networking Trade** 




 An analysis of how the AI infrastructure investment cycle is expanding beyond GPUs into Ethernet fabrics, optical interconnects and networking infrastructure.
 



 Read on Global Markets Review
 



 The piece connects company results, infrastructure trends and technology architecture rather than treating individual stock movements in isolation.
 



 British Business Review
 



**UK AI Companies: The British Firms Building Models, Software and Infrastructure** 




 A structured guide to the UK AI ecosystem, separating foundation models, enterprise software, biotech, autonomy and infrastructure rather than grouping every AI\-related company into one category.
 



 Read on British Business Review
 



 American Commerce Review
 



**US Industrial Investment, Companies and Business Geography** 




 American Commerce Review's wider research cluster follows industrial investment from corporate announcement through incentives, construction and eventual operation.
 



 Explore the American Commerce Review research cluster
 



 It connects investment announcements to companies, states, employment and regional economic effects instead of treating each factory announcement as an isolated story.
 



 German Business Review
 



**Germany's Defence Boom Is Becoming a Mittelstand Story, Not Just a Rheinmetall Story** 




 A look beyond Germany's largest defence primes at how rising defence spending could reshape specialist manufacturers and Mittelstand supply chains.
 



 Explore German Business Review's Mittelstand coverage
 



 The same research area includes Germany's robotics companies, industrial automation businesses, semiconductor cluster and AI data\-centre buildout.
 



 Dutch Business Review
 



**The Dutch Semiconductor Value Chain: ASML, ASM, Besi, NXP and the Suppliers Between Them** 




 A value\-chain view of one of Europe's most strategically important technology ecosystems.
 



 Read on Dutch Business Review
 



 Instead of treating the Dutch chip industry as synonymous with ASML, the research maps lithography, deposition, packaging, chip products, precision engineering and research infrastructure.
 



 Czech Business Review
 



**Czech AI Is Moving Beyond the Pilot Phase. Here Is Where Companies Are Actually Deploying It** 




 An examination of where Czech companies are moving AI from experimentation into ordinary operating infrastructure across banking, automotive, software, healthcare and government.
 



 Read on Czech Business Review
 



 Gulf Business Review
 



**UAE Data Centre Projects: Stargate, Khazna, G42 and the Abu Dhabi Buildout** 




 A permanent guide to the UAE's rapidly developing AI infrastructure ecosystem.
 



 Read on Gulf Business Review
 



 The analysis deliberately separates the proposed scale of the wider UAE\-US AI campus from infrastructure actually being delivered, while connecting companies including G42, Khazna and Core42 to the layers of the technology stack they actually operate.
 



**One Platform, Multiple Publications** 




 One of the more interesting parts of the engineering challenge is that Meridian is not one website.
 



 Much of the network operates from a shared technical foundation, while each publication maintains its own identity, editorial focus, domain, information architecture and audience.
 



 An improvement to the underlying platform can therefore benefit every publication in the network and publications that have not yet launched.
 



 This creates opportunities to build reusable systems for:
 


* Publishing
* Structured data
* Company profiles
* Authors
* Topics
* Geographic hubs
* Market data
* Rankings
* Research products
* Internal linking
* Search
* SEO
* Analytics
* Advertising
* Subscriptions
* Editorial workflows



 while still allowing each publication to evolve independently.
 



  





**What You’d Work On** 




 There isn’t a narrow list of tickets waiting for you.
 



 You’ll work with our existing engineering, editorial and leadership teams to determine what we should build next and how we should build it.
 



 Depending on your strengths, that could include:
 


* Building new reader\-facing products and features
* Improving the shared Meridian publishing platform
* Building infrastructure that allows us to launch new publications efficiently
* Creating tools for journalists, editors and researchers
* Building structured company, executive, industry and economic databases
* Developing market\-data infrastructure
* Creating stock and company information products
* Building APIs and data pipelines
* Integrating external financial and economic datasets
* Building ranking and index products
* Developing systems for original Meridian research
* Improving article discovery and recommendation
* Building stronger topic, company, sector and geographic architecture
* Developing search and research functionality
* Improving technical SEO and Core Web Vitals
* Building entity\-based internal linking systems
* Developing automated publishing and editorial workflows
* Creating internal monitoring and intelligence tools
* Building systems to monitor data freshness and accuracy
* Automating indexing, canonical, redirect and orphan\-page audits
* Improving analytics and understanding how readers interact with the network
* Experimenting with AI\-assisted research, classification and editorial tooling
* Building future subscription and premium research products
* Developing infrastructure for advertisers and commercial products



 Some projects will be highly visible.
 



 Others might remove hours of repetitive editorial work or quietly improve thousands of pages across the network.
 



 Both matter.
 



  





**Building for Scale** 




 A major part of this role is helping us prepare Meridian for a much larger audience.
 



 We want the network to be technically capable of supporting
 **10 million monthly visitors** 
 as the publications grow.
 



 This is not simply a traffic problem.
 



 Growth means considerably more:
 


* Articles
* Companies
* Executives
* Stock pages
* Geographic pages
* Industry pages
* Rankings
* Datasets
* Publications
* APIs
* Internal relationships between entities
* Search\-engine crawling
* Data updates
* Editorial activity



 That means thinking seriously about:
 


* Performance under significantly higher traffic
* Efficient rendering and caching
* Database and API performance
* Infrastructure reliability
* Search and indexing at very large content volumes
* Programmatic page generation
* Cost\-efficient scaling
* Monitoring and observability
* Content\-delivery architecture
* Data freshness
* Search\-engine crawl efficiency
* Resilience during major market or breaking\-news traffic spikes
* Shared infrastructure across multiple domains
* Preventing architectural decisions that work for seven publications but become problematic at twenty



 We do not expect every engineer to arrive having built a 10\-million\-user publishing platform.
 



 We do want people who understand the difference between building something that works and building something that can continue working as usage, data and complexity increase dramatically.
 



  





**Data Is Becoming a Major Part of Meridian** 




 Meridian is increasingly building products where journalism and structured information sit alongside one another.
 



 Across the network we are developing company databases, executive profiles, economic datasets, investment trackers, rankings, research tools and proprietary research.
 



 Some products begin as datasets used by journalists.
 



 Others become searchable public resources.
 



 Some may eventually become subscription or professional intelligence products.
 



 Engineering will play a major role in determining how those systems are designed.
 



 Building an Entity\-Based Publishing Platform
 



 One particularly important engineering direction for Meridian is structured information.
 



 An article about a company should not exist in isolation.
 



 That company might also connect to:
 


* Its company profile
* Executives
* Stock information
* Headquarters
* Countries and cities
* Industries
* Competitors
* Rankings
* Investment activity
* Previous Meridian coverage
* Relevant economic indicators
* Research datasets



 The same applies to people, industries, regions and markets.
 



 Over time we want Meridian to become increasingly good at understanding and representing those relationships.
 



 That creates interesting engineering problems around databases, entity resolution, structured data, search, internal linking, page generation and information architecture.
 



**The Kind of Engineer We’re Looking For** 




 We’re less interested in finding somebody who matches a rigid technology checklist than somebody who can look at a problem, understand why it matters and work out a sensible way to solve it.
 



 You’ll probably enjoy this role if you like relatively high levels of ownership.
 



 We’re particularly interested in engineers who:
 


* Have built real production software used by real users
* Are comfortable moving between frontend and backend problems
* Can understand an unfamiliar codebase quickly
* Care about performance, reliability and maintainability
* Think about scale rather than only immediate implementation
* Understand databases and structured information
* Enjoy solving ambiguous problems rather than only executing predefined tickets
* Can explain technical trade\-offs to non\-engineers
* Are interested in publishing, markets, research, data or information products
* Understand that SEO can be an engineering problem as much as a marketing problem
* Know when a simple solution is better than an elaborate one
* Are comfortable working asynchronously with an internationally distributed team
* Like experimenting, but can distinguish useful experimentation from unnecessary complexity
* Are interested in building systems that may eventually serve millions of users



  





 You do not need previous experience working for a newspaper or media organisation.
 



 Experience building SaaS products, research platforms, financial products, data products, marketplaces, content systems or startup products could all translate particularly well.
 



  





**Technology** 




 Our current environment includes technologies and tools such as:
 


* TypeScript
* JavaScript
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* Git and GitHub
* Vercel
* SQL and modern databases
* REST APIs
* Structured data
* Analytics infrastructure
* Modern web performance tooling
* Technical SEO systems
* AI APIs and automation workflows
* External financial, market and economic datasets



**Experience across the entire stack is not expected.** 




 Strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter considerably more than having every technology on your CV.
 



 Engineering Inside a Publishing and Research Group
 



 One of the things that makes this role different is the proximity between engineering and the rest of Meridian.
 



  





 You won’t be several layers removed from the people using what you build.
 



 An editor might identify a research process that takes several hours and could be automated.
 



 A financial dataset might need to update thousands of company pages.
 



 A new ranking might require its own methodology, database and publishing architecture.
 



 A new Meridian publication might need country, company, topic and city infrastructure before launch.
 



  





 Search data might reveal an entirely new information product worth building.
 



 An internal dataset might become valuable enough to turn into a public research platform.
 



 We want engineering involved in those conversations early.
 



 The best solution may be a new application.
 



 Sometimes it might be an API, an automation, a database, an interface or twenty lines of code that eliminate an unnecessary workflow.
 



  





**A Small Team With Real Ownership** 




 Meridian remains small enough that individual engineers can have a substantial effect on the product.
 



 You won’t be engineer number 400 responsible for maintaining one subsection of one product.
 



 You’ll be able to influence architecture, propose products, question existing systems and take ownership of meaningful parts of Meridian’s technical roadmap.
 



 That might mean owning a research product.
 



 It might mean redesigning part of the publishing architecture.
 



 It might mean developing Meridian's market\-data infrastructure.
 



 It might mean building the system that allows us to launch the next ten publications.
 



 We want people who see things that should exist and are comfortable helping us build them.
 



 Location and Working Structure
 



 The position can be:
 


* **Fully remote**
* **Based from London**
* **Based from Prague**
* **Based from Costa Rica**



 Our wider team is internationally distributed, so much of our collaboration is already designed around remote and asynchronous work.
 



 The position can be structured as either a
 **full\-time role or a long\-term contract** 
 , depending on location and circumstances.
 



 Expected compensation is
 **$9,000–$12,000 per month** 
 , depending on experience, technical depth and level of responsibility.
 



  





**Why Meridian?** 




 We are still early enough that many of the most interesting systems have not been built yet.
 



 The opportunity is not simply to maintain several news websites.
 



 It is to help build the technical infrastructure behind an international network of business, markets and economic publications.
 



 We believe modern publishing can combine journalism with structured information, proprietary research, useful datasets and software products far more effectively than most traditional publications currently do.
 



 The distinction between a publication, research platform and information product is increasingly blurry.
 



  





 We see that as an opportunity.
 



 Growing Meridian toward
 **10 million monthly visitors** 
 will require much more than producing more journalism.
 



  





 It will require better discovery systems, stronger information architecture, faster infrastructure, better data models, automated workflows, deeper products and technology capable of supporting substantially larger audiences.
 



 At the same time, Meridian itself can become much larger.
 



 Seven publications do not necessarily need to remain seven.
 



 The underlying platform should make it possible to expand into new markets, industries and specialist subjects without rebuilding the organisation's technology every time.
 



 That is the problem we want this engineering team to help solve.
 



 The right engineer will have an unusual opportunity to influence what that platform ultimately becomes.
 



  





**Applying** 




 Apply through the LinkedIn application on this listing.
 



 Please include:
 


* Your current location
* Whether you prefer remote work, London, Prague or Costa Rica
* Examples of products, systems or projects you have built where relevant



 You do not need to match every technology or requirement above.
 



 We would rather speak with a strong engineer who has built interesting things, thinks independently and wants substantial ownership than someone whose CV simply contains every keyword in our stack.
 



**Meridian Review Group** 




 Visit Meridian Review Group

 TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.

**O** 
**pportunity Overview**
 We are seeking a versatile and hands\-on Robotics Engineer to join the AI Partnerships team in Bangalore, India. This is a role within an established US\-based team that is expanding into India. You will work at the intersection of robotics, AI, and systems integration, collaborating with model builders and end users to deploy intelligent robotic solutions in real\-world industrial environments.
   

  

 The AI Partnerships team is part of the Chief AI Officer's organization and works across Teradyne's robotics portfolio, including Universal Robots (UR), the global leader in collaborative cobots, and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), pioneers in autonomous mobile robots. Your primary focus will be on robot manipulation applications, with additional involvement in visual inspection and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) / mobile manipulators.
   

  

 This role requires a well\-rounded robotics engineer with strong software development skills, as well as practical experience in mechanical and electrical integration of robotic systems. You will be responsible for deploying and supporting AI\-enabled robotic solutions that operate reliably in dynamic, production environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Integrate AI models into robotic systems using ROS2, Python, and C\+\+.
* Design, implement, and test robotic subsystems involving mechanical, electrical, and software components.

* Work with sensors such as RGBD cameras, LiDAR, and depth sensors to support perception and control.
* Use simulation tools (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim) for development, testing, and synthetic data generation.
* Deploy AI solutions from prototype to production on physical robots, ensuring safety, reliability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with global teams including Universal Robots and MiR, as well as external model builders and integration partners.
* Support projects in inspection and AMR/mobile manipulator domains, including hardware\-software integration and field validation.


**All About You**
 We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* BS or MS in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–6\+ years of experience in robotics engineering, including system\-level integration of mechanical, electrical, and software components.
* Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C\+\+.
* Experience with ROS2 and deploying AI models in robotic systems.
* Familiarity with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks.
* Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including kinematics, motion planning, control, and sensor integration.
* Hands\-on experience with robotic hardware, including wiring, sensor calibration, and actuator control.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with robotic perception in production environments.
* Familiarity with sim\-to\-real transfer techniques.
* Exposure to reinforcement learning or imitation learning.
* Awareness of Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models.
* Experience with robot programming environments (e.g., URScript, PLCs).
* Background in industrial automation, manufacturing, or logistics.
* Experience with anomaly detection or unsupervised learning.
* Familiarity with safety standards and best practices for deploying robots in shared human environments.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. description:
Ingersoll Rand is committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.
   

  

**Role : Backend and Algorithm Engineer.**
**Level:** 
 Mid\-level,Individual Contributor
   

  

- 

**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

- 

**About The Role**
 We build a data\-driven platform that optimizes compressed air systems — compressors — under real\-world operating constraints, including stability, safety, and performance. The algorithms this team develops translate live sensor data into operating decisions that reduce energy consumption, lower emissions, and generate cost savings for customers.
   

  

 This role carries end\-to\-end ownership of algorithms: from the mathematical and control logic that determines how a compressor should behave, through to the production service that executes that decision continuously and safely in the field. For this hire, we are prioritizing engineering strength. We are seeking a candidate whose existing practices already reflect a rigorous, test\-first, strongly typed approach to software, so that onboarding time is spent on domain context rather than on foundational engineering habits.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain production\-grade Python services and automated pipelines to a consistently high standard of testing, type safety, and reliability.
* Design and implement optimization and control logic that translates physical and operational constraints into decisions executed by real compressors.
* Fit and calibrate models against noisy, real\-world sensor data, exercising sound judgment about when a given fit or result cannot be trusted, such as in the presence of outliers, edge cases, or boundary behavior.
* Write tests prior to implementation as standard practice, using shared, reusable test fixtures rather than ad hoc, hardcoded test data.
* Carry projects from design through automated verification to production deployment, in close collaboration with a distributed core engineering team.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience building and shipping production Python systems, with demonstrated proficiency in type\-hinted code and schema\-first data models, as opposed to unstructured data passed between functions.
* Strong testing discipline, including test\-first development, well\-structured and reusable test fixtures, and a consistently high standard of test coverage as an established practice rather than an aspirational goal.
* Demonstrated ability to own a service across its full lifecycle: containerized, deployed through an automated pipeline, and operated within an orchestrated, multi\-service infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of relational databases and at least one caching or eventing layer in a production environment.
* Familiarity with modern, reproducible dependency management practices for Python, in contrast to less structured approaches to package installation.
* Strong applied problem\-solving ability in optimization or control logic, with demonstrated capacity to translate physical or operational constraints, such as stability, safety, or performance limits, into functioning algorithms rather than relying solely on off\-the\-shelf models.
* Experience fitting or calibrating models against real\-world, noisy data, with sound judgment regarding the reliability of results.
* A disciplined approach to data and experimentation, including reproducible results, appropriate training and validation practices for time\-ordered data, and awareness of data leakage risks.
* Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with a distributed team across time zones.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with more than one cloud provider, or genuine interest in cloud migration work.
* Experience with workflow or pipeline orchestration systems, beyond request\-response APIs.
* Academic or professional background in a physical or engineering discipline relevant to rotating or reciprocating machinery — thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, or mechanical/industrial systems — compressors being one example.
* Hands\-on machine learning experience, which is valuable but secondary to the optimization and control skill set described above.
* An advanced degree in a quantitative or engineering field.


**What We Offer**
* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance\-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life \& Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.


 Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

title: Applied AI Product Specialist II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Specialist II**
 An Applied AI Product Specialist II is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid\-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cash learning loop—automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

 The Applied AI Product Specialist II plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
* Product Accountability
+ Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
+ Drive strategy\-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.
+ Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
+ Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
+ Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).

* Vision and Strategy
+ Co\-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
+ Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
+ Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.

* Market and User Engagement
+ Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
+ Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
+ Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.

* Collaboration and Teamwork
+ Work side\-by\-side with cross\-functional (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
+ Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
+ Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership.

* Continuous Improvement
+ Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
+ Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
+ Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force\-multiplier to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
+ Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.

* Applied AI Ways of Working
+ Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios—charting new pathways for the business rather than only collecting requirements.
+ Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compressing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
+ Amplify focus: act as Editor\-in\-Chief—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
+ Amplify experimentation: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path for engineering to productionize.


**The successful candidate will possess:**
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


**The team**
 Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI\-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this transformation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of proven experience in product management or related roles.
* 1\+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1\+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 0\-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week
* Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select location available for this role


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience being accountable for value and viability results for an empowered product team.
* Experience in modern product craft of delivering the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Experience in modern product management craft and domain (tools, methods, and practices).
* Experience with lean solutions and rapid, inexpensive experimentation to emerge the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Accountability for value, viability and P\&L objectives for a product.
* Quick to reach expert\-level knowledge within the product domain being served.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and derive actionable insights.

* Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and collective movement toward product goals.
* Customer\-Centricity: Deep understanding of customer needs and engagement patterns, driving teams to deliver solutions that customers love and that work for the business.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for the product, aligning it with broader business objectives.
* AI Agentic Fluency: Comfortable orchestrating multiple AI agents across the concept\-to\-cash flow (research, insight, prototyping, specification, coding, and compliance), with guardrails at each hand\-off—assumptions, confidence levels, and links to sources of truth.
* AI Realism and Eval Fluency: Understands the difference between deterministic logic and probabilistic generation; designs guardrails for hallucination, bias, and drift; uses evaluation harnesses before launch and monitors drift after, with a kill\-switch mentality—and knows when not to use AI.

 Siemens Healthineers is looking for a Software Lifecycle \& Project Manager to support the planning, coordination, and execution of software development and release activities for our X\-Ray Imaging Systems.
   

  

 In this role, you will drive software lifecycle activities across development, quality, and regulatory domains, ensuring efficient collaboration, release readiness, traceability, documentation, and compliance throughout the software development process. You will work closely with international teams to support the successful delivery of high\-quality medical device software.
   

  

 In this role, you are responsible for
   

  

* Facilitating and coordinating Agile development activities within the team.
* Organizing and driving Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, and team meetings.
* Managing sprint boards, team capacity planning, and task tracking.
* Managing software traceability activities and resolving traceability\-related issues.
* Coordinating defect management activities using Azure DevOps.
* Reviewing incoming defects and supporting defect triage and prioritization.
* Coordinating software release activities across multiple product versions.
* Creating and maintaining release documentation, release notes, and project quality documentation.
* Supporting document management, change control, and regulated software development processes.
* Managing third\-party software compliance activities, including impact assessments and related documentation.
* Maintaining software lifecycle records and supporting audit readiness.
* Collaborating with development, quality, regulatory, and project management stakeholders throughout the software lifecycle.


 To be successful in this role, your profile includes
   

  

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Medical Engineering, or a comparable discipline.
* Experience in software lifecycle management, release management, project coordination, or quality\-related engineering activities.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Solid knowledge of Azure DevOps or comparable work management and defect tracking tools.
* Understanding of software traceability, defect management, release processes, and software documentation.
* Experience coordinating software releases and regulated software documentation.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and teams.
* Strong communication and moderation skills.
* Experience working in international and cross\-functional development environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in regulated industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace, or other safety\-critical environments.
* Knowledge of ISO 13485, IEC 62304, or comparable software lifecycle standards.
* Experience with software configuration management and release processes.
* Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, or quality management processes.


 Your Contributions to the Organization
   

  

 In this role, you create value for the organization by:
   

  

* Ensuring transparent and efficient coordination of software development and release activities.
* Supporting high\-quality software releases through structured defect, traceability, and lifecycle management.
* Maintaining compliance, traceability, and documentation throughout the software lifecycle.
* Reducing project risks through disciplined planning, coordination, and release governance.
* Enabling effective collaboration between development, quality, regulatory, and project stakeholders.
* Supporting audit readiness and compliance with medical device development requirements.
* Contributing to the timely delivery of safe and compliant software for our imaging systems.

title: Climate Nature & Social Risk Integration Analyst - Mumbai
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 JP Morgan Chase (JPMC) is committed to understanding how climate change may drive or influence the risks we identify and manage. This includes evaluating how our business and the activities of our clients and customers could be impacted through transition and/or physical risks driven by climate change. The Firm's dedicated Climate, Nature and Social (CN\&S) Risk team, which is led by our Firmwide Risk Executive for Climate Risk, is responsible for establishing the firmwide framework and strategy for climate risk management, developing and advancing climate risk policy and standards, and building our approach to climate risk data. The CN\&S Risk team collaborates with stakeholders across the Firm to integrate climate considerations into line\-of\-business risk management frameworks.
   

  

 As an Analyst in the CN\&S Risk team, you will support the integration of climate, nature, and social risk considerations into the Firm's risk management frameworks, with a focus on research, insight synthesis, and regulatory change delivery across stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with impeccable attention to detail, capable of articulating their thoughts clearly both verbally and in written communications. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a rapidly evolving field within the financial services industry, with high focus and visibility within J.P. Morgan.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Monitor emerging CN\&S regulatory developments and trends; assess implications for the Bank's regional franchise and translate them into clear compliance requirements and implementation plans.
* Coordinate cross\-functional delivery of regulatory change, including socializing updates, supporting impact assessments, tracking actions/milestones, and ensuring alignment with Firmwide framework.
* Support integration of CN\&S considerations into risk management frameworks (policies, processes, controls, metrics, and reporting) in partnership with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and the business.
* Develop high\-quality presentations, briefs, and working materials for stakeholders and senior forums; communicate technical and quantitative content clearly and succinctly.
* Support enhancement of CN\&S risk analytics by identifying emerging regulatory themes that may translate into supervisory expectations, enabling proactive impact assessment, and readiness across lines of business.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Master's degree in economics, Finance, Environmental Science, or related field.
* Strong ability to synthesize technical information into clear, accurate takeaways for senior audiences.
* Understanding of financial institutions and climate\-related financial risk concepts.
* Strong ownership, critical thinking, and attention to detail; able to deliver to tight timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience building presentations and concise briefs.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* 1–2 years of experience in financial services, risk, compliance, or regulatory change.
* Exposure to climate risk, sustainability, or regulatory implementation/change management.
* Experience using LLM/AI tools to improve research, summarization, and analysis (subject to Bank\-approved tooling and controls).


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
   

  

 Risk Management helps the firm understand, manage and anticipate risks in a constantly changing environment. The work covers areas such as evaluating country\-specific risk, understanding regulatory changes and determining credit worthiness. Risk Management provides independent oversight and maintains an effective control environment.

title: Knowledge Analyst - Product Development
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will spend a significant part (\~70% to 80%) of your time working onsite as part of consulting teams helping solve complex client problems in product development domain.
   

  

 Your work majorly includes (and is not limited to) helping client teams estimate product cost based on clean sheet costing (and hence design a low cost product), rationalizing product design based on competitive teardown analysis and customer insights, working on new product development arena reducing new product development time, cost and quality attributes, carrying on survey to understand improvement aspects of the organization to support an efficient and effective product development and improving thereof to build a sustainable capability for the R\&D organization for clients, etc.
   

  

 The remaining time (\~20% to 30%) will be spent on developing cutting\-edge knowledge related to the Product Development (PD) domain and in delivering specialized remote services to clients.
   

  

 You will focus on product development \& design across industries. You will be expected to work on various product development engagements, provide expert client service by way of clean sheet costing, cost saving ideas/lever identification, and product teardown analysis.
   

  

 You will also be required to support development and maintenance of various practice knowledge initiatives (build firm’s knowledge on product development related topics). This is a global role (cross geography, cross industry) and would work well for those who truly envision themselves growing into ‘experts’ within the PD domain.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Engineering degree (Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Production, Electronics). In addition to an Engineering degree, an MBA from a school with a specialization in Operations will be an added advantage
* 1\+ years of experience in should costing of parts or systems under procurement / R\&D functions at OEM or Tier 1 (systems suppliers); prior experience in a multi\-national environment is desirable
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem\-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate complex cost structures, identify root causes and drivers, and propose optimization solutions
* Proven experience building or using bottom\-up cost models; familiarity with research\-based modeling (e.g., process parameters, cycle times, material utilization, yields) is highly valued
* Proficient in reading engineering drawings and technical specifications
* Knowledge of the manufacturing process of various categories (OEM/Tier1/Tier 2\)
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutions
* Flexibility, patience and understanding of fluid, demanding, and unstructured environments, where priorities evolve constantly, and methodologies are regularly challenged
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, interact effectively with members from all levels in McKinsey and client organizations, with strong communication skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in both written and spoken English

title: Backend Developer – NestJS & TypeScript
description:
**Backend Developer – NestJS \& TypeScript** 




**Location:** 
 India – Remote
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 Open – commensurate with experience
 



**Working Hours:** 
 8:00 AM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time
 



**Team:** 
 Peer Consulting Resources – Product Development
 



**Reports to:** 
 Systems Architecture Lead / India Team Lead
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 Peer Consulting Resources is looking for a
 **Backend Developer** 
 with strong hands\-on experience in
 **NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL** 
 to join our Product Development team.
 



 You will help build and maintain secure, scalable backend services for a modern learning platform used by administrators, teachers, and students. The platform includes course creation, assessments, dashboards, and an integrated AI learning assistant.
 



 You will work closely with the frontend development team to build REST APIs, maintain API contracts, implement authentication and authorization, and ensure reliable application performance and security.
 



  





 Candidates must be available to work remotely from
 **8:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Eastern Time** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and maintain secure, scalable REST APIs using NestJS and TypeScript.
* Build modular backend services following NestJS architecture and best practices.
* Design and manage PostgreSQL databases using Prisma ORM.
* Create and maintain database schemas, relationships, and migrations.
* Implement JWT authentication, refresh\-token mechanisms, and role\-based access control.
* Implement request validation, rate limiting, secure file uploads, and error handling.
* Write and maintain unit and end\-to\-end tests using Jest.
* Debug, optimize, and maintain existing backend services.
* Collaborate with frontend developers to define and maintain API contracts.
* Participate in code reviews and follow secure coding practices.
* Document APIs, backend workflows, and technical decisions.



  





**Required Skills:** 



* Node.js and TypeScript
* NestJS
* Prisma ORM
* PostgreSQL
* REST API development
* JWT and refresh\-token authentication
* Role\-based access control and authorization
* Jest and end\-to\-end testing
* Git and GitHub
* Understanding of backend security and API best practices



  





**Experience:** 



* 1–3 years of backend development experience.
* Hands\-on experience building backend applications using NestJS and TypeScript.
* Candidates with strong and demonstrable project experience will also be considered.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good understanding of backend architecture.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, and secure code.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a development team.
* Clear communication and a responsible approach to delivery.
* Willingness to work during US Eastern Time hours.
* A GitHub profile, portfolio, or backend project demonstrating relevant technical experience is preferred.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience working with Angular applications
* Familiarity with Swagger/OpenAPI documentation
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience deploying applications on Render or Vercel
* Experience working with monorepos
* Experience with education, learning\-management, or AI\-enabled platforms

title: Intermediate Backend Engineer, India
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**About The Role**
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.
   

  

**Why you’ll love this role**
* Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow\-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
* Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.
* Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.
* Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote\-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self\-direction are the pillars of success.
* User\-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.


**What You’ll Do**
* Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.
* Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.
* Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on\-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
* Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.
* Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.
* Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow\-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.
* Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.
* Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.
* AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.


**Helpful Experience**
* Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
* Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.
* PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event\-driven workflows.
* Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
* Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.


**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing.
   

  

 We are looking for highly capable engineers to work in the areas of Client/Server/IoT, ready to use their knowledge and experience to ensure we continue to deliver software with the level of quality demanded by our customers.

 Active involvement in the software design and test of reference application processor firmware.
   

  

* Your day\-to\-day role will involve low level software development, test and debug on various platforms, including software models, development boards and shipping products.
* Creating software stacks for Arm’s reference platforms for future Arm devices.
* Development of test code

* Expertise in application and low\-level systems, with a strong understanding of system architecture (preferably ARM), OS fundamentals, bootloaders, and device drivers. Proficiency in Linux/Windows operating systems and driver development is preferred.
* Good understanding of test methodologies, CI and test automation.
* Strong interpersonal skills; excellent written and spoken English.


****“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:****
* Experience with Python programming and writing shell scripts.
* Basic understanding of the Linux kernel, system software and device drivers, and Android internals
* Familiarity with open\-source project development cycles and contribution processes.
* Experience of software profiling, instrumentation, and optimization.
* Verification and validation of firmware.

* Experience with Security Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices.

title: Technical Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Engineer with a strong background in telecommunications networking. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in data plane software development for PHY, PCS, MAC layers, transceivers, and IEEE 802\.3 standards, coupled with robust C/C\+\+ programming skills. This role is crucial for developing and optimizing high\-performance carrier\-grade hardware products.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
 NIFN2026
   

  

* Develop and optimize data plane software for high\-performance, carrier\-grade networking hardware, focusing on PHY, PCS, MAC, and transceiver layers that comply with IEEE 802\.3 standards.
* Design, implement, and maintain low\-level drivers and HALs for ASICs and optical transceivers, working closely with Broadcom, Marvell, and in\-house chipsets.
* Analyze and troubleshoot packet forwarding paths to diagnose complex Layer 1 and Layer 2 networking issues, ensuring optimal throughput and reliability.
* Collaborate with hardware and system teams to derive software requirements from schematics, datasheets, and hardware documentation, validating designs through lab testing.
* Debug, profile, and optimize embedded software running on RTOS environments (e.g., VxWorks), ensuring performance, stability, and carrier\-grade quality.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 You Have:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 4\+ years of relevant experience in embedded or networking software development.
* Proficiency in C, C\+\+, and Assembly programming.
* Experience with RTOS concepts and VxWorks development.
* Experience working with Broadcom, Marvell, or custom ASIC chipsets. Strong background in HAL development for ASICs and transceivers.
* Familiarity with SFF, MSA, and CMIS 5\.2 specifications for optical modules.
* Solid understanding of SerDes fundamentals (FFE, DFE, insertion loss, signal integrity).
* Good experience with Layer 1 and Layer 2 networking protocols.
* Deep knowledge of IEEE 802\.3 Ethernet standards (PHY, PCS, MAC).
* Hands\-on experience with packet forwarding analysis and troubleshooting.


 It would be nice if you also have:
   

  

* Direct hands\-on experience with Broadcom and/or Marvell SDKs and chipsets.
* Proficiency with protocol analyzers and debugging tools (e.g., Wireshark).
* Experience with hardware simulation or emulation environments.
* Familiarity with QEMU, automated test frameworks, and lab validation setups.
* Exposure to large\-scale system integration and field issue debugging in telecom environments.

title: Graphics Modelling Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 Adreno GPU has been the industry leading mobile graphics solution and has been the dominating GPU in today’s smart phone market. Our power efficient GPU solution is fundamental to enable the exciting new markets like VR, IoT, AI, drone, autonomous driving etc. We are looking for talented Graphics System engineers to create world class GPU products to enable high performance graphics and compute with low power consumption.
   

  

 As a member of our Graphics System team, you will help create the simulator of our next generation graphics core for mobile devices. In this position, you will be responsible for development of the GPU architecture design using advanced modeling methodologies. You are expected to understand the design and implementation, define the development scope, develop the algorithm for some functional blocks, and verify the correctness of the design. You will be working with architects, designers, driver, and compiler teams to accomplish your tasks.
   

  

* Develop bitwise accurate functional models (C\-model) (by using C/C\+\+ etc.) to simulate our new architectures and solutions
* Develop solid test suites and perform functional verification \& validation with the C\-Model and RTL simulation
* Perform conformance tests, stress \& random tests and stabilize GPUs \& Compute systems


**Critical “Must Have” Skills/experience For Role**
* Good understanding of modern 3D graphics pipeline.
* Programming experience in graphics or compute using API like DirectX, OpenGL OpenCL, Vulkan.
* Programming experience in modeling using C\+\+ and good understanding of computer/GPU architecture and pipeline.
* Debugging and problem\-solving skills. Ability to write clean, professional \& maintainable code in C\+\+.


**Preferred Skills/experience For Role**
* Knowledge on graphics/ray\-tracing/compute architecture \& pipeline (e.g., DirectX, OpenGL, OpenCL, Vulkan, etc.)
* C/C\+\+/Perl/Python programming language
* Good communication skills and ability \& desire to work as a team player.
* SystemC and TLM experience are desirable
* Agile development methodology experience is preferable
* Graphics \& compute driver or compiler experience is a plus
* Verilog/Vera/System Verilog experience is a plus


**Education Text**
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Preferred: Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or related field


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
   

  

 OR
   

  

 PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1\+ year of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

**About The Company**
**Who are we?**
 Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e\-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.
   

  

 We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
   

  

 Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self\-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.
   

  

 We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
   

  

 From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.
   

  

 Working at Myntra is challenging but fun \- we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.
   

  

 Job Description: Inventory \& Demand Planner
   

  

**Role Overview:** 
 We are looking for a sharp, data\-driven
 **Inventory \& Demand Planner** 
 to master the balance between supply and demand. In this role, you won’t just count stock—you will optimise it. You will be the strategic link ensuring our FDCs have exactly what they need (neither too much nor too little) by analysing trends, streamlining operations, and collaborating across teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Demand Forecasting \& Analytics
   

  

* Analyse \& Predict: Dive deep into historical sales data and emerging market trends to build highly accurate demand forecasts.
* Risk Mitigation: Develop and execute proactive strategies to eliminate stockouts and aggressively minimise overstock risk.


 Process Optimisation \& Accuracy
   

  

* Drive Efficiency: Identify and implement industry best practices to boost overall inventory efficiency and data integrity.
* Streamline Workflows: Redesign and optimise inventory processes to drastically reduce stock discrepancies and ensure pinpoint accuracy.


 Strategic Inventory Management
   

  

* Optimise FDCs: Continuously monitor and maintain optimal stock thresholds across all FDCs to seamlessly align with demand forecasts.
* Asset Health: Balance inventory turnover rates to keep capital fluid and warehousing efficient.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Operations Integration: Partner closely with logistics and delivery teams to ensure a frictionless, end\-to\-end supply chain loop.
* Commercial Alignment: Synchronise with the purchasing and marketing teams to align inventory levels with upcoming promotional campaigns and seasonal demand spikes.


**Required Skills**
 inventory planning, demand planning, inventory management, stock management
