title: Engineering Manager
description:
### **Description**

  

Based in Gurugram, you will lead our newly established software team (currently four engineers) as we enter an exciting new phase of expansion. We are seeking an Engineering Manager who will build a strong, happy, high\-performing team, creating the environment, clarity, and support that enables people to do their best work. This is a people\-first role: you will have proven strength in leadership, scaling teams, and developing others. You will report to the Head of Software Product Engineering.  

Aurora’s mission is to help drive the energy transition through data\-driven energy market intelligence and software that supports decision\-makers across the power system. You will partner closely with colleagues in Oxford and across the business to help the team build customer\-facing software that delivers on this mission.
  

Our platform includes microservices and modern web applications (TypeScript/Node, React, AWS). While this is a leadership\-focused role, you will still do some hands\-on senior engineering work, contributing code when needed, leading by example on quality, and helping the team make sound technical decisions
  

You will establish the people and process foundations for an effective engineering team: regular 1:1s, coaching and feedback, inclusive ways of working, and strong delivery practices (planning, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives). A key part of the role is growing the team through hiring, attracting, assessing, and onboarding great talent in Gurugram.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead and grow the Gurugram engineering team, creating a positive, inclusive, high\-trust culture with strong team health and engagement.
* Hire, onboard, and retain great engineers, owning the hiring process end\-to\-end in partnership with HR and engineering leadership.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members through 1:1s, goal setting, feedback, and growth plans; support performance management when needed.
* Contribute as a senior engineer: write and review code, guide architecture and technical design, and continuously raise the bar on engineering standards (testing, reliability, and maintainability).
* Run effective engineering processes and ceremonies (planning, daily coordination, reviews, and especially high\-quality retrospectives) that drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to shape priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the team delivers valuable outcomes with a sustainable pace and high quality

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Required attributes:*** Strong people leadership and emotional intelligence: able to build trust, communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations, and foster psychological safety.
* Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers (including regular 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, and progression support), with a genuine interest in people development.
* Demonstrated hiring capability: defining roles, running structured interviews, assessing both technical and behavioural skills, and making high\-quality hiring decisions.
* Experience running effective team processes (e.g., planning, reviews, and retrospectives) and using outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
* Able to lead within a distributed environment and collaborate effectively with Oxford\-based colleagues through proactive communication and inclusion.
* Experience working hands\-on with our (or similar) stack: Node/TypeScript, ExpressJS, React, SQL/NoSQL, AWS and microservices.
* Strong organisational skills: can balance competing priorities, create clarity, and follow through on commitments.

**Desirable attributes:*** Experience using delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to inform team practices.
* Experience with engineering quality practices such as unit testing and CI/CD pipelines.

  

### **What we offer**

  

Some of the benefits we include are:* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.  

  

Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.### **About Aurora Energy Research**


From its academic roots, Aurora Energy Research is a thriving, rapidly growing company, currently serving over 1000 of the world’s most influential energy sector participants, including utilities, investors, and governments.  

  

While we constantly strive to reach new markets and diversify our product portfolio, we are already active across the globe in Asia\-Pacific, Latin America, Europe, South Africa and North America, working with leading organisations to provide comprehensive market intelligence, bespoke analytic and advisory services, and cutting\-edge software.

Link Logistics is a leading owner and operator of last\-mile industrial real estate, with a large portfolio across key North American markets. Founded by Blackstone in 2019, Link Logistics combines institutional scale with local expertise, proprietary data and a fast\-moving, collaborative culture operating at the intersection of real estate, technology, data and sustainability.

**What you will do:**
---------------------


Link Logistics is seeking an accomplished and entrepreneurial **Director, Business Partner Advisory, Link Logistics India** to establish and lead the people and talent agenda for its Bengaluru organization.

The Director will create the long\-term people strategy for the Bengaluru organization while designing and leading the full employee lifecycle, from workforce planning and employer positioning through recruitment, onboarding, development, engagement, performance and retention.

  

The successful candidate will bring approximately 20 or more years of progressive HR and talent leadership experience, including meaningful experience in start\-up, greenfield or rapidly scaling environments. This leader must be equally comfortable advising senior executives, building new programs, solving complex organizational challenges and personally driving critical work when needed.

  

The Director will serve as the senior HR leader and principal people advisor for the Link Logistics India organization and advisor to Head of Link India. The role will partner closely with the central entity P\&C team, which provides core HR processes, policies and operational support. The Director will ensure that these services are effectively integrated into the Link Logistics employee experience while retaining clear ownership of the company’s people strategy, workforce priorities, leadership advisory and talent agenda.

###

### **Employee Lifecycle and People Solutions**

* In partnership with **Revantage Services and People Solutions**, oversee the employee experience from onboarding through development, performance, engagement, retention and departure.
* Ensure core HR processes, policies, systems and services are effectively delivered and aligned with Link Logistics’ business and culture.
* Lead workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, performance management and engagement activities.
* Advise leaders on performance, organizational and employee matters, partnering with People Solutions and other specialists as needed.
* Establish clear roles, service expectations, escalation paths and measures of effectiveness across the HR partnership.
* Use employee feedback and workforce data to improve programs, processes and the employee experience.

### **Leadership, Culture and Team Development**

* Establish and reinforce a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion and high performance.
* Coach senior leaders and managers on leadership effectiveness and talent development.

* Demonstrated success building HR strategies, teams, programs and operating models.
* Strong experience advising executives on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership, talent and change.
* Deep expertise in strategic talent acquisition, including executive search, talent intelligence and workforce planning.
* Experience working within complex global, matrixed and shared\-service environments.
* Strong knowledge of the Bengaluru talent market and Indian employment practices.

**You will showcase:**
----------------------

* A hands\-on builder who can create structure and scale in an evolving environment.

Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.

At H\&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.


We offer all our employees at H\&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here!

\* Ability to work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment.

\* Team player with a willingness to learn.

\* Basic knowledge of food and beverage service.

\* Familiarity with POS systems is an added advantage.

Working Conditions

\* Rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

\* Standing and walking for extended periods.

\* Ability to carry trays, plates, and service equipment safely.

Performance Standards

\* Deliver exceptional guest service that exceeds customer expectations.

\* Maintain Olegio’s standards of cleanliness, professionalism, and hospitality.

\* Ensure prompt, courteous, and efficient service at all times.

\* Comply with all company policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), food safety regulations, and workplace safety guidelines.

\* Contribute positively to teamwork and help create an outstanding dining experience for every guest.

Olegio Gastronomy Pvt. Ltd. is committed to delivering authentic European hospitality through exceptional food, outstanding service, and memorable guest experiences. :
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk (OTCR) organisation is instrumental in protecting and ensuring the resilience of Standard Chartered Bank’s operations, data, and IT systems by managing operational, technology and cyber risk across the enterprise. As a critical function reporting into the Group Chief Risk Officer (CRO), the Group OTCR team serves as the second line of defense for assuring that controls are implemented effectively, in accordance with the OTCR Framework, and for instilling a risk culture within the Bank.


The Assistant Manager, OTCR Reporting is a permanent role that requires knowledge and experience in data management and governance, development and delivery of internal risk reporting, a deep understanding of the Group’s operational risk events’ standards and a holistic understanding to regulatory expectations on operational loss reporting and data analytics. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, OTCR Data Governance, Reporting \& Analytics.


The purpose of this role is to implement a robust data governance around internal risk reporting framework, identify and enable utilization of accurate and timely risk data, and deliver business efficiencies through automation and process optimization.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Internal Risk Reporting:**

• Responsibility for production of OTCR Risk Information Reports for regions, countries, businesses and functions within the Bank.
  

• Identify and respond to MI and reporting requirements to support the internal reporting requirements and committee paper preparations. Addressing the senior management requests for management information and reporting packs and updates.
  

• Lead multi\-business/function forums and working groups to solution for risk reporting issues, identify actions and drive remediation to completion.
  

• Lead engagement with key stakeholders to ensure that key risk drivers and business rationales are reflected in the commentary of risk reporting and that adequate attention is drawn on key insights from risk analysis.
  

• Determine new risk reporting requirements of the bank, continually enhance existing risk information reports and conceptualise development of risk information reports at appropriate levels of granularity.
  

• Implement automated solutions to monitor data quality and issue resolution
  

• Set up processes with embedded best in class data management practices  

  



**To deliver this the role holder must have:**

• Ability to identify and analyze risk data and communicate data\-driven insights to wider audience with diverse background
  

• A collaborative approach to ensure that the needs of stakeholders can be met, in order to support effective risk identification, prioritization and remediation
  

• An ability to drive innovation and change so as to enhance processes and achieve efficiencies and investment in people to ensure that staff are fully supported to be here for good.


**Governance**  

**The role holder is responsible for the following:**  

• Building a strong risk culture and good conduct in the OTCR organization
  

• Ensure compliance with Group Data Conduct Policy and its standards, Group Data Management Policy and its standards, Risk Reporting and Risk Data Aggregation Standards, and all other standards related to management and utilization of risk data, and risk reporting


**Strategy**  

• Prepare reports, packs and MI for senior committees and forums.
  

• Resolve audit findings; open/close related operational risk issues.
  

• Maintain a mature OTCR risk reporting process, including effective change management.
  

• Support OTCR risk type by monitoring OTCR compliance, informing about risk metrics and quarterly risk assessments, and improving control efficiency.
  

• Develop and support the strategic planning process (incl. prioritisation of strategic initiatives)
  

• Support the establishment of good culture and corporate identity by developing mission / value statements
  

• Align processes, resources\-planning and objectives with the strategy
  

• Provide support and insight into significant organizational changes (e.g., shift in strategic focus)
  

• Support business/ strategic planning activities by providing financial budgets and forecasts
  

• Address audit issues as they arise, incl. creation and closure of operational risk issues related to specific audit findings
  

• Support in the preparation of reports, packs and MI to senior executives including to the Board as required and Regulators
  

• Drive the strategic intent and agenda of the OTCR organisation through excellent reporting, data and MI, processes, and creating visibility of top risks across the Management Team


• Management of headcount, workforce governance, vacancies, and succession planning
  

• Communicate risk intelligence to stakeholders for principle and sub\-risk types of OTCR
  

• Prepare and present communications and MI to senior management
  

• Contribute to the development of performance management processes, to encourage the development of an appropriate risk culture and discipline.
  

• Establish and maintain a mature Risk Reporting Process for OTCR, including effective and efficient change management
  

• Support the Executive Director, OTCR Data Governance, Reporting and Analytics to build data analytics capabilities in the team with the aim to monitor compliance with OTCR requirements and provide insights for the risk metrics.
  

**Business**  

* Develop and maintain OTCR risk reporting capabilities, tools and processes to meet business needs.
* Deliver timely and accurate OTCR risk reports.
* Improve data management, governance and reporting through appropriate tools, automation and best practices.
* Strengthen data quality controls, escalate issues and support effective continuous monitoring.
* Partner with OTCR data owners to leverage data for risk reporting and insights.
* Maintain clear documentation and control requirements for the risk reporting process
**Processes**  

• Support the build of a mature and sustainable process to deliver timely and accurate OTCR Risk Metrics (data about for example Risk Events, Elevated Residual Risks, ICS Culture Quotient)
  

• Provide commentary \& insights to OTCR Risk Metrics
  

• Regularly review the monthly and quarterly performance of risk metrics, identifying any patterns, deteriorating trends, or emerging risks for escalation to the RFO or designated delegate.
  

• Monitor and manage the quality of data used in the OTCR Risk Reporting process (identify and assess issues, monitor closure and mitigation of those issues)
  

• Collaborate with OTCR Data Providers for timely and accurate metric results as well as metric reading
  

• Handle Manual Adjustments related to OTCR Risk Metrics (identification, impact assessment, documentation in central repository)
  

• Establish and maintain OTCR Risk Metrics documentation (including Report Specification, Metric Calculation Logic, List of Critical Risk Measures, List of Critical Data Elements)
  

• Engage in change risk and impact assessment for reporting changes triggered by Policy, System, Regulatory Changes
  

• Contribute to the design and implementation of effective continuous monitoring for Data Quality
  

• Support RCSA for the OTCR Risk Reporting process by providing challenges during KCI design and automations as well as evidencing for existing KCI attestation.
  

• Continuously look for areas to improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the OTCR risk management processes through optimization and automation


**Risk Management**  

• Define and design appropriate MI and communicate via reporting to relevant committees.
  

• Embed appropriate data quality controls and provide analysis to support effective Risk Management
  

• Ensure that all activities are in line with and support of the OTCR principal risk type under the Bank’s ERMF
  

• Ensure all activities are in line with and support the relevant data management and risk reporting internal polices and standards and external regulatory requirements and obligations
  

• Identify and assess the impact of data quality issues, analyse the root cause and escalate when necessary
  

• Provide commentary \& insights to critical and context OTCR risk metrics
  

• Ensure early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to OTCR and relevant stakeholders.
  

• Provide insight and guidance on the interpretation of reported exceptions/analytics outputs so that appropriate actions can be taken by the Group OTCR function


**Governance**  

**The role holder is responsible for the following:**  

• Building a strong risk culture and good conduct in the OTCR organization
  

• Ensure compliance with Group Data Conduct Policy and its standards, Group Data Management Policy and its standards, Risk Reporting and Risk Data Aggregation Standards, and all other standards related to management and utilization of risk data, and risk reporting


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**

• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  

• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  

• Demonstrating leadership ability to ensure that the team achieves the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Risk framework.


**Key stakeholders**

• OTCR LT
  

• OTCR SPOC
  

• Risk \& CFCC COO
  

• Regional CRO
  

• Country OTCR Teams
  

• Global Head Reporting, Risk \& CFCC
  

• Group CISO Teams
  

• TTO Data Domain Owner
  

• Group CDO Teams
  

• HR Learning Capability
  

• Risk BPM Team
  

• Head Audit


**Other Responsibilities**  

• Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must\-have Skills**  

• Risk and Compliance
  

• Risk Reporting and Data Governance
  

• Analytical Thinking


**Other Skills**  

• Microsoft Excel and Data Analysis
  

• Effective Communication
  

• Business Partnering
  

• Business Process Improvement and Change Management


**Motivations**
---------------

• Solving complex risk\-data and reporting problems with disciplined analysis and sound judgement.
  

• Turning data into clear insights that strengthen senior\-management and committee decision\-making.
  

• Improving controls, data quality and reporting processes through collaboration, innovation and sustainable automation.


**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  

• Experience in OTCR or operational risk reporting, risk metrics, data governance and management information.
  

• Experience producing senior committee packs and communicating data\-driven insights to diverse stakeholders.
  

• Experience with data\-quality controls, RCSA/KCI processes, audit or issue remediation, change delivery and process automation.
  

• Advanced Microsoft Excel capability; knowledge of SQL and data visualisation tools is advantageous.
  

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**  

• Industry related qualification in Operational Risk Management or Information \& Cyber Security, such as CISSP, CISM(P), and/or CRISC or equivalent experience
  

• Degree level education or equivalent
  

**Languages:** English

title: General Manager
description:
**Job Title:** General Manager / Executive Manager – Strategy \& Operations

**Department:** Executive Management / Operations

**Industry:** Healthcare / Retail Pharmacy

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly driven, execution\-oriented General Manager / Executive Manager to serve as the primary integration and operational support for the Managing Director. This role is central to driving operational discipline, accountability, and execution speed across a multi\-branch pharmacy network. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between strategic planning and daily operations, ensuring that management priorities are instantly converted into clear action points and rigorously tracked to closure without requiring continuous MD intervention.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Execution \& Tracking**

* Convert MD decisions, strategies, and priorities into structured, step\-by\-step action plans with clear owners and deadlines.
* Track critical tasks, departmental deadlines, and project closures systematically.
* Maintain a clear, continuously updated priority and action tracker for executive review.
* Operate with a solution\-oriented mindset, proactively presenting viable solutions alongside any escalated problems.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Coordination**

* Drive execution across multiple branches and core functional departments, including Operations, HR, Finance, Purchase, IT, and Distribution.
* Confidently follow up with senior department heads and branch managers to ensure strict accountability and timely delivery on commitments.
* Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and project delays early, resolving them before they escalate into major issues.
* Separate routine operational matters from critical issues, ensuring daily follow\-ups are closed at the appropriate management tier.
* Champion the continuous improvement of operational systems, reporting standards, and branch coordination across the entire pharmacy chain.

**Executive Support \& Management Reporting**

* Manage high\-level management meetings by preparing agendas, capturing precise Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and driving all post\-meeting action items.
* Synthesize raw operational data into concise management updates, leveraging Excel, Google Sheets, and business dashboards.
* Act as an effective filter for the MD, escalating only major risks, severe delays, or critical exceptions requiring executive approval.
* Handle highly sensitive business, financial, and personnel information with absolute confidentiality and professionalism.

**Qualifications \& Ideal Profile**

**Experience \& Domain Expertise**

* **Tenure:** **4\* to** 8 \*years of relevant strategic or operational leadership experience.
* **Industry Requirement:** Mandatory background in the Healthcare or Pharmacy industry.
* **Preferred Sectors:** Exceptional preference given to candidates with direct experience in Chain Retail Pharmacy, Multi\-branch Pharmacy Operations, Pharmacy Distribution linked with Retail, or Healthcare Retail.
* *(Note: Experience solely in unrelated industries will not be considered).*

**Core Competencies**

* Deep practical understanding of pharmacy store operations, including purchasing, inventory management, stock movement, customer service, and regulatory compliance.
* Highly organized, disciplined, and relentless in follow\-up.
* Strong bias for execution—capable of moving swiftly from planning and discussion to on\-the\-ground implementation.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to fast\-changing business needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills tailored for executive\-level interaction.

**Core Success Measure**

The ultimate success in this role is defined by a tangible reduction in routine MD involvement, paired with a noticeable improvement in execution speed, branch coordination, organizational accountability, and operational discipline across the entire retail pharmacy chain.

title: Store Manager
description:
About Knya Knya is a funded, fast\-growing D2C brand redefining healthcare apparel for modern professionals, backed by DSG Consumer Partners. We combine functionality, comfort, and aesthetics to serve a community that deserves more from their workwear. Our culture values ownership, experimentation, speed, and customer obsession.

What Are You Entering Into Knya is one of India's fastest\-growing healthcare apparel brands and we're just getting started. When you join us, you're not filling a seat. You're stepping into a company that is actively being built, where the work you do today shapes what Knya looks like tomorrow. We're a team of driven people who care deeply about what we're building, move with purpose, and back each other to grow. If you're looking for a place where your contribution is visible, your growth is real, and your work actually matters to the people who wear what we make, this is it.

Role Overview You will run a Knya store like it's your own. Our customers are doctors, nurses and healthcare students who come in between shifts, and they deserve a store that respects their time and their profession. You own the numbers, the team, the stock and the standards, and you make sure every customer walks out with the right fit and a reason to come back.

You report to the Area Manager and work closely with the Retail, HR and Finance teams. Key Responsibilities

Sales \& Store Performance **Own the monthly sales target for your store and plan daily and weekly how the team gets there.** 

Track sales, bill value and conversion every day, and act early when the numbers slip. **Build local demand by reaching out to nearby hospitals, medical colleges and clinics for walk\-ins and bulk orders.** 

Drive high\-value bills through strong product knowledge, fit guidance and genuine recommendations. Customer Experience **Serve every customer like a caregiver. Anticipate what they need, remove friction and make their day easier.** 

Know the product at expert level: fabric, fit, care and durability, and make sure your team does too.

**Understand our customers' world, from hospital dress codes to shift timings, and use it to guide them better.**  Handle exchanges, complaints and escalations calmly and resolve them on the spot wherever possible

Team Leadership **Lead, coach and motivate your store team. Set clear daily goals and give honest, regular feedback.** 

Plan rosters and weekly offs so the store is always well staffed at peak hours.

**Make sure attendance, leaves and punches are recorded correctly in Keka every day.**  Onboard new joiners into the Knya way of working and help identify and grow future store leaders.

**Set the tone on grooming, conduct and professionalism. Your team will follow what you do.** 

**Operations, Stock \& Compliance**  Own inventory accuracy. Run regular stock counts, flag variances and keep shrinkage close to zero.

**Manage cash handling and deposit store cash on time, with daily reconciliation against sales.**  Keep billing clean and accurate, with every sale punched correctly at the time of sale.

**Ensure CCTV, POS and store systems are working at all times and report issues the same day.**  Maintain visual merchandising, folds, sizing displays and store upkeep to Knya standards, every single day.

**Follow company SOPs and policies, and share accurate daily and monthly reports with your Area Manager. Ownership \& Community**  Treat the store as a professional gathering point for the healthcare community in your city.

**Bring ideas on what is working locally, what customers are asking for and what we should try next.** 

**ust Haves**  3 to 6 years of retail experience, with at least 1 to 2 years managing a store or leading a floor team. **Proven track record of hitting sales targets.**  Hands\-on experience with inventory management, stock audits, cash handling and POS billing.

**Comfortable with numbers and basic reporting in Excel or Google Sheets.**  Strong communication in English and the local language.

**Willingness to work on weekends, public holidays and in retail shift timings.**  High integrity. You will be trusted with cash, stock and people.

Good to Have **Experience in apparel, fashion, lifestyle or premium retail brands.**  Exposure to healthcare, medical or uniform retail, or an understanding of how hospitals and medical colleges work.

**Experience driving B2B or bulk orders from local institutions.** 

Familiarity with HRMS tools like Keka for attendance and rosters.

**Experience opening or setting up a new store.**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* what is your current salary?
* what's your expected salary?
* what's your notice period?

Work Location: In person

description:
Role Purpose

The Factory Manager will be responsible for leading the manufacturing unit as an integrated business operation, ensuring safe, reliable, efficient and high\-quality production while building a disciplined, capable and engaged workforce. The role reports to the CEO and will have HR, Administration, Production Engineering, Maintenance, Services, Shipping and Despatch reporting into it.

Education \& Experience

The candidate should be a Chemical, Mechanical or Industrial Engineer with around 15 years of experience in paper, packaging, printing, filter media, insulation materials or similar process industries. Experience in automated manufacturing environments, preferably involving SCADA, PLC\-based controls, IoT\-enabled monitoring, process controls and modern shop\-floor systems, is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the plant to deliver production, quality, cost, safety, delivery and people\-development targets. Ensure smooth commissioning, stabilisation and scale\-up of the new unit. Drive process discipline, preventive maintenance, productivity improvement, energy efficiency and waste reduction. Build strong systems for production planning, inventory control, despatch, engineering support, statutory compliance and EHS. Develop a performance\-oriented culture with clear accountability across departments. Work closely with the CEO and corporate functions on budgeting, capex execution, customer commitments, quality standards and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure high levels of housekeeping, safety compliance, employee engagement and industrial harmony.

Skills \& Competencies

Strong understanding of process manufacturing, automation, maintenance systems, quality systems and factory operations. Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and manage a medium\-sized workforce with discipline and empathy. Good analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills. Strong communication skills in English, Hindi and Kannada or any one South Indian language. Must be comfortable working with digital dashboards, plant data, MIS, ERP and automated control systems.

Expected Outcomes

Stable and efficient operation of the new Ramanagara unit. Achievement of production, quality, delivery, cost and safety targets. High equipment uptime and disciplined maintenance practices. A well\-trained and motivated workforce. Strong compliance with statutory, EHS and quality requirements. Continuous improvement in productivity, yield, energy use, customer service and overall plant performance.

title: Recruiter
description:
**Overview**The Recruiter is responsible for delivering high quality, end to end recruitment for roles within the aligned Business Unit/s.  

  

**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities*** Establish trusted relationships and partnerships with the business and developing a sound understanding of the business
* Work with the hiring manager to conduct full role briefing, consult on market, agree process and timelines for key milestones (advertisements, interviews and expected offer date)
* Support and coach hiring managers throughout the process in relation to systems, practice and process
* Develop sourcing strategies, conduct market mapping, build talent pools and a candidate pipeline for current and future recruitment needs
* Deliver a first\-class experience to all candidates, regardless of application outcome ensuring correct details are provided, recruitment process an appropriate length, a transparent process throughout and a seamless on\-boarding
* Work with the Senor members of the Recruitment Team and provide input into sourcing strategies
* Share insight and best practice across the team
* Drive quality of hire, reducing attrition, minimizing cost per hire and agency spend
* Use metrics and measures to continually improve the success of the recruitment process and practices
* Drive collaboration across the recruitment team to ensure consistency and process excellence
* Contribute to the wider HR agenda by supporting EVP, on\-boarding, culture, engagement, retention, branding, initiatives
* Actively promote inclusion in all areas of recruitment, ensuring considered across all elements of recruitment and selection
* Develop manager awareness and embed the processes that support unconscious bias, pay equality, flexible working and equal opportunities through ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process
* Ensure adherence to company process, legal and regulatory requirements
* Support Link Group assurance programs that deliver effective risk management and compliance practices
* Ensure all requisitions have the appropriate approvals before commencing requirement and all new hires meet audit requirements
* Process excellence, data integrity and compliance to policy and legislation (requisition management to ensure data up to date and accurate, zero fail on new hire audit)
**Experience \& Personal Attributes*** Strong recruitment experience in a high\-volume environment (30\-40 roles)
* Proven experience and results in an in\-house or RPO environment
* Demonstrated ability to develop trusted partnerships across all levels of the business
* Confident in managing stakeholders and influences throughout a recruitment process
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
* Strong organisational skills with the juggle multiple priorities and deliver to required timescales
* Demonstrated flexibility and agility to work effectively within a fast paced, complex and changing environment, with an ability to work under pressure
* Tertiary qualifications in HR or a related discipline is preferable, but not essential
* Strong attention to detail, high quality standards with analytical and problem\-solving ability

  
MUFG Pension \& Market Services is a global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly.
Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose\-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences.


A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.


  
India Hub is a central part of MUFG's transformation program, which has rapidly expanded over the past 5 years to nearly 1100\+ employees, to provide services to our clients across two of our businesses. We have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
India Hub has allowed us to streamline our operations and forms one of our global centres of excellence. This has allowed us to focus our skillsets, innovate our current operations and create new capabilities for the future. The Hub has been designed to support flexible operations processing our three businesses \- Retirement Solutions, Corporate Markets and Investor Services. In addition, our Global Functions team provide centralized expertise and support—like HR, Finance, and IT—to ensure consistency, efficiency, and strategic alignment across all business units.
At India Hub, we are building a dynamic, client\-focused, caring, and inclusive culture based on entrepreneurial spirit, effective risk management, empathy, and trust, underpinned by core values. We work collaboratively, supporting and valuing the talents and perspectives of our people, and promoting a flexible work environment where their wellbeing is prioritized. We believe diversity drives better client outcomes, improvement, and growth.
Be part of the MUFG Pension \& Market Services journey and together we will achieve our full potential. Candidates must have the relevant work rights. Successful applicants must complete background screening before employment.

title: Assistant Manager – CCLE Operations
description:
**Department:** Centre for Continuous Learning \& Employability (CCLE)


**Location:** Electronic City, Bengaluru


**Reporting To:** Vice President – Industry Relations, Career Services \& Leadership Engagement

  



**About JAGSoM**


Jagdish Sheth School of Management (JAGSoM) is a globally recognized business school known for its innovative curriculum, strong industry integration, and focus on developing future\-ready professionals. With prestigious accreditations including AACSB and SAQS, JAGSoM has consistently been ranked among India’s leading business schools.


**Position Summary**


JAGSoM is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and technology\-savvy Assistant Manager – CCLE Operations to support and strengthen the institution’s Career Services, Corporate Engagement, Leadership Development, and Student Success initiatives.


The role requires effective coordination across students, faculty, corporate partners, recruiters, alumni, and institutional leadership to ensure seamless execution of mentoring programs, student grooming initiatives, industry engagement activities, placement operations, reporting, and process automation.


The ideal candidate should possess strong operational capabilities, excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and hands\-on experience with digital platforms and productivity tools.


**Key Responsibilities**


1\. Career Services \& Placement Operations


**–** Support end\-to\-end placement operations and execution of the annual placement calendar.


**–** Manage placement portals, job postings, interview schedules, recruiter communications, and offer tracking.


**–** Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.


**–** Maintain placement databases and ensure accuracy of student and recruiter information.


**–** Generate periodic placement dashboards, reports, and analytics for management review.  

  

  



2\. Mentorship \& Student Development Programs


**–** Coordinate student mentorship programs involving industry leaders, alumni, and faculty mentors.


**–** Support grooming, employability, career readiness, and leadership development initiatives.


**–** Track student participation, engagement, and program outcomes.


**–** Facilitate communication between mentors, students, and internal stakeholders.  

  

  



3\. Industry Engagement \& Corporate Relations


**–** Coordinate interactions with recruiters, industry experts, alumni, and corporate partners.


**–** Facilitate guest lectures, leadership talks, panel discussions, workshops, conclaves, and networking events.


**–** Build and maintain professional relationships with external stakeholders to support student outcomes.


**–** Assist in identifying and engaging industry leaders for strategic initiatives.  

  

  



4\. Event Planning \& Leadership Support


**–** Plan and execute placement drives, career fairs, industry conclaves, leadership forums, and special events.


**–** Work closely with institutional leadership for event planning, logistics, communication, and execution.


**–** Coordinate event documentation, post\-event reporting, and stakeholder feedback.  

  

  



5\. Reporting, Analytics \& Documentation


**–** Prepare management reports, dashboards, presentations, and review documents.


**–** Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and knowledge repositories.


**–** Analyze operational and placement data to provide actionable insights.


**–** Support accreditation, ranking, and audit\-related data requirements as needed.  

  

  



6\. Technology \& Platform Management


**–** Manage and optimize career services and engagement platforms.


**–** Support implementation of automation workflows and digital tools.


**–** Ensure effective utilization of CRM, placement, survey, collaboration, and reporting systems.


**–** Work with internal technology teams and vendors to improve user experience and process efficiency.  

  

  



7\. Communication \& Brand Promotion


**–** Create professional presentations, reports, newsletters, and stakeholder communications.


**–** Support promotion of CCLE initiatives through institutional communication channels and social media platforms.


**–** Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to enhance visibility of student achievements, industry partnerships, and events.


Desired Qualifications \& Skills  

  

  



**Education**


**–** Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, Commerce, Engineering, or related discipline.


**–** MBA or Postgraduate qualification preferred.  

  

  



**Experience**


**–** 4–8 years of experience in operations, career services, placement coordination, corporate relations, program management, student engagement, or related functions.


**–** Experience in educational institutions, career services, HR operations, training, or corporate engagement will be an advantage.  

  

  



**Technical Skills**


**–** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Google Workspace.


**–** Hands\-on experience with CRM, ERP, placement management, reporting, or workflow automation platforms.


**–** Familiarity with dashboards and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Superset, or similar platforms is desirable.


**–** Comfort with digital collaboration and productivity tools.  

  

  



**Competencies**


**–** Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**–** Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building abilities.


**–** High attention to detail and documentation discipline.


**–** Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


**–** Analytical mindset with strong reporting capabilities.


**–** Proactive, solution\-oriented, and collaborative approach.


**–** Event management and coordination skills.  

  

  



**Added Advantage**


**–** Experience in social media promotion, content creation, and digital engagement.


**–** Exposure to alumni relations, leadership programs, or industry outreach initiatives.


**–** Familiarity with automation tools and AI\-enabled productivity platforms.  

  

  



**Why Join JAGSoM?**


**–** Opportunity to work closely with industry leaders, recruiters, and institutional leadership.


**–** Exposure to strategic career services and corporate engagement initiatives.


**–** Dynamic, collaborative, and growth\-oriented work environment.


**–** Meaningful impact on student success, employability, and industry readiness.

title: Sr. Executive HR - Payroll
description:
Monthly Payroll Processing

* Process monthly payroll for employees across multiple branches and locations.
* Collect, verify, consolidate, and validate monthly salary inputs.
* Ensure accurate processing of **basic salary, HRA, allowances, incentives, deductions, LOP, arrears, revisions, and recoveries**.
* Verify new joiners, transfers, promotions, increments, and employee exits before payroll processing.
* Ensure payroll is processed within the defined monthly payroll calendar.

2\. Attendance \& Leave Management

* Collect and verify **biometric attendance** data from branches.
* Monitor attendance, late coming, absenteeism, LOP, leave, weekly offs, and holidays.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers and HR teams for attendance corrections and approvals.
* Ensure attendance data is properly reconciled before salary processing.
* Monitor leave balances and ensure approved leave is correctly reflected in payroll.

3\. Employee Master Data

* Maintain accurate employee master data relating to:
* Employee ID
* DOJ/DOL
* Designation
* Department
* Branch/Location
* Salary structure
* Bank details
* PAN/Aadhaar and other statutory details
* EPF/UAN
* ESIC/IP number
* Professional Tax details
* Update employee master data for transfers, promotions, increments, salary revisions, and other changes.

4\. Incentive \& Variable Pay

* Collect and verify monthly incentive statements from respective departments.
* Coordinate with Sales, Service, Parts, and other functional teams for incentive inputs.
* Validate incentive calculations against approved incentive structures.
* Ensure approved incentives are correctly included in payroll.

5\. Statutory Compliance

Coordinate with the HR/Finance team for payroll\-related statutory compliance, including:

* **EPF / PF**
* **ESIC**
* **Professional Tax**
* **TDS**
* **Labour Welfare Fund**
* Other applicable statutory deductions and contributions.

Ensure payroll data reconciles with statutory returns and challans.

6\. Full \& Final Settlement

* Process Full \& Final settlements for resigned, retired, terminated, and separated employees.
* Calculate:
* Salary payable
* LOP
* Leave encashment
* Incentives
* Gratuity, wherever applicable
* Notice\-period recovery/pay
* Loans/advances
* Other recoveries
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, and concerned departments for clearance and settlement.

7\. Payroll Reconciliation

* Reconcile payroll with attendance and employee master data.
* Verify total **headcount and monthly salary payout** branch\-wise.
* Identify discrepancies in salary, employee count, deductions, incentives, and arrears.
* Prepare reconciliation between payroll register, bank payment file, and accounting records.
* Ensure the final payroll total matches the approved monthly payout.

8\. Payroll MIS \& Reporting

Prepare regular payroll\-related MIS reports such as:

* Branch\-wise headcount
* Branch\-wise salary cost
* Department\-wise salary cost
* New joiners
* Separations
* Transfers
* Promotions
* Increment statements
* LOP report
* Incentive report
* Overtime, where applicable
* Attendance summary
* Payroll variance report
* Statutory deduction summary
* Monthly salary payout statement

9\. Coordination with Branches

* Coordinate with Branch Managers, HR representatives, and functional heads for timely submission of payroll inputs.
* Follow up on pending attendance corrections, leave approvals, incentives, and other salary inputs.
* Ensure all branches comply with the monthly payroll cut\-off dates.

10\. Payroll System / HRMS

* Maintain payroll and employee records in the Company's **HRMS/Payroll system**.
* Ensure proper integration/reconciliation between biometric attendance, HRMS, and payroll.
* Troubleshoot payroll\-related system issues and coordinate with IT/software vendors where required.

Wells Fargo is seeking a highly motivated Principal Engineer to design, architect, and lead Data Engineering initiatives within the HR Information Technology organization. This role requires a hands‑on technologist who can anchor critical initiatives to drive operational excellence and enhance employee and customer experience.


The Principal Engineer will provide technical leadership across the design, development, and operationalization of Data and Generative AI solutions, while shaping the enterprise HR data strategy. This role will oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient data engineering solutions across the HR data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, AI‑driven insights, and next‑generation HR capabilities. The Principal Engineer will also act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing architecture decisions, solution design, and implementation strategies to ensure alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long‑term technology strategy.

**The AVP – Employee Relations and Compliance** is responsible for developing, governing, and executing the employee relations and HR regulatory compliance framework for the India GCC. This role ensures adherence to applicable labour and employment laws, statutory obligations, employee relations processes, workplace investigations, and compliance governance requirements.


The incumbent will serve as the compliance subject matter expert and governance lead, partnering closely with Legal, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Procurement, external labour compliance vendors, and business leaders to mitigate risk, maintain audit readiness, and ensure an equitable, compliant, and positive employee experience.


The role will be accountable for labour compliance oversight, regulatory monitoring, statutory inspections, compliance audits, policy governance, employee grievance management, disciplinary processes, and employee relations strategy across the India organization.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Regulatory Compliance Governance**


–Own and lead the end\-to\-end employment and labour compliance framework for the India GCC.


–Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory obligations.


–Establish governance mechanisms for monitoring compliance obligations, statutory filings, registrations, renewals, notices, record maintenance, and payments.


–Build and maintain a compliance calendar and compliance dashboard covering all employment\-related statutory requirements.


–Monitor regulatory changes and assess business impact, ensuring timely implementation of new compliance requirements.


–Drive compliance awareness and training programs for People leaders and employees.


–Act as the primary compliance escalation point for labour law matters.

**2\. Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance Management**


–Oversee compliance with employment related legislation


–Ensure statutory filings, registrations, renewals, inspections, notices, and returns are completed accurately and within timelines.


–Partner with Payroll and HR Operations to ensure all payroll\-linked statutory requirements are met.

**3\. Employee Relations \& Workplace Governance**


–Develop and execute the Employee Relations strategy for the GCC.


–Lead employee grievance resolution, disciplinary actions, misconduct investigations, workplace complaints, and conflict management.


–Drive fair, consistent, and legally compliant employee relations processes.


–Support leaders with performance\-related employee matters, conduct concerns, workplace disputes, and behavioral issues.


–Ensure compliance with internal policies, code of conduct requirements, and ethical standards.


–Partner with Legal where required on complex employee matters and litigation risks.


–Lead workplace investigations and ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and closure.

**4\. Compliance Vendor \& Regulatory Relationship Management**


–Manage relationships with external labour compliance vendors and legal advisors.


–Oversee labour law registrations, statutory record maintenance, compliance audits, regulatory filings, and labour inspection support through vendors.


–Coordinate responses to government authorities, inspectors, labour departments, and other regulators.


–Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, audit outcomes, compliance metrics, and governance reviews.


–Serve as the internal liaison for all labour compliance related regulatory interactions.

**5\. Audit, Risk \& Controls**


–Lead labour compliance audits and compliance self\-assessments.


–Ensure organizational readiness for internal audits, regulatory inspections, external audits, and diligence exercises.


–Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for emerging compliance risks.


–Develop controls to ensure sustainable compliance adherence.


–Drive corrective action tracking and closure of audit observations.


–Maintain evidence repositories and statutory documentation for audit purposes.

**6\. Policy Governance \& Employee Experience**


–Own policy governance for employment\-related policies and procedures.


–Review, update, and implement policies to align with legislative and organizational requirements.


–Ensure compliance requirements are embedded into employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, transfers, promotions, leave management, separations, contractor management, and workforce engagement.


–Partner with business and People leaders to maintain a positive employee experience while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.

**7\. Reporting, Analytics \& Governance Forums**


–Develop compliance dashboards and executive reporting mechanisms.


–Provide regular updates to GCC Leadership and People Leadership teams on compliance status, risks, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.


–Use compliance and employee relations data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s degree in law, Employment Law, Labour Relations, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and employment compliance and regulatory frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of employee relations and workplace governance practices
* Experience managing employment compliance audits, investigations, and labour inspections.
* Certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, Industrial Relations, or Compliance Management are preferred.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**


–15\+ years of experience in HR Compliance, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, HR Operations, or Industrial Relations.


–Experience in BFSI GCC, multinational corporations, or regulated environments is strongly preferred.


–Experience working with external compliance and payroll vendors.


–Demonstrated experience managing labour inspections, audits, regulatory inquiries, and investigations.


–Strong experience designing scalable compliance governance frameworks.

**CORE COMPETENCY \& BEHAVIOURAL DESCRIPTION**

* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of labour laws, statutory requirements, regulatory frameworks, and compliance governance.
* Employee Relations: Strong capability in grievance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor compliance and employee relations risks proactively.
* Audit \& Controls: Experience designing compliance controls and driving audit readiness.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to partner effectively with business leaders, legal teams, payroll teams, regulators, and external vendors.
* Policy Governance: Strong capability in developing, reviewing, and implementing policies and compliance frameworks.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to use compliance data and people analytics to drive decisions and identify emerging risks.
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence leaders at all levels.
* Investigation \& Judgment: Demonstrated capability to conduct impartial investigations and make sound risk\-based decisions.

description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Basic BBS (Bar Bending Schedule)**

· Prepare and check basic Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) for reinforcement works as per approved structural drawings.

· Verify bar diameter, cutting length, shape, quantity, laps, bends, and reinforcement details.

· Coordinate with the site team and bar\-bending workers for correct reinforcement execution.

· Maintain records of reinforcement quantities and consumption.

**2\. Quantity Estimation**

· Prepare basic quantity estimates for concrete, reinforcement steel, shuttering, masonry, and other construction activities.

· Take site measurements and verify executed quantities.

· Assist in preparation of material requirements based on planned activities.

· Check quantities against drawings, BOQ, and site measurements.

**3\. Labour Management**

· Allocate labour according to daily work requirements and project priorities.

· Monitor labour productivity and ensure proper utilization of manpower.

· Coordinate with supervisors and subcontractors for smooth execution of work.

· Maintain discipline and ensure workers follow safety and site procedures.

**4\. DPR \& MPR**

· Prepare and maintain Daily Progress Reports (DPR) covering manpower, work progress, quantities, materials, and site issues.

· Assist in preparing Monthly Progress Reports (MPR) and compiling project progress data.

· Record delays, constraints, and completed activities accurately.

· Coordinate with the Project Manager / Site In\-Charge for progress updates.

**5\. Basic Material Testing \& Quality**

· Assist in basic material testing and quality checks for cement, aggregates, concrete, reinforcement steel, and other construction materials.

· Ensure materials received at site meet approved specifications and project requirements.

· Coordinate with the quality team/laboratory for required tests and maintain test records.

· Monitor construction work for compliance with approved drawings and quality standards.

· Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, supervisors, consultants, and other site teams.

description:

**Freshers can also apply**

System Management: Install, configure, and maintain servers, workstations, and networking hardware.

Backup \& Recovery: Manage and monitor regular system backups, ensuring the restoration of data in case of failure or system breach.

Documentation: Maintain clear documentation of system configurations, procedures, and network changes.

Collaboration: Work closely with the senior IT team to ensure smooth system operations, upgrades, and IT projects.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Familiarity with Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments.

Basic understanding of networking protocols (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP).

Experience with system monitoring and backup solutions.

Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Good communication and teamwork skills.

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively.

Job Opening: U.S. Career Enrollment Executive

ABOUT VSP TECHVERSE

VSP Techverse is building career\-focused technology training programs designed to provide participants with practical exposure to AI, Robotics, software development, and emerging technologies.

We are building a dedicated U.S. Admissions \& Growth team and are looking for five energetic, confident, and target\-oriented fresh graduates who can identify prospective participants, explain our programs professionally, conduct initial counseling, and support qualified candidates throughout the enrollment process.

POSITION OBJECTIVE

The U.S. Career Enrollment Executive will be responsible for developing a pipeline of prospective participants for VSP Techverse’s U.S. programs and converting qualified prospects into successful enrollments.

This is a business development \+ enrollment \+ career counseling position. Candidates should be comfortable speaking with prospects in the United States and working toward clearly defined enrollment and revenue targets.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1\. U.S. Candidate Outreach

Identify and approach prospective participants across the United States through approved channels, including professional networks, referrals, universities/colleges, alumni communities, webinars, events, social media, and company\-generated leads.

2\. Lead Generation

Develop a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects who may be interested in VSP Techverse’s technology training and OJT programs.

3\. Lead Management

Contact leads provided by the VSP marketing team and independently generated prospects through phone, email, virtual meetings, and other approved communication channels.

4\. Program Counseling

Understand the prospect’s educational background, technology experience, career interests, and objectives before recommending an appropriate VSP Techverse program.

5\. Program Presentation

Clearly and accurately explain the VSP Techverse U.S. OJT program, including:

\* Program structure and curriculum

\* AI and Robotics training

\* Practical/project\-based learning

\* Program duration

\* Eligibility requirements

\* Payment terms

\* Participant responsibilities

\* Applicable OJT/internship structure

\* Terms and conditions

6\. Enrollment Conversion

Guide qualified and interested prospects from the initial inquiry through counseling, application, documentation, payment, and successful onboarding.

7\. University \& Community Outreach

Develop relationships with universities, colleges, student organizations, alumni networks, career organizations, and other approved communities that can introduce qualified prospects.

8\. Webinar \& Information Session Promotion

Invite prospective participants to VSP Techverse webinars, technology demonstrations, information sessions, career presentations, and program orientations.

9\. Referral Development

Build an ethical referral network among existing participants, alumni, professional communities, and other approved partners.

10\. CRM \& Pipeline Management

Every prospect must be properly tracked through the VSP CRM:

New Lead → Contacted → Qualified → Counseling Completed → Interested → Application → Documentation → Payment → Enrolled

Maintain accurate notes and next\-action dates for every active prospect.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We welcome ambitious fresh graduates who have:

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

\* Strong English communication skills

\* Confidence speaking with U.S.\-based prospects

\* Interest in technology, AI, and Robotics

\* Good presentation and interpersonal skills

\* Ability to conduct virtual counseling sessions

\* Strong follow\-up discipline

\* Basic CRM/computer knowledge

\* Target\-oriented mindset

\* Willingness to learn consultative selling

\* Professional and ethical communication skills

MBA/Marketing, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related graduates are preferred, but strong candidates from other educational backgrounds may also be considered.

We are not looking for people who simply make hundreds of calls.

We are looking for professionals who can identify the right candidates, understand their career objectives, communicate the VSP Techverse value proposition accurately, build trust, maintain disciplined follow\-up, and convert qualified prospects into successful enrollments.

VSP Techverse – Building Future\-Ready Technology Talent.

Job Description – Site Engineer

**Department:** Projects / Site Operations  
**Designation:** Site Engineer  
**Reporting To:** Project Manager / Senior Project Engineer / Site Head  
**Location:** Project Sites  
**Industry:** Interior Fit\-Out / Retail Shopfitting / Furniture \& Fixtures

1\. Job Purpose

To supervise and coordinate interior fit\-out works at the project site and ensure that work is completed **as per drawings, specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and project schedule**.

2\. Key Responsibilities

**Site Execution**

* Supervise day\-to\-day interior and fit\-out activities at the site.
* Ensure execution is as per approved drawings, BOQ, specifications and client requirements.
* Coordinate activities such as civil, carpentry, furniture installation, ceiling, flooring, painting, electrical, plumbing, glass, metal and other interior works.
* Check measurements and ensure proper installation and finishing.
* Identify site issues and coordinate with the Project Manager for timely resolution.

**Drawing \& Technical Coordination**

* Read and understand AutoCAD drawings, shop drawings and site layouts.
* Coordinate with the Design and Production teams regarding drawings and site requirements.
* Verify dimensions and site conditions before execution.
* Report discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.

**Manpower \& Contractor Coordination**

* Supervise carpenters, electricians, plumbers, painters, installers and other workers at site.
* Allocate daily work to workers and subcontractors.
* Monitor manpower productivity and attendance.
* Coordinate with subcontractors to ensure timely completion of activities.

**Material Management**

* Check materials received at site against requirements.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of materials.
* Raise material requirements in advance to avoid work stoppage.
* Monitor material usage and minimize wastage and damage.

**Quality Control**

* Inspect workmanship and finished work regularly.
* Ensure proper alignment, levels, dimensions, finishing and installation quality.
* Identify defects and ensure rectification before handover.
* Maintain quality standards as specified by the company and client.

**Project Schedule**

* Monitor daily progress against the project schedule.
* Prepare daily site progress reports.
* Highlight delays, manpower shortages and material shortages to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate activities to avoid delays and dependency issues.

**Safety**

* Ensure workers follow site safety rules and PPE requirements.
* Conduct basic safety checks at the work area.
* Report unsafe conditions, accidents or incidents immediately.
* Ensure housekeeping and proper disposal of waste at site.

**Client \& Consultant Coordination**

* Coordinate with client representatives, consultants and other contractors when required.
* Attend site meetings and communicate project requirements to the site team.
* Record client instructions and ensure proper implementation after approval.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain daily progress reports, measurement records and site instructions.
* Maintain material receipt and consumption records.
* Prepare snag lists and follow up on closure.
* Maintain photographs and other site documentation.
* Submit regular updates to the Project Manager / Site Head.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Completion of work within project schedule.
* Quality of workmanship.
* Reduction in rework and material wastage.
* Effective manpower utilization.
* Timely identification and resolution of site issues.
* Compliance with safety procedures.
* Accuracy of measurements and documentation.
* Client/consultant satisfaction.
* Timely completion of snagging and handover.

4\. Required Qualifications

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Construction or related field.
* **1–5 years of relevant experience** in interior fit\-out, retail projects, commercial interiors or construction.
* Freshers may be considered for **Trainee Site Engineer** positions.

5\. Required Skills

* Good knowledge of interior site execution.
* Ability to read AutoCAD drawings.
* Knowledge of civil and interior finishing works.
* Basic knowledge of electrical and plumbing coordination.
* Manpower and subcontractor handling skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Word and email.
* Ability to prepare site reports.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and work extended hours when project requirements demand.

6\. Behavioural Competencies

* Discipline and punctuality.
* Teamwork and coordination.
* Ownership and accountability.
* Attention to detail.
* Good communication with workers and management.
* Ability to work under project deadlines.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

title: Executive Manager - Information Security
description:
Overview:

The Information Security Lead is a key member of the Business Information Security Office, serving as a trusted security advisor and change agent, enabling secure digital transformation across multiple enterprise business domains (e.g., Supply Chain \& Operations, Consumer \& Commercial, Finance, HR, Enterprise Platforms). This role partners closely with business, strategy \& transformation leads, capability teams, IT, OT, and Cybersecurity stakeholders to embed security\-by\-design into large\-scale transformation initiatives (e.g., AI adoption, automation, cloud, data platforms), while advancing BISO operating maturity, scalable security capabilities, and consistent risk outcomes.

  

The role focuses on forward\-looking initiatives, operating model evolution, and systematic risk reduction—complementing run\-the\-business BISO activities with a strong emphasis on transformation programs, pattern\-based security solutions, and continuous improvement.

  


Responsibilities:

Transformation \& Strategy

* Act as the security transformation lead for major business and technology transformation initiatives, ensuring security requirements are integrated early across strategy, planning, design, and execution phases.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to translate transformation objectives into actionable security strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Shape and operationalize secure\-by\-design patterns for AI/ML, cloud, automation, data platforms, and domain\-specific technologies.
* Drive alignment of transformation programs with enterprise security strategy, architecture standards, and risk appetite.


Risk Management \& Advisory

* Serve as a security coach and trusted advisor to global capability and transformation teams on risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and risk acceptance.
* Identify, assess, and report on systemic and transformational security gaps; develop prioritized remediation and maturity\-improvement plans.
* Guide teams in adopting defense\-in\-depth controls and resilience principles within transformation delivery cycles.
* Advise leaders on emerging risks (e.g., AI risk, third\-party risk, cloud concentration risk, data protection risk) relevant to the supported business domain.




Operating Model \& Enablement

* Advance the BISO operating model by developing repeatable processes, playbooks, metrics, and automation to scale security engagement across transformations.
* Create and deliver tailored security enablement content (briefings, playbooks, patterns, guardrails) for business, transformation, and engineering audiences.
* Identify and remove organizational friction, strengthening collaboration across Business, IT, Architecture, Risk, Privacy, and Cybersecurity teams.
* Support the adoption of Agile and product\-centric delivery models while ensuring appropriate security governance.


Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership

* Build strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and transformation leaders as a single point of security accountability for major initiatives.
* Influence decision\-making by clearly articulating risk trade\-offs in business terms, enabling informed and timely decisions.
* Present on Information Security programs, initiatives, incidents, threat trends, and risk posture as it relates to transformation.


Incident Readiness \& Learning

* Partner with incident management and recovery teams to support post\-incident recovery and lessons learned, feeding insights back into transformation patterns and controls.
* Continuously deepen understanding of the business, technology, and threat landscape relevant to supported enterprise domains.

  


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s or Advanced degree (Information Security, Engineering, Computer Science, or IT\-related studies preferred).
* 4\+ years of IT experience supporting enterprise business functions or platforms, with exposure to Supply Chain, ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, data/analytics, AI, automation, or domain\-specific systems.
* 3\+ years of Information Security experience (BISO, security architect, engineer, or risk leader experience strongly preferred).
* Demonstrated experience supporting large\-scale digital or business transformations.
* Strong working knowledge of:
	+ NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST AI RMF
	+ CIS Critical Security Controls
	+ OWASP Top 10 and LLM/GenAI security risks
* Experience with Agile, product\-centric delivery models, and modern program management practices.
* Professional security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, GIAC/GSEC) preferred.
* Written and spoken English proficiency.
